title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager
description:
**Contract Risk Assessment & Governance**

* Review Statements of Work (SOWs), MSAs, Change Requests, Service Agreements, and subcontractor agreements.
* Identify contractual obligations that may impact delivery, security, privacy, staffing, geography, subcontracting, hosting, AI usage, or operational processes.
* Translate contractual requirements into actionable delivery controls and compliance obligations.
* Maintain a repository of contract risk clauses, deviations, exceptions, and mitigation actions.
* Provide risk sign-offs and recommendations for complex or high-risk engagements.

**Data Privacy & Regulatory Compliance**

* Assess contracts for privacy and data protection obligations.
* Local country privacy regulations
* Sector-specific regulations (Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector, etc.)
* Ensure compliance requirements are incorporated into delivery plans.
* Support privacy impact assessments and data processing reviews.
* Review cross-border data transfer requirements and restrictions.

**AI Risk & Responsible AI Compliance**

* Assess contractual requirements related to AI, GenAI, Machine Learning, Automation, and Data Usage.
* Identify AI-related obligations including:
* Transparency requirements
* Model governance requirements
* Human oversight requirements
* Data governance obligations
* AI security controls
* AI auditability requirements
* Partner with AI governance teams to assess compliance with emerging AI regulations and client mandates.
* Review third-party AI tool usage and associated contractual restrictions.

**Information Security & Data Protection**

* Evaluate engagement compliance with:
* Information Security policies
* Client security requirements
* Data handling obligations
* Encryption standards
* Access management requirements
* Incident reporting obligations
* Validate alignment with privacy, security, and confidentiality commitments.
* Participate in security reviews, spot audits, and compliance assessments

**ODC Governance & Audit Readiness**

* Review contractual clauses governing Offshore Delivery Centers (ODCs).
* Support ODC setup governance and compliance validation.
* Ensure contractual commitments are reflected in ODC operational controls.
* Participate in ODC readiness reviews and audits.
* Drive audit remediation and closure of identified findings.

**Delivery & Operational Risk Management**

* Assess delivery risks arising from:
* Resource location restrictions
* Client-specific delivery controls
* Segregation requirements
* Staffing commitments
* Subcontractor usage
* Service-level obligations
* Transition and transformation commitments
* Work with Delivery Excellence teams to ensure contractual obligations are reflected in project governance.
* Identify risks early and recommend preventive actions.

**Compliance Monitoring & Assurance**

* Establish risk control frameworks for high-risk engagements.
* Monitor compliance throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Perform periodic reviews of:
* Contractual compliance
* Data privacy compliance
* Security compliance
* AI compliance
* ODC compliance
* Support internal and external audits.
* Track remediation plans and risk closure.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with:
* Legal
* Quality & Risk Management
* Data Privacy Officers
* Information Security Teams
* Delivery Excellence Teams
* Client Service Teams
* Engagement Leaders
* Serve as trusted advisor for contract risk interpretation and mitigation.
* Present risk assessments and recommendations to leadership forums.

title: QA Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using bug-tracking tools.
* Validate web applications, REST APIs, and backend services.
* Collaborate with developers to reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve issues.
* Participate in requirement reviews and provide quality-related feedback during development.
* Perform cross-browser, cross-device, and responsive testing.
* Ensure software meets quality standards before release.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and testing methodologies.
* Work in Agile/Scrum teams and participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Requirements**

* Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments and participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Experience in functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, exploratory, usability, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Ability to create detailed test cases, test plans, test scenarios, and test execution reports.
* Experience with defect tracking, bug reporting, and defect lifecycle management.

API Testing
  
  

* Hands-on experience testing REST APIs using Postman , Swagger , or similar tools.
* Good understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, request/response validation, and authentication mechanisms.
* Experience validating JSON responses and API workflows.

Automation Testing
  
  

* Basic to intermediate experience with automation testing frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver , Playwright , or Cypress .
* Experience writing, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts.
* Understanding of test automation best practices, framework design, and CI/CD integration.

Database Testing
  
  

* Good knowledge of MySQL or PostgreSQL .
* Ability to write SQL queries for data validation and verification.
* Understanding of database relationships and data integrity.

Tools & Technologies
  
  

* Experience with JIRA , Azure DevOps , or similar defect management tools.
* Version control using Git .
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and test execution in deployment workflows.
* Familiarity with browser developer tools for debugging.
* Experience using test management tools such as TestRail or Zephyr is an advantage.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing applications built with React.js , Next.js , Node.js , or similar web technologies.
* Strong understanding of Agile Testing principles, including continuous testing, shift-left testing, and collaboration within cross-functional Agile teams.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 .
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals and common web vulnerabilities.
* Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS .
* Basic scripting knowledge in JavaScript , TypeScript , Java , or Python .
* Exposure to mobile application testing is an added advantage.

AI Skills (Good to Have)
  
  

* Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and automation.
* Experience using AI tools to generate test cases, automate repetitive QA tasks, or improve test coverage.
* Basic understanding of AI/LLMs and prompt engineering.
* Experience validating AI-powered features such as chatbots, document processing, OCR, or recommendation systems is a plus.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:

title: Lead I - Software Testing (Senior Servicenow QA, CMDB)
description:
**Role Description**
Job Description –
  
  
Senior QA ServiceNow Analyst Focus: CMDB, CSDM, ITOM and Enterprise Service Management Testing Role Summary The candidate should have a strong background in ServiceNow Quality Assurance and test engineering, with extensive experience in validating ServiceNow platform implementations across key modules and a demonstrated ability to design, execute, and govern testing for Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) capabilities.
  
  
The role requires deep knowledge of testing methodologies applied to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, Service Mapping, integrations, and data governance. The Senior ServiceNow QA Analyst will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and data integrity of platform solutions that improve service visibility, configuration data quality, operational efficiency, and business-service alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and execution of ServiceNow test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts covering functional, integration, regression, UAT, and end-to-end testing.
* Collaborate with business, infrastructure, security, and application stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into comprehensive test coverage and acceptance criteria.
* Perform testing across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM, Discovery, and Service Mapping. Own end-to-end validation of the CMDB implementation, including CI class design, identification and reconciliation rules, data sources, relationships, lifecycle states, normalization, and data certification outcomes.
* Validate CSDM adoption and data model integrity across foundation data, design, manage technical services, sell/consume, and service portfolio domains, in line with the organization's maturity and roadmap.
* Test and verify application services, business applications, technical services, service offerings, dynamic CI groups, and their relationships against CSDM guidance. Execute CMDB Health validation including completeness, correctness, compliance, duplicate management, orphan CI remediation, stale CI controls, and data-quality reporting.
* Validate CMDB data ingestion from ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, cloud platforms, endpoint tools, asset systems, monitoring solutions, and third-party data sources.
* Design and execute test coverage for business rules, Script Includes, client scripts, UI policies, data policies, Flow Designer flows, IntegrationHub spokes, and other configuration elements. Validate Service Catalog items, workflows, approvals, notifications, and request-fulfilment processes.
* Test integrations built using REST, SOAP, MID Server, IntegrationHub, import sets, transform maps, and scripted APIs. Validate security controls, including ACLs, roles, data segregation, and secure integration practices through negative and role-based testing.
* Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites for regression testing, upgrade readiness, and continuous validation. Monitor and report defects, root-cause analyses, quality metrics, and coverage dashboards; drive defect triage and closure with development teams.
* Provide QA leadership, test-case reviews, quality assurance for design deliverables, troubleshooting support, and mentorship to junior testers.
* Partner with process owners and platform governance teams to define CMDB/CSDM data-quality standards, ownership, stewardship, and continuous-improvement plans.
* Support release management activities including UAT coordination, upgrade testing, and post-deployment validation.
* Stay current with ServiceNow product releases, CMDB/CSDM guidance, testing best practices, and emerging capabilities.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow testing and quality assurance, including experience validating enterprise-scale implementations.
* Strong hands-on experience testing ServiceNow CMDB, including CI class modeling, relationships, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), reconciliation rules, data sources, transform maps, and CMDB Health validation.
* Practical experience validating CSDM implementations, including business applications, application services, technical services, service offerings, and supporting foundation data.
* Experience testing ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping outputs, including MID Server validation, credentials, patterns, discovery pattern debugging, and reconciliation of discovered data. In-depth understanding of CMDB governance, data ownership, lifecycle management, certification, normalization, duplicate remediation, and data-quality controls from a testing perspective.
* Strong proficiency in ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), test-case design, defect management, and QA best practices.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, HTML, CSS, XML, and ServiceNow scripting sufficient to read, debug, and validate platform code.
* Extensive testing experience across at least three ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, GRC/IRM, SecOps, and SPM.
* Proven experience testing scoped or custom applications on the ServiceNow platform. Experience validating ServiceNow integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other APIs (API testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI).
* Solid understanding of ITIL practices, service management processes, asset management, infrastructure domains, and application-service dependencies.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex platform, integration, Discovery, and CMDB data issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), or equivalent demonstrable platform expertise.

**Preferred Skills**

* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery, CIS – Service Mapping, CIS – ITSM, CIS – CSM, or other relevant implementation certifications.
* ISTQB (Foundation / Advanced) or equivalent QA certification.
* Hands-on experience with CSDM adoption assessments, maturity roadmaps, data-model remediation, and migration validation from legacy or custom service models.
* Experience validating Service Graph Connectors, Multisource CMDB, CMDB Data Manager, Data Certification, and IntegrationHub ETL.
* Knowledge of cloud and infrastructure platforms such as AWS, Azure, VMware, Kubernetes, network devices, databases, and enterprise applications for infrastructure test validation.
* Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Tosca) integrated with ServiceNow ATF. Experience with Agile / Scrum delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD test integration, source control, and ServiceNow application deployment testing.
* Familiarity with defect-tracking and test-management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, qTest, or Zephyr.
* Understanding of ITIL 4, service portfolio management, enterprise architecture, and application portfolio management concepts. Experience validating ServiceNow low-code/no-code capabilities, including Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, UI Builder, and Workspace configuration.
* Ability to facilitate technical workshops, walkthroughs, and defect triage sessions with architects, process owners, operations teams, and senior stakeholders.

ServiceNow, CMDB, Test Automation

title: Sr. System Software Quality Engineer
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
  
  
AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
  
  
**Sr. System Software Quality Engineer**
**The Role**
AMD’s quality engineering team is looking for an Associate QA Engineer to build, execute, and scale automated test suites for our core memory-tiering agent and central management platform. You will work closely with developers to ensure the stability of low-level Linux systems and high-performance prefetching engines. You will leverage a comprehensive test environment to practice robust test automation daily, using modern AI tools to accelerate development and focus on the core semantics of test behaviors rather than syntax. While automation is central to scaling and regression, some manual testing is also expected.
  
  
**The Person**
We are looking for a QA Engineer with proven experience in software testing, QA, or systems validation. The Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated and manual test solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise applications. Tricentis Tosca Expertise

Domain Knowledge

* SOFT SKILLS: | Excellent analytical ability and communication skills, strong judgment, and the ability to work effectively with business personnel and IS management and staff

**Must Have Skills:**

* Test Strategy & Planning
* GIS: Basic understanding of GIS concepts including spatial data, layers, spatial queries
* Test automation: Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium
* SQL and data analysis

**Education and Certifications:**

* BS or equivalent in Computer Science or related discipline required

Media & Entertainment –
  
  
This project involves the engineering and quality assurance for a Tier-1 Global Streaming Platform. The team is responsible for ensuring the reliability of the Operating System across a diverse fleet of devices (TVs and Players) already in the market. OS & Platform Knowledge: Deep familiarity with testing proprietary TV Operating Systems, including firmware updates, sideloading builds, and navigating developer modes.
  
  
Technical Debugging: Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA); must be able to capture and analyse system logs (via Serial, Telnet, SSH) to identify failure points rather than just reporting bugs.
  
  
Domain Knowledge (OTA/OTT):
  
  
Strong understanding of OTT (Over-the-Top) streaming workflows, including video playback, buffering, and A/V sync analysis.
  
  
Knowledge of OTA (Over-the-Air) broadcast standards (ATSC, DVB, ISDB) and tuner functionality.
  
  
Networking: Solid knowledge of Router Configuration, Wi-Fi stability (2.4/5GHz),
  
  
Good to have knowledge of DNS and packet analysis using tools like Wireshark.
  
  
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with specific experience interacting with clients or teams located in different geographical time zones.
  
  
Automation: Basic proficiency in Python scripting for automating repetitive tasks.
  
  
Tools: Hands-on experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
  
  
Education: B.E/B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science, or equivalent.

End-to-End Product Validation: Execute functional, regression, and sustaining test cycles on Smart TV and STB platforms to ensure OS stability and compliance with product specifications.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis & Logging: Go beyond standard test execution by capturing logs (Serial/System logs) and performing initial debugging to isolate the root cause of crashes or defects before escalating to development.
  
  
Hybrid Testing (OTA & OTT): Validate both live broadcast features (channel scanning, signal strength, EPG) and streaming application performance (video start time, adaptive bitrate switching) across various network conditions.
  
  
Client Collaboration: Act as the primary technical interface for the client; attend triage meetings with global engineering teams, providing detailed status updates and clarifying technical queries across time zones.
  
  
Defect Reporting: Create comprehensive bug reports including steps to reproduce, system logs, and network captures; verify fixes and manage the defect lifecycle in JIRA.
  
  
Network & Environment Setup: Configure and maintain complex test environments, including specific router settings and network simulations, to replicate customer issues.
  
  
Automation Support: Identify automation opportunities and maintain and execute basic Python scripts to improve testing efficiency.

title: Senior Software Test Engineer
description:
**Introduction:**
Are you searching for an opportunity to play a key role in driving the dramatic growth of a highly successful software company?
  
  
At Poppulo, we’re working on what’s next in communications and workplace technology. As a pioneer in this industry, we understand that meaningfully reaching every employee is hard. And so is managing office space in a hybrid world. And so is improving the customer and guest experience. We exist to make each of these things easier. We exist to bring harmony to our customers.
  
  
And we do that at enterprise scale. Our omnichannel employee communications, customer communications, and workplace experience platform is trusted by over 6,000 organizations today, reaching more than 35M employees and delivering content to 500,000+ digital signs.
  
  
We know there’s no such thing as a “perfect" candidate - we’re all a work in progress and are growing new skills and capabilities all the time. We encourage you to apply for a position with Poppulo even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. We believe in fostering an environment where there is a diversity of perspectives, in hopes that we can all thrive.
  
  
**Job Summary**
You will join a cross-functional team building our Next-Generation of digital signage tooling from a world class CMS that integrates design and event systems, through a multitude of signage presentation platforms, into high volume reporting, and analytics systems.
  
  
We work in an agile, DevOps-oriented environment with an emphasis on quality engineering, sustainable delivery, and continuous improvement. You’ll help ensure our systems are reliable, observable, secure, and capable of handling data at large scale.
  
  
This role will help DS strengthen today’s quality engineering foundation while evolving toward a more automated, telemetry-driven, and AI-enabled delivery model. We do not expect every future capability to exist on day one; we are looking for someone who can improve the current system while helping define and pilot the next generation of quality practices.
  
  
You will collaborate with Product, UX, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver high-quality features in an agile, flow-oriented delivery environment using Jira, GitLab pipelines, and AWS SaaS architecture.
  
  
**The Person**
You are a team player who cares about the customer and business outcomes. You enjoy working closely with teammates to build relationships while finding and fixing important problems. You often experiment with the latest technology and methods to logically and efficiently improve process. You prioritize prevention of risk over late detection of defects, and you are comfortable coaching teammates, improving quality practices, and helping teams build quality into the platform from the start. You are also comfortable operating in a transition state: strong in today’s quality engineering practices, while curious and pragmatic about how AI, automation, and telemetry will change quality over the next several years.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate quality across signage components such as content repository, design, scheduling, integration, deployment, player performance, reporting and analytics.
* Troubleshoot in AWS including CloudWatch, DynamoDB, MySQL, IoT Core, S3, and CloudFront to find problem sources and contribute to resolutions.
* Flag testing, risk, and observability considerations early in design and planning including writing lightweight test strategy and plans.
* Ensure effective automation at the appropriate layers (API/service, data validation, and UI as needed).
* Explore and responsibly introduce AI-assisted quality practices where they create measurable improvements in speed, coverage, reliability, or insight, while preserving human judgment and appropriate review gates.
* Champion a whole-team quality approach.
* Contribute to non-functional testing (performance, scalability, resilience, security).
* Facilitate collaborative quality activities (exploratory testing, risk workshops, bug bashes).
* Help define and mature automated quality gates, regression suites, and evaluation-style checks that can support both today’s delivery process and future AI-assisted development workflows.
* Partner with Product, UX, and Engineering to translate product intent into clear, testable acceptance criteria and risk-based test strategies.
* Use production telemetry, customer workflow data, observability signals, and CI/CD feedback to prioritize testing and identify quality risks earlier.
* Partner with Engineering and Product as we pilot AI-assisted delivery workflows, helping assess where AI can safely support test generation, defect triage, documentation, MR review, and delivery reporting.

**Technical Skills / Experience**

* 7+ years in Software Testing/Quality Engineering.
* Hands-on experience validating complex SaaS platforms, distributed systems, APIs, data workflows, and user-facing product experiences.
* Experience with AWS services (e.g., CloudWatch, DynamoDB, MySQL, IoT Core, S3, and CloudFront).
* Experience with GitLab (or equivalent CI/CD platform) for automated testing and delivery.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and API/service testing.
* Proficient in at least one programming language (preferably in Java and TypeScript).
* Experience building or contributing to automated testing frameworks (API/service and data validation).
* Automation experience with Playwright for API and UI testing; familiarity with Selenium-based frameworks is helpful.
* Experience with load/performance testing.
* Strong grounding in agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience establishing a whole-team quality strategy and coaching teammates.
* Ability to build a strong understanding of customer workflows and use production telemetry to guide testing.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, CodeRabbit, GitLab Duo, or equivalent.
* Ability to review AI-generated tests, code, documentation, or analysis for correctness, maintainability, security, and fit to customer intent.
* Experience collaborating across distributed teams, using clear written context, async-friendly documentation, and structured handoffs to maintain quality across time zones.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with observability tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
* Familiarity with testing containerised workloads (ECS/EKS), serverless patterns, or IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform).
* Experience with analytics and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Looker, or Tableau\*.
* Experience with test data generation techniques and tools, including synthetic data creation, data masking.
* Experience driving quality improvements at a team level.
* Community involvement (Meetups/Conferences, blogs, Open-Source contributions).
* Experience using AI/GenAI tools for synthetic test data generation, test design, log analysis, defect triage, documentation, or automation support.

**Who We Are**
We are a values-driven organisation that encourages our employees to bring their authentic selves to work every day and empowers everyone to make a tangible impact on our products, clients, and culture. We offer a dynamic environment with driven, fun, and flexible individuals who thrive on challenge and responsibility. This is an opportunity to contribute to our culture and join a company that’s on the move.
  
  
We live the Poppulo values each day, as they are key to everything we do.
  
  

* Bring Your Best Self We show up authentically, are self-aware and always strive to be better.
* See it. Own it. Solve it. We proactively innovate and solve for our customers and each other. We set an example with high standards for our work. We foster a culture of learning, acknowledging our successes and our failures.
* Together We’re Better We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respecting their expertise, and focus on building trust. That's what makes us a team.

Named a Great Place to Work in 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, we are a fast-growing global technology company, with offices in Ireland, the US, and the UK.
  
  
Poppulo is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
*We are committed to protecting your privacy. For details on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Policy.*

title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
DESCRIPTION:
  
  
Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll help develop and test software for scientific instruments and laboratory solutions. As a Software Test Engineer III, you'll ensure the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive testing strategies. Working in an adaptable environment, you'll collaborate with teams to validate software for mass spectrometers, electron microscopes, and other analytical instruments that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
  
  
You'll participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through final release. Your role includes designing and executing test plans, automating test procedures, documenting defects, and verifying resolutions. You'll work closely with developers, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure our software meets the highest quality standards while supporting continuous improvement in our testing processes.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a highly experienced
**Lead Quality Assurance Engineer**
with 6–15 years of software testing and quality assurance experience, with strong expertise in
**functional testing, regression testing, test case design, defect management, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support**
. The role also requires strong hands-on test automation expertise, including Squish GUI Tester for desktop GUI automation and Playwright with Python/Pytest for web, end-to-end, and regression automation.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have extensive experience validating complex enterprise applications, defining comprehensive test strategies, managing test execution, and ensuring high-quality product releases. The candidate will work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, UX teams, and other stakeholders to ensure that software solutions meet functional, business, and quality requirements. The candidate should be able to define and evolve maintainable automation frameworks, select appropriate automation coverage, and integrate automated regression suites into CI/CD workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute functional testing activities for complex software applications and business workflows.
* Define test approaches, test scenarios, and detailed test cases based on functional and business requirements.
* Perform comprehensive regression testing to ensure that application changes do not impact existing functionality.
* Review requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and design specifications to identify test scenarios and potential gaps.
* Develop and maintain reusable manual and automated test cases, test suites, test data, and traceability between requirements and tests.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated GUI tests using Squish GUI Tester for desktop applications, including robust object identification, synchronization, reusable components, and data-driven execution.
* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end browser automation using Playwright with Python and Pytest for web application workflows.
* Build and evolve maintainable Pytest-based automation frameworks using fixtures, parametrization, markers, reusable utilities, page-object/component patterns, and clear test reporting.
* Integrate automated regression suites into CI/CD pipelines, support headless and parallel execution where appropriate, and analyze failures, flaky tests, and environment-related issues.
* Execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and document test evidence and failures appropriately.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
* Perform detailed defect analysis and work closely with development teams to facilitate timely resolution.
* Conduct defect triage meetings and support prioritization based on severity, business impact, and release requirements.
* Verify defect fixes and perform appropriate regression testing before closure.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, coordinating testing activities, and assisting business users.
* Analyze UAT findings and coordinate with product and development teams for issue resolution.
* Validate end-to-end workflows and integrations across multiple application components and systems.
* Participate in release planning and provide recommendations regarding application quality and release readiness.
* Monitor testing progress, defect trends, coverage, and overall quality metrics.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor QA team members and promote consistent testing standards and quality practices.

**Required Skills**

* 12–15 years of overall experience in software testing and quality assurance.
* Strong hands-on experience in functional testing of enterprise software applications.
* Extensive experience in regression testing and end-to-end system validation.
* Strong hands-on experience with Squish GUI Tester for desktop GUI automation, including object recognition, synchronization, reusable scripts/components, and maintenance of stable regression suites.
* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for browser-based UI and end-to-end test automation, preferably using Python.
* Strong hands-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, markers, test organization, reusable utilities, and test reporting.
* Strong Python scripting skills for test automation, framework development, troubleshooting, and test-data utilities.
* Experience designing and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks with reusable abstractions, page-object/component patterns, configuration management, logging, and reporting.
* Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines and version-control workflows, with the ability to diagnose automation, application, data, and environment failures.
* Strong expertise in designing effective test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
* Ability to analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria from a testing perspective.
* Strong experience with defect identification, reporting, prioritization, tracking, and closure.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, ALM, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience supporting and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Experience validating complex business workflows and application integrations.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and distinguish application defects from configuration, data, environment, and integration issues.
* Strong understanding of test coverage, requirements traceability, and risk-based testing.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Ability to communicate testing status, quality risks, and release concerns clearly to stakeholders.

**Testing & Quality Leadership Expectations**
The candidate should be capable of operating beyond an individual contributor role and should:
  
  

* Provide testing and quality leadership for complex software products and projects.
* Define appropriate test strategies, test approaches, and quality standards.
* Define the test automation strategy across desktop and web applications, including automation scope, framework standards, maintainability, execution model, and CI/CD integration.
* Review automation architecture, test code, and framework changes; mentor engineers on Squish, Playwright, Pytest, Python, and automation engineering best practices.
* Identify testing risks early and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Review and improve test scenarios and test cases developed by team members.
* Ensure adequate functional, automated, and regression coverage for product releases.
* Establish effective defect-management and defect-triage practices.
* Coordinate testing activities across development, product, business, and other QA teams.
* Provide clear quality assessments and recommendations for release readiness.
* Mentor QA engineers and promote testing best practices across the team.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, documentation, metrics, and overall product quality.
* Work effectively with globally distributed and cross-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing large-scale enterprise, scientific, healthcare, engineering, or data-intensive applications.
* Experience testing complex web and desktop applications.
* Experience validating REST APIs and backend integrations.
* Familiarity with database validation and basic SQL queries.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent solutions.
* Experience with API automation, automation reporting, test-result dashboards, parallel execution, and strategies for reducing flaky tests.
* Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing practices for executing Squish and Playwright/Pytest regression suites.
* Experience testing applications involving complex workflows, dashboards, configuration, or data visualization.
* Understanding of usability, accessibility, performance, and security testing concepts.
* Experience with requirements and test traceability in regulated or quality-driven environments.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed development and business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate them into effective test scenarios.
* Ability to identify risks and communicate quality concerns effectively.
* Strong ownership and accountability for testing deliverables.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, business analysts, product owners, and end users.
* Strong mentoring and team-coordination capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and testing activities across releases.
* Strong customer-focused and quality-oriented mindset.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
**Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**
.

title: Member of Technical Staff- Quality Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
We are hiring a
**senior quality engineer**
to own
**System Testing**
for Pure’s FlashArray products. You will validate
**stability, resiliency, and performance under sustained, production‑like workloads**
, far beyond basic functional testing.
  
  
You will design and run
**multi‑week, customer‑like scenarios**
that combine workloads, failovers, upgrades, and fault injections, and use the insights to influence architecture, design, and release decisions.
  
  
This is a
**hands‑on, high‑impact role**
at the intersection of architecture, systems, and large‑scale testing—acting as a key quality gate before releases reach Pure’s customers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own System Testing strategy for releases Define System Testing strategy and test plans for major features and releases, focusing on stability, longevity, and end‑to‑end behavior, not just feature correctness.
* Design realistic, high‑value scenarios Build scenarios that mirror Pure customer environments: mixed workloads (block, file, object), long‑running IO, failovers, NDUs, hardware events, and background operations (replication, snapshots, quotas, etc.), combining automation with targeted “tortures”.
* Drive execution and triage on System Testing beds Own System Testing environments (arrays, initiators, OSes, accessories); keep them healthy, representative, and well‑instrumented. Monitor runs, triage failures quickly, separate infra issues from product bugs, and file high‑quality defects with clear workload, scale, logs, and impact—driving them to closure with Dev, PM, and Release teams.
* Be a key voice in release readiness Act as a primary quality gate for Release Candidates: define System Testing entry/exit criteria, sign‑off requirements, and soak expectations (for example, 24–48h+ without critical events). Summarize findings, risks, and recommendations and provide data‑driven input on go/no‑go decisions.
* Lead technically and mentor others Coach mid‑level and junior QE engineers (System Testing and system test) on test design, debugging, triage, and long‑running validation best practices. Refine System Testing processes, playbooks, and governance in partnership with engineering managers and technical leaders.
* Advance automation, tooling, and observability Partner with automation teams to extend System Testing workflows (workload drivers, torture suites, health checks, dashboards). Improve observability for System Testing: metrics, alerting, and automated log/triage helpers that make issues obvious and actionable.

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years in software QA / system test / performance / reliability engineering, with significant experience in system‑level or longevity testing of complex distributed or storage systems.
* Strong understanding of storage concepts (block, file, snapshots, replication, HA/failover, NDUs) and their behavior under sustained load and fault conditions.
* Proven ability to design and execute long‑running scenarios that surface race conditions, memory leaks, scaling issues, and resiliency gaps.
* Strong debugging skills across host, network, storage system, logs, and metrics.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux and at least one of VMware, Windows, or Kubernetes.
* Solid experience with test automation (Python, shell), CI pipelines, and result dashboards.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional collaboration with Development, System Test, Release, and Support.
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting complex findings and risk assessments to senior engineers and leaders.
* Directory services and identity:AD, LDAP, Kerberos, ID mapping — and how per-tenant auth domains explode the test matrix.
* Linux systems skills:shell, networking (VLANs, sub-interfaces, routing,ip,tc), service debugging, log and core analysis at scale

**Nice‑to‑have**

* Background in enterprise storage.
* Experience with performance engineering, capacity / longevity modeling, or customer‑data‑driven test design.
* Exposure to AI‑assisted test design or triage and interest in using new tools to improve coverage and efficiency.
* Experience working with different hypervisors, backup applications, databases, video streaming or healthcare applications/workloads is a plus
* Prior multi-tenancy / RBAC / virtual-array isolation work in storage or cloud.

title: Associate Test Architect
description:
**About Edstruments**

Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.

**Location:**

Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

**Who This Role Is For:**

This role may be a strong fit if you:

* Have worked in QA, QA Automation, or Quality Engineering and have taken ownership of testing processes beyond day-to-day execution.
* Have contributed to designing automation frameworks, testing strategies, release processes, or quality standards within your team.
* Have served as a primary QA resource for a product, project, or engineering team.
* Enjoy identifying gaps in quality processes and proposing scalable solutions.
* Are interested in growing into a long-term quality leadership or architecture path.

**Please note:**
We are open to candidates who have demonstrated ownership of testing strategy, automation design, or quality initiatives, even if they have not previously held a formal Test Architect title.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Test Architect who can help define and scale quality practices across our platform. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and execution.

The ideal candidate has experience contributing to or owning testing processes, automation frameworks, quality initiatives, or release practices within a product team. While prior architect or leadership titles are not required, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of quality strategy and help establish scalable QA practices as we continue to grow.

You will work with backend systems built on Java and MySQL, frontend applications built using React.js, and an existing QA automation setup using Playwright.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 1–3 years of experience in Software Testing, QA Automation, or Quality Engineering.
* Experience contributing to or owning testing processes, automation frameworks, quality initiatives, or QA best practices within a product team.
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright or Selenium.
* Solid understanding of Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django), or similar application architectures.
* Experience testing REST APIs, databases (MySQL), and web applications.
* Experience testing React.js or other modern frontend applications.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently drive quality improvements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 1-2 years of experience in software testing and quality engineering
* Strong experience in test architecture and automation strategy
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium
* Solid understanding of Java (Springboot), Python (Django) system architecture
* Experience testing REST APIs, databases (MySQL), and distributed systems.
* Strong experience testing React.js or modern frontend applications
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies
* Ability to influence quality across teams without direct authority

**Good to Have**

* Experience with performance testing or security testing
* Experience building or scaling QA teams
* Exposure to cloud environments (GCP)
* Experience defining quality metrics and dashboards

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you will:

* Help establish scalable QA processes as the company grows.
* Improve the reliability and coverage of our automated testing.
* Identify quality risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Build confidence in releases through strong testing practices and automation.
* Partner closely with engineering and product teams to make quality a shared responsibility.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Someone who thinks beyond test cases and takes ownership of product quality.
* A hands-on builder who enjoys improving systems, processes, and automation.
* Comfortable balancing strategy and execution in a small, fast-moving team.
* Able to influence quality through collaboration rather than formal authority.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to grow into broader quality ownership over time.

title: Principal Software Quality Engineer — Distributed Database
description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Principal Software Quality Engineer to own the quality bar for a distributed database product (NoSQL preferred). This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who lives inside the system under test — reads the server code, reproduces bugs down to the offending function, designs fault-injection to exercise the paths that positive tests can’t reach, and drives fixes across QE, client, and server teams.
  
  
You will also lead how AI agents show up inside our testing frameworks: agents that generate and maintain tests, triage failures against logs, traces, metrics, and database state, and are themselves evaluated for reliability.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the quality strategy for a distributed database platform: test architecture, coverage model, release gates, and risk-based prioritization across server, client SDKs, operator/backup tooling, and management surfaces.
* Design and drive deep protocol- and storage-level testing: replication and rebalancing, partitioning/sharding, consistency (strong, eventual, tunable), transactions and isolation, secondary indexes, query planning, compaction, backup and restore, snapshots, warm/cold restart, and cross-datacenter replication.
* Prove correctness of the cluster under stress: node failures, network partitions, clock skew, disk-full and slow-disk conditions, rolling and mixed-version upgrades, and long-running soak.
* Use fault injection — process crashes, gdb-driven state manipulation, packet drops, latency injection, corrupted wire data, oversized/boundary inputs, and forced version skew between master and replicas — to reach code paths positive tests can’t.
* Perform root-cause investigations that reach into the source: identify off-by-one errors, out-of-bounds reads, encoder/decoder mismatches, compression/CRC issues, and consistency violations; hand dev a minimal repro plus the suspect function and file crisp tickets that drive quick fixes.
* Build and evolve high-leverage test frameworks (Python-based pytest / harness code, plus API and end-to-end suites) that run reliably on a shared test farm and in CI (GitHub Actions,Jenkins, or equivalent).
* Lead AI-agent testing: design agent loops that plan tests, call tools, inspect logs/traces/metrics/DB state, and produce actionable defects; build evaluation harnesses (golden sets, graders, regression suites) so agent output is trusted, not guessed. Integrate AI agents into existing frameworks (pytest, custom harnesses, MCP-style tool servers) so they can generate negative and corner-case scenarios, maintain flaky tests, and triage failures with a human in the loop where it matters.
* Represent quality in feature reviews (PRDs, design docs, client specs): author test plans, drive dev sessions on new features, and land testability requirements before code is written. Turn production and pre-release incidents into durable tests, regressions, and monitors; keep flake and noise on the test farm low.
* Mentor senior QEs and SDETs on debugging, test design, and framework code; raise the org-wide quality bar without needing a management chain.

**Required**
****What you bring****

* 10 - 18 years in software quality / SDET / systems engineering with a quality-systems focus; demonstrated Principal or Staff-level impact.
* Deep, hands-on testing of a distributed database or storage system — NoSQL preferred (e.g. Aerospike, Cassandra, ScyllaDB, MongoDB, Couchbase, Redis, DynamoDB, HBase) — or a relational distributed store (CockroachDB, TiDB, YugabyteDB, Spanner-style). You have tested replication, partitioning/sharding, consistency, transactions, secondary indexes, backup/restore, and cross-datacenter replication — not just applications on top of a database.
* Solid grounding in distributed-systems fundamentals: replication protocols, consensus, quorum reads/writes, eventual vs strong consistency, split-brain, clock skew, and failure/recovery semantics.
* Ability to read server code (C, C++, Go, Rust, or Java) well enough to localize a bug to a function and explain root cause to dev, including protocol/serialization edge cases (wire formats, msgpack/protobuf/Thrift, compression codecs).
* Strong software engineering skills in Python (primary) and comfort in at least one systems language; you treat test infrastructure as a product, not a script pile.
* Practical fault-injection experience: gdb, chaos-style tooling, kill/quiesce, network partitions, latency/packet-loss injection, disk faults, corrupted inputs, forced version skew, and boundary/oversized data.
* Multi-layer testing fluency: unit, integration, API, contract, end-to-end, performance/scale, upgrade/downgrade, and long-running soak/regression.
* Proven experience running debug threads across QE, client, and server teams: you write the analysis, propose the fix location, and follow up until master/dev/stage branches carry the patch.
* Solid CI/CD background (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent), and comfort operating a shared test farm: registering suites, triaging noisy failures, and driving flake down. Practical AI-agent-for-testing experience: agent loops, tool use, prompt/eval design, and using agents against real test frameworks. You can tell an agent doing useful work from one producing plausible-looking noise.
* Excellent written communication: your Slack threads, tickets, and RFCs are the kind other engineers save and quote.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience testing client SDKs in multiple languages (Python, Java, Go, C, Node.js, .NET) against the same server, including compatibility matrices, upgrade/downgrade, and behavioral parity.
* Backup/restore, checkpointing, snapshotting, or WAL/journal correctness testing, including performance at TB-scale.
* Query-engine or secondary-index testing: query planning, index selection, pagination, boundary values, and encoding/collation correctness.
* Kubernetes / operator testing (KUTTL, Chainsaw, envtest) for database operators. Cloud infrastructure fluency for large-scale test environments (AWS/GCP/Azure, TLS/mTLS, IAM, secrets, air-gapped installs).
* Security-adjacent testing: fuzzing, CVE reproduction, memory-safety issues (OOB reads, use-after-free) in native code.

**How We Will Measure Success**

* Critical database paths — replication, rebalancing, consistency, transactions, secondary indexes, backup/restore, and cross-datacenter replication — have high-signal, low-flake coverage; regressions are caught before release, not after.
* Bugs you file consistently include a minimal repro and a suspect location; dev fix cycles get shorter on the surfaces you own.
* AI agents are in daily use inside the framework: writing tests, triaging failures, and evaluated against golden sets so their output is trusted.
* Test-farm flake drops; upgrade/downgrade coverage grows; new features ship with test plans authored before code is complete.
* Engineers across QE, client, and server adopt the patterns, frameworks, and quality bar you introduce.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not manual QA, and it is not a people-manager role unless you later choose that path. Expect to write framework code, attach a debugger to a server, read a compression codec, evaluate an agent run, and leave behind systems other engineers can operate.

Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.
  
  
Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.
  
  
At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to
****unleash the power of the world’s real-time data****
with a database built for
****infinite scale, speed, and sustainability****
.
  
  
If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

It would involve driving quality and operational excellence across the domain of Catalog management, content operations, and data quality at scale. As the Quality Analyst for the Content Acquisition Team, you would be responsible for defining and executing quality governance frameworks, statistical sampling strategies, and process improvement roadmaps to drive measurable improvements in catalog quality, defect reduction, and operational efficiency.

Quality Assurance & Governance, Statistical Quality & Sampling (Z-based sampling, confidence intervals, margin of error), Root Cause Analysis (RCA/CAPA), Process Improvement (VSM/FMEA), Quality Analytics (DPMO, Sigma levels), Data Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Problem Solving, Communication & Reporting

**The Opportunity**
As a QE – AI Test Lead, you will be responsible for validating AI models and systems including Narrow AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. The role involves performing data validation, model evaluation, and statistical analysis while collaborating closely with data scientists to ensure comprehensive testing coverage.
  
  
You will also identify anomalies in data and outputs, assess model bias, and ensure that privacy and compliance protocols are strictly adhered to during testing activities.

* Define and own test strategy, planning, execution, and reporting for AI-based systems

* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and risks in model outputs and ensure timely resolution with development teams
* Lead defect management and collaborate with cross-functional teams for resolution
* Engage with client stakeholders to provide status updates and resolve issues

* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLMs, and Agentic AI systems
* Hands-on experience in AI testing techniques such as bias testing, drift testing, metamorphic testing, and back-to-back testing
* Expertise in test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, PyTest)
* Proficiency in Python programming and AI evaluation frameworks
* Exposure to GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools
* Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Experience working in Agile environments

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**What You Will Be Doing:**
  

  
* Own and lead quality efforts for significant product areas or cross-team initiatives, defining and driving execution of comprehensive test strategies (functional, integration, performance, and system testing).
  
* Support developers in large initiatives to "shift quality left"—ensuring they can run acceptance tests locally and sharing techniques to improve how developers test and validate their own changes.
  
* Develop, execute, and maintain complex automated test scripts (using Python, Pytest, TypeScript, etc.) alongside the development team to enforce collective ownership of quality.
  
* Participate actively in Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and drive toward comprehensive solutions to prevent repeat incidents.
  
* Plan and complete the Readiness Review testing sections for tasked initiatives, managing end-to-end acceptance and exploratory testing at the epic level.
  
* Conduct complex debugging, including staging/production issue reproduction and root cause analysis, helping to troubleshoot issues even outside of your immediate team.
  
* Partner with the Pillar Lead and Protectobot to identify and address technical gaps in test coverage, unblock framework issues, and implement AI-assisted testing efficiencies.
  
* Mentor and coach QE 1s, QE 2s, and QE 3s, guiding them on advanced testing techniques, and act as a technical interviewer during hiring processes.
  
* Evaluate risk vs. schedule, balancing comprehensive testing with rapid delivery timelines to optimize engineering velocity.
  
* Collaborate with architects and development leads to ensure overall system testability and robustness.
  
  

  
**You have:**
  

  
* 6-8 years of experience in test planning, automation framework utilization, and Agile collaboration, with a reputation for tackling hard problems.
  
* Advanced proficiency in automation tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, Pytest, Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript).
  
* Deep experience with diverse testing methodologies, including performance, security, integration, and exploratory testing.
  
* Proven ability to design and implement scalable, maintainable test automation solutions.
  
* In-depth knowledge of CI/CD, deployment pipelines, and troubleshooting tools to support efficient release cycles.
  
* Strong ability to identify when and how to escalate issues to ensure swift resolution.
  
* Experience enabling development teams to manage their own testing and fostering a culture of collective quality ownership.
  
* A collaborative, team-oriented mindset, displaying ownership of quality for epics and proactively identifying problems early.
  
* Strong communication skills, thinking globally about customer needs and collaborating effectively across teams and hemispheres.
  
* Proven ability to define and execute strategies for augmenting test coverage, strategically layering Unit Tests, Functional Tests, and Acceptance Tests across the full test automation pyramid.
  
  

  
**Bonus Points If You Have:**
  

  
* Practical experience leveraging Generative AI or LLMs in the software testing lifecycle to improve test efficiency.
  
* Deep domain expertise in areas relevant to our pillars (e.g., Identity/Directory protocols, Authentication flows, MDM/Device Management, or Cloud Platforms).
  
* Experience with API and web app UI test automation tools like Gherkin, Cypress, or similar.
  
* Deep expertise in designing and implementing Go-based Unit Tests (UT) and leveraging functional testing (FT) frameworks to ensure robust component and service reliability.
  
* Experience deploying, installing, and configuring applications on cloud-based servers (AWS experience is a plus).
  
* Prior experience in dynamic, fast-paced startup environments.

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

 

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  

 

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 

  

 

  

#BI-Remote

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually — turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us.
  
  
The QA Automation Engineer will be responsible for assuring the quality of our products, creating automated tests, and managing builds and continuous integration. You will automate tests for microservices and their related front ends, and manage infrastructure across development and production cloud environments.
  
  
This role goes beyond conventional application testing. Our platform combines graph data stores, graph analytics, machine learning models, and agentic AI workflows — systems whose outputs are probabilistic, whose correctness is contextual, and whose decisions carry regulatory weight. You will help define what “passing” means for components that don’t return the same answer twice, and build the harnesses that hold them to it.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Core Test Automation**

* Build and maintain end-to-end and component test suites using modern browser automation with auto-waiting, trace-based debugging, and parallel execution as the default
* Shape coverage around the test pyramid rather than the UI — API and contract tests as the primary safety net, with UI reserved for genuine user journeys
* Embed quality gates directly in CI/CD pipelines — sharded parallel runs, risk-based test selection, and pass/fail criteria that block promotion without manual sign-off
* Provision ephemeral, containerised test environments on demand through infrastructure-as-code, with synthetic and masked test data generated per run instead of maintained by hand
* Treat test reliability as a product: track flake rates, quarantine and fix unstable tests, and hold suites to explicit stability and runtime SLAs
* Use AI-assisted tooling for test authoring, coverage gap analysis, and locator resilience — while owning the judgement call on what the generated tests are actually worth
* Work shift-left alongside engineers — contributing test coverage with the feature, not after it — and partner on triage to drive issues to root cause

**Graph Data and Analytics**

* Design and automate validation for graph database layers — schema integrity, relationship correctness, and query behaviour across Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL
* Build regression coverage for graph analytics outputs: pathfinding, centrality, community detection, and link analysis used in fraud-ring identification and network risk scoring
* Validate graph ingestion and transformation pipelines for data completeness, deduplication, and referential accuracy at scale

**AI/ML and Agentic Systems**

* Develop evaluation harnesses for ML model behaviour — accuracy thresholds, drift detection, bias and fairness checks, and explainability outputs required for regulatory review
* Build automated test suites for agentic workflows: tool-calling correctness, multi-step orchestration, context handling, failure recovery, and guardrail enforcement
* Design assertion strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including golden-set comparison, semantic similarity scoring, and LLM-as-judge evaluation
* Establish prompt and model regression testing so behavioural changes are caught before release
* Validate feature pipelines and training/serving consistency in partnership with data science teams

**Process and Platform**

* Incorporate best practices into dev/test/deploy processes and recommend improvements
* Support application onboarding to the defined target operating model to achieve build and release automation
* Document, track, and escalate issues as appropriate

**What’s Required**
**Education:**
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
  
**Experience**
Proven track record of hands-on experience in automated testing of web applications and services, including designing, developing, and executing automated tests in Python using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent).
  
  
**Qualifications, Strengths And Skills**

* Demonstrated understanding of maintainable test architecture — Page Object Model or equivalent patterns — for end-to-end testing
* Extensive hands-on experience on Python scripting
* Experience testing web services and REST APIs (Postman, Swagger)
* Working knowledge of graph databases — Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, JanusGraph or similar — including writing and validating graph queries
* Exposure to testing AI/ML-backed features, and a clear grasp of why probabilistic systems need different assertions than deterministic ones
* Scripting experience beyond Python: Unix shell, Ruby, or similar
* Continuous integration and pipeline-based delivery (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
* Experience with SQL
* Experience recommending process improvements

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable orchestration tooling
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation tooling and practices: golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, hallucination and jailbreak testing, red-teaming
* Graph analytics libraries such as Neo4j GDS, Apache Spark GraphX, or NetworkX
* Observability-driven testing — synthetic monitoring, canary analysis, and validation through traces, logs and metrics
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible; microservices, container deployment and service orchestration
* Cloud APIs (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* JIRA for issue tracking and escalation

Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave.
  
  
*At Provenir, we recognize that diversity and inclusion make our teams stronger. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, citizenship, or veteran status or medical condition. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.*
