title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc.). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way. More info at: Our website: https://www.getphyllo.com/
  
  
**About The Role**
AI coding tools now let our engineers ship more code, faster. Your job is to make sure we can prove it works just as fast. As Lead QA Engineer, you will own test automation for Phyllo’s APIs, SDKs and web apps, and lead a small team of QA engineers.
  
  
This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what “working” means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Expected To Do**
**Build and own test automation (UI and API)**

* Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing.
* Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs.
* Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy.
* Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code.
* Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits.
* Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on.

**Lead and grow the QA team**

* Lead and mentor a small team of junior QA engineers: set priorities, assign work, review their test code, and run regular 1:1s and feedback.
* Help your team move from manual testing to automation through pairing, code reviews and clear learning goals.
* Define QA standards: coding conventions for tests, review checklists, defect triage and release sign-off.
* Own release readiness and make the go/no-go call together with engineering leads.
* Take part in hiring and onboarding new QA engineers.

**Work closely with product and engineering**

* Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts.
* Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality.
* Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports.
* Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership.

**You’ll Be a Good Fit If You**

* Have 5+ years in quality engineering, including at least 3 years building test automation (not only running manual tests).
* Have led or mentored QA engineers: assigning work, reviewing code and coaching people to grow.
* Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java.
* Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e.g. Playwright, REST Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI.
* Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium.
* Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews.
* Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason.
* Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL.
* Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers.
* Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience.

**Good To Have (not Required)**

* AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
* AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic).
* Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA.tech.
* Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs).
* Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring.
* Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS.
* Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG.
* API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing.
* Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray.
* Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar).

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance.
* Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive.
* Innovate and Evolve: We’re building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact and less by title.

What's in it for you?
  
  
We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product.
  
  
Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.

title: L2/L3 Protocol Test Engineer
description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Family Definition:**
 Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet\-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions include applying intermediate level of subject matter expertise to solve common technical problems. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and recommendations for appropriate action. Works independently within an established framework and with moderate supervision.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop, execute and automate comprehensive feature test plans for Layer 2/Layer 3 networking protocols (e.g. STP, RSTP, MSTP, VRRP, MC\-LAG, LACP, L2PT, LLDP, VPLS, EVPN, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, and MACSEC), based on detailed feature requirements.
* Design and improve test automation frameworks by creating new automation libraries and implementing complex automation algorithms to enhance test efficiency and coverage.
* Utilise strong analytical skills to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues discovered during testing, ensuring timely identification of root causes.
* Implement and execute test cases, including developing automated test scripts (using Python PyTest and Robot Framework) to streamline repetitive testing tasks.
* Use networking test equipment (e.g. Spirent, Ixia) to generate traffic and validate performance, including automating these tools for comprehensive test coverage.
* Report on testing progress and outcomes through clear documentation and regular status updates.
* Handle critical customer queries and escalations, working quickly to reproduce issues and assist in resolving them to maintain customer satisfaction.


**What You Need To Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* Typically 1\-3 years experience.
* In\-depth knowledge of switches, routers, and IP networking fundamentals.
* Specialisation in one or more of the following areas:
+ Layer 2: Mastery of service provider, data centre, and switching technologies – including STP/RSTP/MSTP, VRRP, MCLAG, LACP, L2PT, LLDP, VPLS, and MACSEC.
+ Layer 3: Expertise in routing protocols and MPLS – including OSPF, ISIS, BGP, and MPLS.
+ Quality of Service \& Security: In\-depth understanding of Class of Service (CoS) mechanisms and firewall/ACL configurations.
+ Hardware \& Multicast: Familiarity with Broadcom Packet Forwarding Engine (PFE) architecture and multicast networking (including multicast snooping).
+ Virtual Networking: Hands\-on experience with EVPN technologies (EVPN\-MPLS and EVPN\-VXLAN) and VPLS services.
+ Test tools: Experience with networking test equipment (Spirent, Ixia) and the ability to automate testing using these tools.

title: Software Development Engineer - Test
description:
At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) – The AI Factory Platform Company – we’re building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide.
   

  

 Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R\&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.
   

  

 Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end\-to\-end services, and industry\-leading partner solutions in a full\-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.
   

  

 At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Penguin Computing is seeking an experienced
 **AI QA / SDET Engineer** 
 to join our Software Engineering team. Penguin Computing’s Scyld Software products are used to deploy, provision, manage, and monitor some of the largest computational systems in the world. As we expand these platforms with
 **AI/LLM\-powered and agentic capabilities** 
 , this role will drive quality engineering across both our core infrastructure software and emerging AI solutions.
   

  

 You will join our agile Software team and collaborate closely with Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Owners, Product Managers, and other teams across the organization to ensure our software meets the highest standards of
 **quality, reliability, performance, and security** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in software testing and automation with hands\-on knowledge of
 **LLM evaluation, AI agent testing, AI security testing, and modern AI quality methodologies** 
 . You will help define testing strategies, build scalable automation and AI evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve our testing processes and tools.
   

  

 This role requires strong technical problem\-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work with a high degree of independence. You will have the opportunity to shape our evolving
 **AI quality engineering practice** 
 and ensure that both traditional software and AI\-powered capabilities are reliable, secure, measurable, and production\-ready.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and execute end\-to\-end QA strategy for software, AI/LLM features, and AI agents.
* Design and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering API, UI, integration, regression, performance, and infrastructure testing.
* Build LLM/AI evaluation frameworks and automated evaluation pipelines integrated with CI/CD.
* Define evaluation datasets, test scenarios, golden datasets, and quality benchmarks for AI features.
* Evaluate LLM outputs for correctness, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, consistency, and task completion .
* Implement automated evaluation methodologies including LLM\-as\-a\-Judge , deterministic checks, model\-based grading, and human evaluation.
* Test AI agents and agentic workflows including reasoning, tool/function calling, multi\-step execution, state management, error handling, and recovery.
* Validate RAG pipelines , including retrieval quality, context relevance, grounding, citation accuracy, and response quality.
* Perform adversarial and security testing of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, unsafe tool execution, excessive agency, and access\-control violations .
* Apply AI security methodologies such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and use appropriate AI red\-teaming/security testing tools.
* Build automated regression suites to identify behavioral and quality degradation across prompt, model, agent, and application changes .
* Define AI quality metrics, dashboards, release gates, and acceptance criteria.
* Test AI systems across different models and configurations to validate reliability and model\-independent behavior.
* Replicate customer environments through simulated data and usage patterns for realistic end\-to\-end testing.
* Partner with Software Engineering, AI Engineering, Product, and Architecture teams to embed quality engineering early in the SDLC .
* Troubleshoot complex issues across Linux, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and AI application layers.


**AI QA Methodologies \& Tools**
 Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
   

  

* LLM Evaluation: LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, golden datasets, pairwise evaluation, rubric\-based scoring, human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation
* Evaluation Frameworks: DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals or equivalent
* Agent Testing: tool/function\-call validation, trajectory evaluation, task\-completion testing, multi\-agent workflow testing
* RAG Evaluation: retrieval precision/recall, context relevance, faithfulness/groundedness, answer correctness
* AI Security: prompt injection, jailbreak testing, data\-exfiltration testing, privilege/access\-control testing, adversarial testing
* Security Frameworks/Tools: OWASP LLM guidance, Garak, PyRIT, Promptfoo or equivalent AI red\-teaming tools
* Observability: tracing and evaluation of prompts, model responses, tool calls, agent decisions, latency, token usage, and failures


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 6\-8 years of experience in QA, SDET, software engineering, or test automation.
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test architecture, and software development lifecycle.
* Strong coding/scripting skills in Python ; Bash, JavaScript, or C experience is beneficial.
* Experience building automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines .
* Strong Linux command\-line, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with API, functional, integration, regression, performance, and security testing.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization .
* Hands\-on exposure to LLMs, Generative AI applications, RAG, AI agents or Agentic AI Platforms .
* Understanding of LLM\-specific failure modes including hallucination, non\-determinism, prompt injection, and unsafe agent behavior.
* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, or similar testing frameworks.
* Knowledge of HPC/AI infrastructure, networking, GPUs, or distributed systems is a plus.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Build a modern quality engineering practice where
 **traditional software testing and AI evaluation come together** 
**,** 
 enabling us to ship infrastructure software and AI agents that are
 **reliable, measurable, secure, and safe to operate in production** 
**.**
**Location**
 Bangalore

Role: Electrical Quality Engineer

 Educational Qualification: BE/BTech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering
   

  

 Work Experience: 3\-5 years of experience in Design QA, Electrical QA, Testing, or Validation roles.
   

  

**Role Description**
 As a key member of Pixxel’s Quality Assurance team, the Quality Engineer is responsible for
   

  

 ensuring that processes, systems, and components meet rigorous quality standards across the
   

  

 satellite lifecycle. The role focuses on embedding reliability, compliance, and quality discipline into
   

  

 design, manufacturing, integration, and testing activities.
   

  

 The candidate will drive product quality throughout development, including supplier management,
   

  

 manufacturing oversight, integration, testing, and flight hardware acceptance. This position
   

  

 requires close collaboration with design, manufacturing, AIT, supply chain, and program teams to
   

  

 ensure quality requirements are met and space hardware is delivered successfully.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Duties**
* Plan and execute quality assurance of incoming materials and in\-process inspections


 during satellite Assembly, Integration \& Testing (AIT).
   

  

* Review and approve manufacturing, inspection, integration, test documentation, and


 traceability documentation.
   

  

* Ensure compliance with project, customer, and industry quality requirements.
* Participate in subsystem and spacecraft\-level integration and test campaigns.
* Lead nonconformance investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions


 (CAPA). Perform RCA for hardware failures and quality issues.
   

  

* Support FMEA/FMECA, reliability assessments, and risk management activities.
* Review qualification, acceptance, and environmental test results.
* Ensure proper configuration control and product traceability throughout the hardware
* lifecycle.
* Support customer audits, internal audits, and quality reviews.
* Work closely with engineering teams to improve product reliability and manufacturability.


**Desirable Skills \& Certifications**
* Experience working on satellite or space hardware programs.
* Hands\-on exposure to AOCS hardware such as Reaction Wheels, Magnetorquers, Star Trackers, Sun Sensors, IMUs, or GNSS receivers.
* Experience with environmental testing including vibration, thermal vacuum (TVAC), shock, and EMI/EMC testing.
* Awareness on supplier and vendor quality activities, including audits, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Knowledge of EEE components, derating, reliability, and space qualification processes.
* Experience participating in design reviews and hardware acceptance reviews.


**Candidate Acumen**
 Strong understanding of electrical quality assurance processes, including inspection, testing, root cause analysis, and adherence to quality standards across electronic and electrical assemblies. Demonstrates a structured approach to problem\-solving, cross\-functional collaboration, and continuous process improvement in manufacturing or aerospace hardware environments.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Health insurance coverage
   

  

 Unlimited leaves \& flexible working hours
   

  

 Role\-based remote work and work\-from\-home benefit
   

  

 Relocation assistance
   

  

 Professional Mental Wellness services
   

  

 Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)
   

  

 Employee Stock Options for all hires
   

  

**About Pixxel**
 Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5\-meter resolution and 135\+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
   

  

 Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18\-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full\-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI\-powered analytics.
   

  

 Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in\-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high\-frequency imagery with AI\-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in\-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
   

  

 Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission\-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long\-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space\-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
   

  

 Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.
   

  

 For more information, see ourCareers page or follow Pixxel onLinkedIn andX/Twitter.
   

  

 Culture
   

  

 Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world\-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.
   

  

 Central to our employee\-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well\-being and growth in all aspects of life

 **IP\- and subsystem\-level verification \& validation**

 blocks within complex SoCs.
   

  

 You will work across

 , MMU/SMMU translation flows, and the surrounding SoC infrastructure—

* Develop test build reusable verification components for SMMU, including page table generators, translation fault injectors, and traffic generators.
* Validate system interactions: SMMU with ARM cores, MMU/TLB, NoC/Interconnect, coherency (ACE/CHI or equivalent), and clock/reset domains (including CDC and low\-power/clock\-gating scenarios).
* Exercise page table formats and features: stage\-1/stage\-2 translations, ASIDs/VMIDs, context banks/stream IDs, MSI/IOMMU operations, address translation faults, and SVA/ATS (if applicable).
* Debug complex issues using JTAG and on\-chip debug/trace infrastructure (ETM/STM/SWO), bring\-up scripts, and logic analyzers; drive root cause with design/architecture teams.
* Performance \& stress validation: create stress scenarios (burst/atomic/ordering/ QoS), measure bandwidth/latency, and validate backpressure \& throttling behavior through NoC.
* Contribute to emulation/FPGA and post\-silicon: port tests, build bare\-metal validation, develop board bring\-up sequences and lab automation.
* Own quality metrics: functional coverage, code coverage, assertions, defect density/escape rates; author clear test/coverage reports and sign\-off criteria.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with architecture, RTL design, firmware/driver, physical design, and validation teams to refine specs and close issues quickly.
* Continuously improve methodology, tools, and checkers; mentor junior engineers in best practices.


**Minimum Qualifications (Must\-Haves)**
* B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in ECE/EE/CS or equivalent with 3–5 years of relevant experience.
* Strong ARM architecture knowledge (A\-profile preferred): memory model, privilege levels, exception model, caches, TLBs, MMU concepts, and virtual memory flows.
* Deep understanding of SMMU/IOMMU fundamentals: stream IDs, context banks, translation stages, page table formats, fault handling, and device DMA interactions.
* Familiar with NoC/interconnect protocols and coherency (e.g., AXI/ACE/CHI), ordering rules, QoS, and interop with SMMU.
* Solid grasp of clocks/resets and their impact on SMMU and NoC behavior; experience validating low\-power states and clock gating effects.
* JTAG basics to intermediate: scan chains, boundary scan, run\-control, breakpoints, basic scripting with OpenOCD/DS\-5/Arm Development Studio or similar.
* Proficient in debugging complex HW/SW issues, using waveforms (e.g., Verdi/DVE), traces, and logs to isolate root cause.
* Scripting in Python/Perl/TCL/Shell for test automation, log parsing, and lab workflows.
* Critical thinking \& learning agility: ability to infer failure modes from first principles, design edge\-case tests, and quickly onboard new IP/flows.


**Preferred Qualifications (Good\-to\-Have)**
* Prior tapeouts with SMMU or IOMMU IP (Arm SMMU v2/v3 or equivalent vendor IP).
* Post\-silicon validation experience: lab bring\-up, firmware integration, board\-level debug.
* Experience with emulation/FPGA prototyping (Veloce, Palladium, Protium, HAPS).
* Familiarity with Linux IOMMU framework, device trees/ACPI, and driver\-level validation (DMA mappings, iommu\_ops).
* Knowledge of PCIe (including ATS/PRI/PASID), CXL, or virtualization stacks (KVM/Hypervisors) and their interaction with SMMU.
* Exposure to safety/security: memory isolation, SMMU faults as security boundaries, RAS features, error injection and detection.
* Performance modeling/analysis; profiling tools; building synthetic traffic to characterize SMMU/NoC behavior.
* CI/CD for verification (Jenkins/GitLab CI), coverage dashboards, and regression triage at scale.


**Tools \& Environment**
* Languages/Methodology: ARM assembly, C for bare\-metal tests, Python/TCL/Perl for scripting.
* Emu/FPGA: Veloce/RUMI
* Versioning/CI: Perforce, Jira.
* OS/Drivers: bare\-metal frameworks.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Test plan completeness and functional/code coverage closure against SMMU spec and use\-cases.
* Defect discovery rate and escape rate (pre\- vs. post\-silicon).
* Time\-to\-root\-cause for complex issues; quality of triage documentation.
* Regression stability and automation coverage.
* Performance validation completeness vs. targets (latency, bandwidth, QoS).


**Example Work Items You’ll Own**
* Create tests for stage\-1 and stage\-2 translations, ASID/VMID rollover, TLB shootdowns, and context switch stress.
* Validate device DMA through SMMU under NoC congestion and clock gating scenarios; confirm ordering and coherency guarantees.
* Run JTAG\-based bring\-up sequences to verify SMMU registers, enable translations, and capture trace for fault analysis.
* Automate validation: configure IOMMU groups, map/unmap devices, inject faults, and parse kernel logs for health signals.


**Education**
* B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech in EE/ECE/CS (or equivalent).

title: Senior Electrical Assembly Integration and Testing (EAIT) Engineer
description:
Role: Electrical Assembly Integration and Testing (EAIT) Engineer
   

  

 Employment Type:Full Time
   

  

 Educational Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 Work Experience: Minimum 2\-3 years of experience in Electrical Assembly \& integration of components/products within the aerospace, satellite manufacturing, automotive, or defence industries.
   

  

**Role Description**
 An Electrical AIT Engineer in the PRD team of the Space Department of Pixxel.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Duties**
* You will be responsible for identifying spacecraft harness requirements for reliable operations with respect to wire, cable and connector types determined currents, voltages, EMI/EMC considerations etc
* You will be responsible for creating detailed harness datasheets with reference to the ICDs, matching of datasheets and creation of worksheets for fabricators for harness fabrication and responsible for overlooking the fabrication process and qualification/ acceptance process.
* As a part of Pixxel’s Production Team, you will be responsible for overseeing and executing satellite assembly, integration and testing processes along with a team of technicians and engineers. At a given time, you will be given the responsibility of production of a set of Pixxel satellites.
* You will be drafting step by step electrical AIT procedures/assembly checklist for the technicians to implement, based on the designs.
* You will be responsible to check and validate each step of the AIT procedures after being implemented by the technicians on the shop floor.
* You will be responsible for troubleshooting any issues that arise during the satellite AIT.
* You will be responsible for documenting the progress in satellite AIT process and the observations during the inspection and validation of the procedures, post implementation, in an enterprise software or via manual record entry.
* You will be responsible for collaborating with design, systems, and mechanical teams to ensure compliance with technical requirements.


**Desirable Skills \& Certifications**
* Impeccable communication skills, in English (bonus \- Hindi and Kannada), in order to interface between the production team and technicians on a daily basis.
* Experience in reading and understanding datasheets, technical reports, wiring diagrams, schematics and test plans is a must.
* Good Experience in resource and production planning enterprise tools, like SAP, ERP etc.
* Highly proficient in documentation and planning tools like Google office (Docs, Sheets), MS projects, Jira, etc.
* Understanding of concepts involved in electrical integration and processes, with strong command over all required tools of the trade.
* Strong experience and proficiency in understanding and maintaining test equipment, including but not limited to, power supplies, oscilloscopes, current monitors, loads, multimeters, etc
* Strong understanding of test campaigns and ability to quickly and accurately document test reports and results. Good understanding of satellite environmental testing is required.
* Knowledge of ESD phenomena,cleanroom procedures, standards and best practices to prevent ESD, surface cleaning and preparation processes is a must.


**Candidate Acumen**
 A strong desire to work in a fast\-paced start\-up environment. Ability to deal with challenges and work out innovative solutions to tackle them. Building a team and guiding them towards success.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Health insurance coverage
   

  

 Unlimited leaves \& flexible working hours
   

  

 Role\-based remote work and work\-from\-home benefit
   

  

 Relocation assistance
   

  

 Professional Mental Wellness services
   

  

 Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)
   

  

 Employee Stock Options for all hires
   

  

**About Pixxel**
 Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first constellation of six commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5\-meter resolution and 135\+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
   

  

 Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18–24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full\-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI\-powered analytics.
   

  

 Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in\-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high\-frequency imagery with AI\-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in\-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
   

  

 Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission\-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long\-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space\-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
   

  

 Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.
   

  

 For more information, see ourCareers page or follow Pixxel onLinkedIn and X/Twitter.
   

  

**Culture**
 Pixxel is an organisation where we enable our employees to work on world\-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.
   

  

 Central to our employee\-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well\-being and growth in all aspects of life.

description:

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead first‑silicon bring‑up, board validation, and early silicon debug.
* Develop and complete detailed electrical characterization plans covering DC, AC, parametric, and functional measurements.
* Characterize high‑speed interfaces such as DDR/LPDDR, SerDes, MIPI, UFS, or custom Micron PHYs.

* Work closely with design, pre‑silicon verification, product engineering, firmware, test, and systems teams.
* Correlate post‑silicon results with simulation and pre‑silicon expectations to identify root causes of gaps.
* Work closely with Design Team \& propose enhancements and design changes to tackle next generation challenges.
* Contribute to silicon learning documentation and guidelines for comprehensive Chaz activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* 6 to 8 years of Industry experience in High Speed Post Silicon Electrical Characterization Domain
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics or related field.
* Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals, analog/digital circuits, and high‑speed interfaces.
* Hands‑on experience with High\-Speed Post‑silicon electrical characterization.
* Deep knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, timing analysis, jitter, noise coupling, Channel loss \& SerDes.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools and technologies
* Proficiency in lab equipment operation and debugging methodologies.
* Experience with scripting and automation (Python preferred).
* Background in (DDR/LPDDR/PCIe), SerDes, or high‑speed PHY characterization.
* Familiarity with ATE correlation, compliance specs, and JEDEC/PCI\-SIG standards.
* Experience owning end‑to‑end characterization of a subsystem or interface.
* Proven track record of silicon issue root‑cause analysis and resolution

title: Lead Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 




 Reva.AI is a unified access control and AI security platform for agentic and cloud\-native environments. It enforces intent\-aware, least\-privilege access across human, machine and AI identities, through AI workload discovery, behavioral analytics, policy governance and runtime enforcement.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Define the QA strategy, and design and maintain test plans and reusable test cases.
* Do manual testing across web and API layers for new features, enhancements and integrations.

* Build adversarial test cases for agentic AI risks: prompt injection, tool\-call abuse, excessive agency and data leakage.

* Work with product and engineering to tighten requirements before they're built.
* Mentor the QA team and set testing standards.



**Required** 



* 8\+ years in QA, including leading QA for SaaS, security or cloud\-native products.
* Hands\-on manual testing: test design, execution and defect reporting.
* Experience setting up and enforcing QA processes.
* Working knowledge of IAM, IGA, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML and JWT.
* Comfort with API testing tools such as Postman or curl.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.



**Nice to have** 



* Experience testing IAM, PAM, ZTNA or IGA products.
* Exposure to Cedar, OPA/Rego or OpenFGA.
* Familiarity with Entra ID, Okta, MCP or AI gateways.
* Basic automation experience (Playwright, pytest, Katalon,Postman in CI) and tools like Jira or TestRail.
* ISTQB or security certifications (Security\+, CISSP, Okta, Entra ID).

description:
Why Nasdaq
   

  

 When you work at Nasdaq, you’re working for more open and transparent markets so that more people can access opportunities. Connections can be made, jobs can be created, and communities can thrive. We want all our employees to have access to opportunities, too.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 Nasdaq financial platforms run some of the world’s largest exchange markets with billions of trades completed every day. Any problem or software fault can have far\-reaching consequences and that is why we work hard on finding even more innovative ways to uphold quality in ever increasingly sophisticated systems.
   

  

 If you have an inquisitive mind and want to work in an environment where we practice experiment\-fail\-learn to explore how we can automate and further secure quality in our products we believe you will enjoy working with us.
   

  

 You can expect an autonomous but fast\-paced work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward. Every day brings many opportunities to learn \& grow and rewards with the global impact we build.
   

  

**Our Team**
 Our team, that you will be joining, is working on a crucial part of the systems crafted to maintain the trust of the exchange (and market) by preventing “bad” orders from being entered. This is what we call Pre\-Trade\-Risk\-Analysis. To do this, a sophisticated graph analysis must be completed in microseconds by our system and hence we have very high requirements for our system.
   

  

 What you will do:
   

  

* Test Automation and Quality Engineering
+ Design, develop and maintain automated test suites in our in\-house automation framework on Python.
+ Build scalable, maintainable and reusable test automation solutions for backend services, APIs and complex business workflows.
+ Review existing automated coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness, reliability and maintainability.
+ Integrate and maintain automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
+ Analyze test failures, identify root causes and collaborate with developers to resolve issues efficiently.


* Test Design and Execution
+ Plan, implement and report tests in qTest, our test orchestration platform.
+ Design comprehensive test scenarios covering positive paths, negative paths, edge cases, boundary conditions and stress scenarios.
+ Apply risk\-based testing techniques to ensure critical business flows receive appropriate coverage.
+ Execute exploratory, integration and regression testing when required.


* Continuous Improvement
+ Use quality metrics and test analytics to identify coverage gaps and improve testing effectiveness.
+ Take ownership of initiatives that improve test coverage, automation efficiency and overall product quality.
+ Partner with developers, business analysts and product owners to ensure quality is built into the product lifecycle.


 What We Expect:
   

  

**Required Experience**
* A minimum of 4\-8\+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, with significant hands\-on test automation experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python 3 and proven experience developing non\-trivial automation frameworks, test suites, scripts or applications.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining automated tests for complex enterprise applications.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, including risk\-based testing, boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, negative testing, edge\-case testing and exploratory testing.
* Strong experience working in Agile software development teams.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, GitLab, Jira, Confluence and qTest or similar test management tools.
* Good experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues, identify risks and drive quality improvements.
* Solid understanding of running systems on a Linux platform.
* Showing examples of positive impact on both teams and quality processes in previous workplaces. Help us see your passion and dedication to continuous improvement in both yourself and the team you are working with!


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Basic knowledge of non\-functional testing (NFT).
* Exposure to Capital Market domain – Trading and Pre\-Trade Risk.
* Experience with Selenium or similar UI automation tools.
* Familiarity with code quality and software composition tools such as SonarQube, Nexus IQ Server, or equivalent.
* Prior programming experience (Java, Python, bash\-scripting, etc.)


 What Would Be Helpful:
   

  

* A strong automation\-first mindset with a proven track record of increasing automated test coverage.
* The ability to challenge requirements and identify high\-risk scenarios before defects reach production.
* A history of driving measurable improvements in product quality, test efficiency and engineering practices.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence quality across cross\-functional.


**Come as You Are**
 Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.
   

  

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

title: TEST & VALIDATION LEAD (ELECTRONICS)
description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
   

  

**Desired Skills**
 Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s in Electrical, Mechanical, or related field.
   

  

* Experience: 10\-12 years of hands\-on experience in product validation, reliability testing, or test engineering preferably in sensors or automotive, medical domain
* Experience in DV/PV test plan preparation, test execution, data analysis and test reports.
* Strong knowledge of environmental, mechanical, and electrical testing methods.
* Demonstrated expertise in vibration testing (random, sinusoidal, swept\-sine), mechanical shock, and combined temperature\-vibration environments.
* Proficiency with vibration control systems and shaker hardware (e.g., Data Physics, LDS, IMC, or equivalent platforms).
* Familiarity with test automation tools (e.g., LabVIEW, Python) and data acquisition systems.
* Expertise in ISO 17025, IATF, AEC\-Q qualification Test methodologies is a must.
* Skilled in use of DAQ, Oscilloscopes, Lab Instruments, Pressure / Vibration / Humidity, Climatic chambers, etc


**Job Overview**
 The Senior Test Engineer will play a critical role in the setup, execution, and analysis of DV, PV, and Qualification testing for sensor products including Pressure, MEMS, Resolver, Humidity, and Position Sensors, with a primary focus on Vibration Testing, Combined Temperature and Vibration (CTV), Mechanical Shock, and Environmental Reliability Testing. This role demands deep hands\-on expertise in mechanical and environmental stress testing, strong analytical capability, and thorough command of international test standards and methodologies. Operating from the central T\&V Lab in Bangalore, the engineer collaborates closely with global engineering teams to ensure all validation activities meet defined standards, cost targets, and schedule goals. A key dimension of this role is also the active mentoring, coaching, and capability development of fellow colleagues in the lab.
   

  

**Key Resposbilities**
* Lead the planning, setup, and execution of Combined Temperature and Vibration (CTV) testing, Mechanical Shock, and Environmental Reliability tests for sensor products across automotive, medical, and industrial applications.
* Define and develop vibration test profiles (random, sinusoidal, swept\-sine) and shock pulse parameters in accordance with applicable standards and customer\-specific requirements.
* Configure and operate vibration test systems, shaker tables, and associated control systems (e.g., LDS, IMC, Data Physics, or equivalent) integrated with thermal chambers for combined environment testing.
* Develop and validate fixture designs for vibration and shock testing to ensure accurate load transmission and minimize test artifacts.
* Develop and own mechanical and environmental test methods, procedures, and fixtures in full compliance with ISO 17025 lab requirements.
* Perform structural and dynamic response analysis of sensor assemblies to support test planning and failure analysis.
* Lead root cause investigations for shock induced or any other test failure modes, including fatigue, solder joint cracking, connector fretting, resonance\-related failures, etc.
* Plan and execute validation and reliability tests for sensor products in accordance with global and customer\-specific standards.
* Interpret and apply standards such as IATF 16949, ISO 17025, ISO 13485, AEC\-Q100/102/103\.
* Develop test plans, procedures, and reports aligned with product requirements and regulatory needs documentation in compliance with ISO 17025 requirements.
* Operate and maintain test equipment for electrical, mechanical, and environmental testing for maintenance, calibration and test efficiency.
* Analyze test data using statistical tools (e.g., Minitab), identify trends, and recommend design or process improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including design, quality, and manufacturing to resolve technical issues.
* Collaborate with global design and validation teams to align test scope, timeline and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to lab standardization and continuous improvement initiatives in test methods, automation, and lab efficiency.
* Ensure Test activities are executed safely in compliance with EHS safety, quality, and documentation standards in the lab environment
* Mentor junior engineers and technicians in test execution and data interpretation to build sustained lab capability.


**What Your Background Should Look Like**
 Generally requires Bachelors degree in appropriate field with a minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible professional level experience; Masters degree or higher or local equivalent may be preferred at this level
   

  

**Competencies**
 SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a senior technical leader to manage and guide the Regression team responsible for validating 2G, 4G and 5G (including O\-RAN) radio products. The role combines hands\-on RF and protocol validation expertise, automation leadership, and team mentoring. You will translate the product roadmap into test scenarios, automate them at scale, and ensure radio products meet quality, conformance, and schedule commitments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership and Planning**
* Lead and mentor the Regression team technically, guiding engineers on test design, debugging, and automation practices.
* Study the product roadmap, derive functional and system\-level scenarios, and convert them into automated test cases.
* Develop and own complex test plans and strategies aligned with project scope and timelines; track execution and report status to stakeholders.
* Drive a strong sense of urgency and accountability to meet product delivery needs on time.


**Test Automation and Frameworks**
* Design, implement and maintain automation scripts for functional, regression and performance testing.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks using industry best practices and tools such as Unittest and Pytest.
* Automate Radio Conformance Test (RCT) and end\-to\-end (E2E) scenarios.
* Develop instrument drivers, validation frameworks and measurement applications in Python (and MATLAB) to improve coverage, repeatability and productivity.
* Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and use Kubernetes\-based environments for scalable test execution.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to improve test productivity, such as test generation, log analysis, failure triage, anomaly detection and coverage optimization.


**RF and Radio Validation**
* Design, implement and execute 3GPP Radio Conformance Testing (RCT) methodologies for next\-generation RF SoC and radio platforms, covering test development, automation, data analysis and debug.
* Perform hands\-on characterization of RF subsystems and signal chains, including PA, LNA, filters, CFR and DPD algorithms across multiple technologies and carrier configurations.
* Develop custom measurement techniques and validation workflows for key metrics: EVM, ACLR, receiver sensitivity, noise figure, spectral emissions and transmitter linearity.
* Use and automate Keysight or Rohde \& Schwarz equipment, including signal generators and signal/spectrum analyzers.
* Evaluate, integrate and optimize advanced RF test equipment and commercial test solutions to improve accuracy and throughput.


**Debug, Analysis and Bring\-up**
* Investigate and root\-cause RF performance issues through lab measurements, statistical analysis, and cross\-functional debugging with hardware, firmware and software teams.
* Drive silicon bring\-up and system\-level validation, identify performance gaps, and give actionable recommendations to design teams.
* Analyze large RF datasets to identify trends, anomalies and performance limits, and translate them into clear technical insights and design guidance.


**Experience**

* 18\+ years of relevant experience in wireless/radio validation.
* Has technically led and/or mentored a team of 6\+ engineers.
* Has developed a complex test plan and managed its end\-to\-end execution.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong coding skills in Python and shell scripting; working knowledge of C/C\+\+ for developing test cases and scripts.
* Solid understanding of cellular wireless protocols (MAC/PHY), especially O\-RAN, LTE or 5G.
* Knowledge of O\-RAN, 5G or 4G technology.
* Expertise in using and automating Keysight or R\&S RF equipment (signal generators, analyzers).
* Experience automating RCT and E2E scenarios.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized test environments.
* Practical experience using AI in engineering and testing workflows (a must\-have).

* Able to work productively and independently.
* Strong team player with ownership and urgency.

* Strong understanding of integration architecture, enterprise design patterns, and system landscapes.

* Exposure to A2A and B2B integration scenarios and proficiency with adapters such as REST, SOAP, SFTP, IDoc, OData, and JDBC.
* Knowledge of security protocols including SSL and PGP encryption.
* Familiarity with Groovy and JavaScript scripting.
* Awareness of Boomi AgentStudio and Boomi GPT capabilities is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-cultural environment.

title: QA Engineer - O2C & Enterprise Billing Testing
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
   

  

 We are looking for a highly analytical and technically proficient QA Engineer to take ownership of our Opportunity\-to\-Cash (O2C) and Enterprise Billing testing. In this role, you will act as a quality gatekeeper for the financial systems that drive our business.
   

  

 You will join the BOBA Frameworks QA team — a small, high\-ownership team embedded in the Finance engineering organization — where quality directly impacts revenue accuracy and customer trust.
   

  

 You will not just be executing test cases; you will be mapping out complex data flows that span across Salesforce CPQ, our middleware, our Billing Platform, our payment gateways (Braintree), and our NetSuite ERP. If you are a critical thinker who understands the financial domino effect of a failed sync, loves unraveling usage\-based billing logic, and thrives in cross\-functional collaboration, we want you on our team.
   

  

**What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)**
* End\-to\-End Pipeline Ownership:
+ Execute comprehensive test strategies for our entire Opportunity\-to\-Cash lifecycle.
+ Trace data payloads from the moment an order is created in Salesforce CPQ to the moment the final journal entry hits NetSuite.

* Complex Billing Lifecycle Validation:
+ Take ownership of testing our Enterprise Billing Platform.
+ Rigorously validate invoice generation, taxation (Avalara), proration, discounts, credits, tiered and usage\-based pricing models, credit memo issuances, and dunning (collections) workflows.

* Test Plan \& Coverage Ownership:
+ Own and maintain structured test plans in Xray for all buying programs (PAYG, Savings Plan, Volume Plan).
+ Ensure traceability from requirements to execution across every billing lifecycle stage.

* Payment Gateway \& Ledger Allocation Testing:
+ Take ownership of end\-to\-end payment flows through Braintree.
+ Validate successful authorizations, settlements, and complex edge cases like partial refunds on multi\-invoice payments.
+ Ensure funds are accurately handled (e.g., proper allocation vs. unallocated amounts) and invoice statuses remain correct across systems.

* Usage \& Consumption Testing:
+ Deep\-dive into our usage\-based billing models.
+ Simulate high\-volume usage data, validate tier drawdown logic, and ensure overages are calculated with absolute precision.

* Cross\-System Integration Testing:
+ Perform robust integration testing across our financial tech stack.
+ Validate API payloads, investigate failed background syncs, and ensure data integrity between Salesforce, Billing Platform, NetSuite, and Braintree.

* Defect Triage \& Root Cause Analysis:
+ Investigate system logs and identify exactly where a data sync broke down.
+ Provide developers with clear, actionable reproduction steps beyond just reporting bugs.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
+ Act as the bridge between Engineering, Product, and Finance.Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex revenue rules and translate them into foolproof test scenarios.


 What Success Looks Like (Your First Year)
   

  

* Day 30 — Architecture \& Ownership: You've mapped the full Quote\-to\-Cash pipeline end\-to\-end: Salesforce CPQ → Boomi/PASS provisioning → Billing Platform → NetSuite → Avalara \& Braintree. You've taken full ownership of the Xray test repository and can explain which test cases cover which buying program, workstream, and billing lifecycle stage without being asked.
* Day 60 — Independent Execution: You independently execute QA for a complete enterprise billing lifecycle — from contract activation through invoice approval, tax calculation, and payment processing — and close it without escalation. You've begun triaging Billing Platform → NetSuite sync failures and Boomi provisioning errors on your own, and you understand the difference between a defect and expected system behavior.
* Day 90 — Primary Sign\-Off: You are the QA gate for all cross\-system financial deployments. Engineering ships nothing that touches CPQ, Billing Platform, or NetSuite without your sign\-off. You've established a defect triage process in Jira and Xray that gives Engineering and Finance a shared, real\-time view of quality — eliminating the back\-and\-forth that slows down deployments.
* Year 1 — Measurable Impact: Critical post\-deployment data sync errors between CPQ and NetSuite have dropped measurably. Every active buying program — PAYG, Savings Plan, and Volume Plan — has standardized, Xray\-tracked test coverage for usage\-based billing, commitment invoicing, contract lifecycle boundaries, and edge cases. The team ships faster because QA is a multiplier, not a bottleneck.


**What You Bring To The Table (Required Experience)**
* O2C Domain Expertise: 4\+ years of QA experience with a heavy focus on Quote\-to\-Cash / Order\-to\-Cash business processes. You understand the "why" behind financial transactions, not just the "how."
* Salesforce CPQ: Hands\-on experience configuring and testing quotes, product bundles, amendments, and contract renewals within Salesforce CPQ.
* Enterprise Billing Platforms: Proven experience testing complex billing systems such as BillingPlatform, Zuora, or similar financial engines.
* Payment Processing \& Gateways: Hands\-on experience testing enterprise payment gateways (Braintree heavily preferred; Stripe or Adyen acceptable). You possess a deep functional understanding of payment lifecycles (Auth, Capture, Settle, Refund) and how gateway actions impact Accounts Receivable (AR) balances.
* Integration Middleware: Familiarity with provisioning and event\-driven middleware (Boomi or equivalent). You can read a payload log and identify where in the chain a sync broke.
* Test Management \& Agile Tools: Proficient in Jira for defect tracking and Agile workflows, with strong hands\-on experience using Xray as a test management tool. You know how to navigate structured test plans, manage test executions, and maintain strict traceability between bugs, test cases, and product requirements.
* Usage\-Based Models: Familiarity with testing consumption\-based pricing, tiered pricing, drawdown models, and metered billing logic.
* Integration \& API Verification: Experience validating data transfers between systems (using tools like Postman or validating middleware logs). You know how to prove a system sent the right data even if the UI hasn't updated yet.
* Taxation \& Compliance Tools: Familiarity with enterprise taxation calculation software like Avalara.


**Who You Are (Soft Skills)**
* A System\-Level Thinker: You understand that missing a prerequisite step — like failing to approve a usage invoice before uploading the next month's consumption — breaks the entire downstream flow.
* Self\-Driven Investigator: When a test fails, you don't just throw it back to Dev. You dig into the documentation and logs to help figure out exactly what went wrong.
* Exceptional Communicator: You can clearly explain a complex API sync failure to an engineer, and then turn around and explain the business impact of that failure to a Finance Manager.
* Detail\-Obsessive Under Ambiguity: Financial test data is rarely clean. You know how to set up a controlled test environment, isolate variables, and still reach a confident pass/fail verdict even when upstream systems are noisy.

 **.**

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Write, maintain, and execute test cases for studio games across mobile and web platforms, covering a broad range of devices, operating systems, and browsers.
* Perform functional and non\-functional testing of mobile applications, including network traffic, API responses, and log analysis.
* Collaborate closely with Scrum teams, Producers, Developers, and QA Leads/Managers to ensure releases meet high quality standards.

* Mentor junior QA team members and support their technical and domain growth.
* Partner with the QA Lead to continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and release quality.
* Support team coordination and delivery in the absence of the QA Lead.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4–7 years of experience in software testing, preferably across mobile, web, or gaming products.

* Good understanding of client\-server architecture, APIs, application data flow, and network debugging.
* Hands\-on experience in test design, test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and risk\-based testing.

* Good understanding of software testing processes, SDLC/STLC, and Agile methodologies.

* Automation frameworks and standards.

* Support testing of Salesforce integrations, APIs, and AppExchange products.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science
 **, Information Systems, Engineering, or related eld** 
 , or equivalent experience.

 in Software Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering.

* Demonstrated experience designing, executing, and maintaining
 **test automation** 
 for business applications.

**Strong working knowledge of:** 



* Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

* Agile delivery methodologies.



  





**Experience with:** 



* Automated testing frameworks and tools.

* Proficiency with standard productivity and reporting tools.



  





**Preferred Skills and Competencies:** 



* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Experience with:**

The role requires having good understanding of incident response and customer issue resolution—and working with the team on initiatives such as automation, process standardization, and system optimization. Success in this role directly impacts product quality, team productivity, customer experience, and the organization's ability to scale its software offerings effectively while maintaining operational excellence standards.
   

  

**How are the engineers in this team different from SDEs?**
 They are skilled in one or more programming languages (Python, Java, Perl, etc.). They understand data structures, but don’t have to be as strong as SDEs. For example, they understand and can implement Arrays, linked lists, queues, but not necessarily Trees or Graphs. SDEs typically develop core software products for business and solve problems with significant algorithmic complexity or Big\-O performance optimizations, while the engineers in this team will implement solutions to improve system resilience and build automations to address common problems faced across multiple teams. (eg. Build an automation that implements security patch across services owned by multiple teams) which doesn’t need to be optimal but does the work effectively and error free.
   

  

* QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

* Proven experience in supporting production software systems, performance improvements and resolving systemic issues

* Experience in automation tools, monitoring solutions, and operational processes
* Background in working with cross\-functional teams and interfacing directly with customers or end users
* Experience with agile development methodologies

* DB and SQL understanding

title: Senior Payroll Quality Analyst
description:
**About us:** 




 The global hiring revolution is shaping a future where talent can thrive everywhere, driving innovation and progress on a global scale. Multiplier is at the forefront of this change. By removing barriers and simplifying global hiring, we’re creating a level playing field where businesses and individuals – (like you) – can compete, grow, and succeed, regardless of geography.
 



  





 Multiplier empowers companies to hire, onboard, manage, and pay talent in 150\+ countries, quickly and compliantly. Our mission is to build a world without limits, where ambitious businesses can look beyond borders to build their global dream teams.
 



  





 Our unified employment platform, complete with world\-class EOR, AOR and Global Payroll products, means it has never been easier to seize the global hiring opportunity.
 



  





 The future is borderless. Let’s build it together.
 



  





**About Job** 




 We are building a world\-class Payroll Centre of Excellence at Multiplier, and the Quality Assurance sub\-vertical is central to that vision. As a Senior Quality Assurance Specialist, you will be the frontline guardian of payroll accuracy and compliance across our global operations.
 



 This is not a traditional audit role. You will be an active participant in building and running the QA control framework from the ground up — designing proactive checks, conducting variance analysis, governing vendor quality, and driving continuous improvement across multi\-country payroll cycles.
 



 You will work closely with the payroll operations team, the functional transformation team, and senior leadership to ensure that every payroll cycle we run meets the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and timeliness. You will play a direct role in Multiplier's ambition to achieve near\-zero payroll errors at scale.
 



  





***While the Kep responsibilities will primary involve setting up the foundation for the Quality Assurance vertical, it will also become your responsibility to convert this into an auto pilot process, where we ensure zero people driven activities and convert these into a highly efficient process driven vertical.***




  





 Skills \& Competencies
 


* **Exceptional attention to detail:** 
 you notice what others miss and you care about getting it right every time.
* **Strong analytical thinking:** 
 you can look at payroll data, spot patterns, and draw meaningful conclusions quickly.
* **Structured problem\-solver:** 
 when something goes wrong, you go beyond the fix to understand why it happened and prevent recurrence.
* **Clear written communication:** 
 you can document errors, root causes, and process recommendations in a way that is easy to understand and act on.
* **Process\-oriented mindset:** 
 you believe that good outcomes come from good processes, not individual heroics.
* **Collaborative:** 
 you work effectively with payroll operations, finance, HR, and vendors to resolve issues and improve quality.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** 
 you can operate in a growing, evolving environment and help define the standards as the function matures.



  





 Technical Skills
 


* Proficiency in Excel, including VLOOKUP, SUMIF, pivot tables, and data validation. Ability to work with large payroll datasets and identify anomalies.
* Experience with payroll software: familiarity with one or more global or regional payroll systems is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Zendesk, Jira, Notion, or similar ticketing and documentation tools is an advantage.
* Understanding of gross\-to\-net payroll calculations, statutory deductions, tax withholding mechanisms, and GL reconciliation.



  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience working within a Centre of Excellence, shared services, or a structured QA governance framework.
* Exposure to payroll implementations or in\-house country go\-lives.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance in India, UK, Brazil, or other high\-complexity countries.
* Familiarity with QA maturity models or continuous improvement frameworks such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Experience working in a global employment platform, HR tech, or payroll technology company.



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Proactive Quality Assurance
* Execute pre\-payroll QA checks across assigned countries, including input data validation, variance analysis, and headcount reconciliation before every payroll run.
* Enforce input cut\-off compliance: flag missing or late inputs, apply mandatory field validation, and escalate exceptions through the appropriate approval workflow.
* Conduct month\-over\-month variance analysis and apply defined thresholds (salary changes above 20%, headcount variances above 5%, and large or off\-cycle payouts), triggering investigation and dual approval where required.
* Maintain and execute the QA Audit Checklist for every payroll cycle across your assigned countries, ensuring each stage is documented and signed off before payroll proceeds to payment.
* Identify duplicate records, outlier transactions, and data anomalies using systematic checks and early warning logic.



  





 Reactive Quality Assurance
 


* *Catch and resolve errors when they occur*
* Conduct post\-payroll output validation: gross\-to\-net accuracy checks, payslip sampling, payroll register reviews, and bank file reconciliation.
* Perform post\-payroll reconciliation including payroll vs bank totals, payroll vs Finance GL reconciliation, and accrual validation within agreed timelines.
* Log every error, including minor ones, in the Error and Incident Log with full classification, description, and timeline.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for all payroll errors within your remit, completing RCA documentation within 5 business days for High and Critical issues.
* Define and implement corrective actions (CA) and preventive actions (CAPA), feeding improvements back into the QA checklist, SOP updates, and the broader control framework.



  





 Compliance \& Statutory Quality Control
 


* *Maintain 100% compliance across EMEA*
* Validate statutory filings, tax deductions, social contributions, and country\-specific compliance requirements for assigned in\-house countries.
* Monitor compliance calendars and ensure all statutory obligations are met within deadlines, flagging risks proactively before cut\-off dates.
* Support the Taxes and Filings Operations Team with three\-way reconciliation (payroll output, bank payments, statutory reports) and proof of payments documentation.
* Stay current on legislative changes in assigned countries and escalate regulatory updates to the Functional Transformation team for SOP and knowledge repository updates.



  





 Vendor Quality Governance
 


* *Hold third\-party vendors accountable*
* Execute the internal pre\-QA layer for all vendor\-processed payrolls: conducting mandatory variance analysis, headcount reconciliation, high\-value transaction reviews, and payslip sampling before approving vendor output.
* Score and document vendor performance on a quarterly basis using the Vendor Performance Tracker, assessing SLA adherence, accuracy rate, issue resolution speed, and responsiveness.
* Flag underperforming vendors to the QA Lead and Sr. Manager CoE, providing data\-backed scorecards to support formal reviews and escalations.



  





 KPI Monitoring \& Reporting
 


* *Drive data\-driven quality improvement*
* Own the monthly QA Scorecard for your assigned countries, tracking Error Rate, On\-Time Payroll, Compliance Issues, Input Accuracy, and Rework Volume against defined targets.
* Maintain the country Risk Heatmap by updating monthly risk scores and providing a written summary of key issues and recommended actions for each country in your remit.
* Contribute to the weekly operations update, reporting open issues, exceptions, and SLA status to the QA Lead.
* Prepare country\-level QA summaries for the monthly management review and Control Tower, including trend analysis and improvement recommendations.



  





 Continuous Improvement \& SOP Contribution
 


* *Make the system better every cycle*
* Identify gaps in existing QA controls and proactively propose enhancements to the QA checklist, control matrix, and operating procedures.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of country\-specific playbooks in collaboration with the Functional Transformation team.
* Support the shift from reactive to proactive QA, actively working to increase the percentage of errors caught before payroll runs versus after.
* Participate in the onboarding and training of new QA team members, sharing process knowledge and best practices.

 Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail\-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Silicon Validation
description:
**Senior Staff Engineer, Silicon Validation**
 Location: Bengaluru (on\-site, hours flexible)
   

  

 Ayar Labs is shattering AI data bottlenecks by moving data at the speed of light. As pioneers of co\-packaged optics (CPO), we are using light instead of electricity to move data faster, further, and with a fraction of the energy needed to fuel the explosive growth of AI models.
   

  

 Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD, MediaTek and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs’ co\-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next\-generation AI scale\-up architectures.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the silicon validation of our optical chiplets. You will define and drive the validation strategy from pre\-silicon validation and preparation with emulation/FPGA platforms, tape out qualification, initial silicon power\-on through block and chip level signoff. This is a rare opportunity to apply deep expertise in high\-speed SerDes, photonic systems, pre\-silicon and post\-silicon validation to shape the future of optical interconnect for next\-generation AI infrastructure.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead Validation Strategy: Define and implement comprehensive validation methodologies for our electronic\-photonic SoCs, covering pre\-silicon validation, initial bringup, functional validation, electrical characterization, and system\-level testing. Develop detailed test plans, success criteria, and select appropriate test equipment and methodologies.
* Drive Silicon Bring\-up: Lead first silicon power\-on and bringup for new tape\-outs, collaborating with firmware and design teams to establish operating conditions and validate core functionality from day one.
* Own Block and System Validation: Execute rigorous post\-silicon validation of SerDes interfaces, optical control loops, and mixed\-signal blocks using industry\-standard lab equipment (BERT, DCA, oscilloscopes, OSA, VNA).
* Apply Standards and Best Practices: Draw on industry standards (IEEE, OIF, JEDEC, Ethernet/Optical MSA specs) and semiconductor validation best practices to establish rigorous validation targets, coverage objectives, and signoff criteria.
* Root Cause and Debug: Investigate and drive to closure all silicon failure modes, from signal integrity issues to mixed\-signal anomalies, using systematic debug methodologies and close collaboration with design and firmware teams.
* Mentor and Lead: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior and junior validation engineers; guide the team's technical execution.
* Deliver High Quality Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive validation reports, signoff packages, and product performance documentation.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 10\+ years of relevant industry experience, or Masters degree with 10\+ years of experience.
* Demonstrated leadership in pre\-silicon, post\-silicon validation for complex SoCs or multi\-chip packages, including first silicon bringup and full signoff.
* Hands\-on expertise with high\-speed SerDes validation and characterization (NRZ and PAM\-4\) using equipment such as BERTs, oscilloscopes/DCAs, and network analyzers.
* Strong proficiency in Python for lab automation, data analysis, and test infrastructure development.
* Experience developing and owning validation test plans end\-to\-end.
* Deep understanding of communication protocols and standards (Ethernet, PCIe, etc.).
* Excellent communication skills and ability to drive cross\-functional technical alignment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MSEE or equivalent
* Familiarity with optical transceiver standards and co\-packaged optics integration challenges.
* Knowledge of high\-speed standards: Ethernet (200G/400G/800G), PCIe Gen5/6, OIF CEI.
* Experience driving NPI and transition from lab validation to manufacturing test.
