title: Sr. Engineer – Pen Tester
description:
**About Us**
 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The Penetration Tester is a critical member of the Application Security team, focused on identifying, validating, and resolving security vulnerabilities across our cloud infrastructure and applications. You will lead technical security assessments, including application\-layer and network\-layer penetration testing, to ensure all information assets are secured against evolving threats. This role is vital for maintaining our security posture and ensuring remediation efforts are effectively prioritized and executed.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Perform comprehensive manual and automated application\-layer penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities, adhering to industry standards and internal methodologies.
* Conduct network\-layer penetration tests encompassing all components supporting network functions and operating systems.
* Validate segmentation and scope\-reduction controls at least annually and after any significant changes to ensure isolation of the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE).
* Triage and validate vulnerabilities reported through bug bounty program.
* Document and risk\-rate all findings, providing actionable remediation guidance to engineering and product teams.
* Verify the correction of exploitable vulnerabilities through re\-testing and post\-remediation assessments.
* Collaborate with external 3rd party security firms on penetration testing and threat hunting exercises.
* Ensure all security assessments and remediation activities meet compliance and regulatory obligations (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC).


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or application security engineering.
* Deep understanding of common web\-based attacks (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, XXE, etc.) and how to mitigate them at the application level.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, Ruby, or Bash to automate security tasks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of network protocols and security concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, and IPSEC.
* Strong experience with security testing tools (e.g., BurpSuite Enterprise, SAST, DAST, and IAST).
* Working knowledge of OWASP security fundamentals and API identity/access management (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT).
* Ability to work with high autonomy and communicate technical security findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Relevant information security certification(s) such as OSCP, CEH, OSWE, or CISSP.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Direct experience managing or triaging a public bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, BugCrowd).
* Experience leveraging Slack/ChatOps to automate security tasks or reporting.
* Experience with cloud orchestration and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Google Deployment Manager).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tooling like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC2, or CCPA.

title: QA Engineer - Networking L2/L3 Testing | 4 - 8 yrs
description:
**Meet the Team**
 The Cisco IOS XR Routing and BNG Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco’s carrier\-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer\-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end\-to\-end validation across Layer 2, Layer 3, routing, subscriber\-management, and network\-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, and web\-scale customers operating some of the world’s largest and most demanding networks.
   

  

 Our team values technical depth, automation\-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem\-solving, and responsible adoption of AI\-assisted development practices.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing and Broadband Network Gateway capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system\-level failures, and provide data\-driven release recommendations.
   

  

 Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production\-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI\-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high\-availability tests for IOS XR routing and BNG features.
* Validate BNG subscriber technologies, including IPoE, PPP, PPPoE, DHCPv4/DHCPv6, DHCP relay, Prefix Delegation, RADIUS, AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, subscriber policies, and session lifecycle management.
* Test Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies such as Ethernet, VLAN, QinQ, LACP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, MPLS, Segment Routing, L2VPN, L3VPN, EVPN, ECMP, BFD, QoS, and high\-availability mechanisms.
* Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools.
* Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud\-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms.
* Validate control\-plane, forwarding\-plane, subscriber\-scale, traffic, failover, software upgrade, rollback, process restart, route churn, and subscriber churn scenarios.
* Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system\-resource data.
* Validate model\-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing.
* Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation.
* Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI\-generated output.
* Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product\-quality risks and release readiness.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.
* 4 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering.
* Strong knowledge of BNG architecture and subscriber\-management technologies, including PPP/PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS, AAA, accounting, and subscriber session management.
* Comprehensive understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, and MPLS.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier\-grade network operating system.
* Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting.
* Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high\-availability test scenarios.
* Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working experience of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools.
* Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycle.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience testing BNG and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, or NCS 5500/5700\.
* Experience with traffic generators and subscriber\-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent.
* Knowledge of advanced BNG features, including subscriber QoS, dynamic policy activation, etc.
* Experience with L2VPN, EVPN, telemetry, and network programmability.
* Familiarity with scale and performance characterization.
* CCNP Service Provider, CCIE Service Provider, DevNet Professional, or equivalent technical knowledge.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. title: Technical Lead, (FCAPS Quality Assurance)
description:
Job Description
 



**Greetings From Rakuten Symphony!** 




 Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com
 



 Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.
 



 To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud\-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.
 



 Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together! About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755\) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e\-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Lead/Senior QA Engineer to design, architect and lead end\-to\-end integration testing and validation strategies across our OSS (Operations Support Systems) platforms. In this role, you will drive quality governance for complex multi\-vendor ecosystems spanning Configuration Management (CM / Config Manager), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM), Performance Management (PM), Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Cloud Observability workflows. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in telecom service assurance, network synchronization parameters and a strong background in validating highly distributed data layers— specifically leveraging Graph databases for complex network topologies alongside Redis for high through put, real\-time caching and data streaming pipelines.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




 •
 **Integration \& E2E Validation: Architect and execute comprehensive integration testing strategies across highly interconnected OSS environments, ensuring flawless structural data orchestration between northbound/southbound APIs, multi\-vendor EMS/NMS and physical/virtual network elements.** 




**• Configuration Management (CM) Validation: Design and drive automated validation frameworks for CM engines to audit network configurations, track baseline drift, validate parameters (e.g., cell parameters, routing tables) and verify automated network provisioning rollbacks.** 




 • Database \& Network Topology Testing: Validate large\-scale Graph databases (e.g., Janus Graph)utilized for real\-time network topology mapping, complex entity relationship queries and cross domain dependency modeling.
 



 • Performance \& Cache Validation: Performance\-test and validate distributed Redis DB implementations, ensuring active data structures, eviction policies, session states and high frequency pub/sub message queuing behave reliably under simulated peak telecom traffic loads.
 



 • Test Automation Frameworks: Design, build and scale custom test automation frameworks from scratch using Java and/or Python leveraging industry\-standard tools such as Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, TestNG and REST Assured.
 



 • Observability \& Streaming Validation: Validate cloud\-native observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) along with high\-throughput distributed messaging and event data logs streams orchestrated via Apache Kafka clusters.
 



 • AIOps \& Closed\-Loop Automation: Lead end\-to\-end quality validation initiatives for AI/ML\-driven root cause analysis (RCA), predictive network analytics, anomaly detection algorithms and closedloop self\-healing operational workflows.
 



 • CI/CD/CT Quality Gates: Embed robust automated quality validation gates, automated continuous regression suites and infrastructure tests seamlessly into DevOps deployment pipelines via Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD/CT engines.
 



  





**Required Technical Skills \& Competencies:** 




**OSS \& Telecom Domain Expertise** 




 • Comprehensive understanding of the FCAPS structural framework and modern Telecom Service Assurance principles.
 



 • Hands\-on validation experience covering Configuration Management (CM), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM) and Performance Management (PM) domains.
 



 • Expertise in parsing network topology nodes, checking delta configurations and validating multivendor EMS/NMS integration points.
 



 Database \& Architectural Skills
 



 • Strong querying and structural knowledge of Graph Databases along with graph query languages.
 



 • Deep understanding of Redis DB core architecture, including data structures, replication, eviction policies, clustering and Pub/Sub functionality.
 



 • Proven experience verifying log, search and transactional accuracy across distributed data backends including Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Cassandra.
 



 Automation Engineering
 



 • Advanced proficiency using Python or Java to design test libraries, custom keywords and object oriented testing suites.
 



 • Robust hands\-on framework experience with programmatic API Testing Tools (REST Assured, Postman) and message brokers (Kafka).
 



 • Solid architectural knowledge of containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes orchestration and Helm charts.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




 • 5\-10 years of direct, hands\-on experience in Software Quality Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on Telecom OSS and Service Assurance systems.
 



 • Proven background validating highly distributed distributed systems with demanding high availability, real\-time telemetry and complex data persistence requirements.
 



 • Excellent analytical, root\-cause isolation and communication skills to collaborate efficiently across multi\-vendor technical domains.

title: Quality and Reliability Lead
description:
**About General Autonomy** 




 General Autonomy is building the next generation of intelligent autonomous ground robots, including quadrupeds, humanoids and UGVs , together with the actuators, electronics, AI and electromechanical systems that power them.
 



 Unlike most robotics’ companies, we build across the entire technology stack in\-house. Around 90% of the company is engineering, working across five core disciplines: mechanical and actuator design, electronics, controls, robot learning, and deployment. Our teams work on locomotion, perception, navigation, reinforcement learning, edge AI, embedded systems, actuators, motor controllers, precision gearboxes, rugged electronics and manufacturing.
 



 We believe tightly integrating hardware and software is essential to building robots that can operate reliably in real\-world and demanding environments.
 



 Our flagship quadruped, PARAM, is designed for reconnaissance, logistics, surveillance and other demanding field operations. Our humanoid platform, ATOM, is being developed for dexterous and remote tasks in challenging environments. Alongside these platforms, we are also building UGVs and investing in indigenous actuators, electronics and manufacturing capabilities to strengthen the domestic robotics ecosystem.
 



 General Autonomy was founded by IIT Kanpur alumni Bhanu Singh, CTO, and Farid Ahsan, CEO, who previously built and scaled ShareChat and Moj. The company has raised over US$6\.5 million from leading venture investors.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is a senior hands\-on individual contributor role, with leverage to evolving automation systems. . You will establish how product quality and reliability are defined, measured and improved while personally executing the work: planning tests, analyzing failures, leading root cause investigations, reviewing design and process risks, and closing issues with engineering, suppliers and manufacturing.
 



 The role suits an experienced professional who wants to remain technically close to the product and is motivated by building from scratch. You should be comfortable moving between component\-level investigation and system\-level decisions on reliability targets, release readiness and the quality operating model.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




**Quality and reliability operating foundation** 



* Create lightweight systems for nonconformance, MRB, change control, traceability, test evidence, calibration and quality records as the organization scales.
* Partner with the supply chain on supplier qualification, audits, incoming quality, corrective actions and supplier capability improvement.
* Define a focused set of metrics and review routines that make product risk, failure recurrence and closure effectiveness visible.



**Product reliability and validation** 



* Define practical reliability goals and verification plans for systems, subsystems and critical components.
* Plan and execute lifecycle, durability, environmental and stress testing appropriate to product maturity and risk.
* Use test, prototype and field evidence to identify degradation mechanisms, estimate life and recommend design or usage changes.
* Build reliability learning from early prototypes toward repeatable production and field operation.



**Design and manufacturing quality** 



* Work directly with engineering on design reviews, critical characteristics, testability, acceptance criteria and design risk reduction.
* Lead DFMEA and or PFMEA activities according to the product and process risk; convert findings into owned actions and verification evidence.
* Define fit for purpose inspection, control plans, end of line tests, burn in or screening methods where they add measurable value.
* Support product release decisions with clear evidence, unresolved risk visibility and proportionate controls.



**Failure resolution and feedback loops** 



* Personally lead structured root cause analysis for prototype, production, supplier and field failures; drive corrective and preventive actions to verified closure.
* Establish failure reporting, review and learning mechanisms across engineering, manufacturing, suppliers and field operations.
* Use RMA, test, inspection and field data to prioritise the problems that most affect reliability, safety, availability and customer outcomes.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Reliability and quality risks are identified earlier and translated into specific engineering, supplier or process actions.
* Critical failures are investigated rigorously, corrective actions are verified and learning is retained.
* Release and production decisions use traceable evidence rather than informal judgement alone.
* The function operates effectively in a lean organization without depending on a laboratory team or large quality department.



  





**Experience and Capabilities** 



* **Experience** 
 6 to 9 years in product quality, reliability, validation, manufacturing quality or a closely related discipline for complex hardware.
* **Essential foundation** 
 Direct hands\-on ownership of failure analysis and root cause resolution, with demonstrated ability to work across design, test, manufacturing and suppliers.
* **Technical judgement** 
 Ability to connect failure evidence, product physics and manufacturing variation to practical design, test or process decisions.
* **Build stage mindset** 
 Evidence of creating test methods, quality controls, reliability practices or operating mechanisms in an ambiguous NPI, prototype, low volume or scaling environment.



  





**Relevant career paths** 




 Candidates may come through either of the following paths. Deep expertise in every quality and reliability discipline is not required.
 


* Product reliability, validation or test strength, with working knowledge of manufacturing and supplier quality; OR
* Product or manufacturing quality strength, with demonstrated reliability testing, failure analysis and evidence based release work.



  





**Methods and technical depth** 



* Deep experience in either DFMEA and design reliability or PFMEA and manufacturing quality, with working proficiency in the other.
* Practical proficiency in the methods relevant to your path, such as 8D, CAPA, fault tree analysis, fishbone, 5 Why, SPC, MSA or control plans. Mastery of every tool is not expected.
* Working knowledge of reliability statistics and test planning. Deeper proficiency in Weibull analysis, accelerated life testing or sample size methods is expected primarily for reliability led profiles.
* Technical depth in one or more areas such as actuators, gear trains, dynamic mechanisms, structural systems, electronics, power electronics, motors, sensors or interconnects.



  





**Preferred Background** 



* Robotics, aerospace, automotive, industrial automation, defence, drones, medical devices or another safety or mission critical hardware sector.
* Exposure to environmental and durability testing, supplier audits, test equipment, data acquisition or industry quality standards. The exact combination may vary by career path.
* Mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, materials or related engineering degree, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications are useful but secondary to demonstrated technical ownership.



  





**Who Will Thrive Here** 




 You are a builder who is willing to investigate the failure, run the test, challenge the assumption and then create the system that prevents recurrence. You do not need a team or a mature quality framework to create impact. You combine technical depth with practical judgement and can make progress without adding unnecessary process.

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Reliability Engineering**
**About The Role**
 As a Reliability Engineering, you are a core technical expert within Cisco’s Quality Organization. You are responsible for the reliability execution across multiple product families (PFs), ensuring that our hardware meets rigorous quality standards from design through end\-of\-life. You will lead NPI engagements, manage cross\-functional reliability tasks, and serve as the primary technical contact for product\-level reliability issues. This role requires a strong technical leader who can drive project milestones, execute mitigation plans, and provide data\-driven insights to engineering teams to ensure our networking infrastructure remains reliable and performant.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Project Reporting \& Advocacy: Serve as the Reliability Lead for project\-level reviews. Provide technical counsel to program managers and engineering leads regarding risk mitigation and the status of reliability deliverables.
* Upfront Reliability Assessment: Manage materials and manufacturing reliability, product\-level historical field reliability, and gap analysis to quantify risks for assigned products.
* Reliability Plan Execution: Execute milestone\-based reliability plans from planning through design and development, driving deliverables and tracking progress against product objectives.
* Design\-Phase Risk Analysis: Drive cross\-functional FMEA and lead execution of derating analysis and schematic modeling, ensuring design parameters are validated prior to physical testing.
* Validation \& Demonstration: Lead RDT planning, execution, and failure analysis through product validation, driving root cause resolution before launch.
* Launch \& Field Performance: Drive early and ongoing field reliability monitoring, failure trending, and Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) performance reporting; lead failure analysis for sustaining issues.

 5 years in QA

 ivoyant is a software engineering and product company headquartered in Atlanta, GA, with delivery teams across the US and India. We build and support enterprise platforms for clients in the US market. This role sits with our India delivery team and supports a US\-based enterprise SaaS client.

 We're hiring a QA Engineer to take hands\-on ownership of testing for a client's Salesforce platform during an upcoming release program. You'll take user stories through to verified, release\-ready functionality writing and executing test cases in X\-ray, validating Salesforce configuration and integrations, and catching defects before they reach users.

title: Senior Engineer - System Solution Engineer
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Senior Engineer \- System Engineering**
 Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is seeking a Solution Engineer for MCO equipment, to be part of MCO engineering team.
   

  

 In this role you will be in charge of Engineering activities to demonstrate the compliance and functionalities of equipment in front of Design Changes with same form\-fit\-functionalities. You establish the Change Impact Analysis, and perform the Simulation, analysis and verification activities.
   

  

 Context of Design in MCO activities for FLX Cockipit and Computers,
   

  

 After the first certification of our Equipments, during serial production and support phases, our equipment are regularly submitted to Design Changes. These Design Change involving partial redesign, are mainly due to obsolescence treatment, necessary correction to solve critical PR (Problem Report).; or enhancement improvement of equipment capabilities. These design changes vary from minor changes (component change with limited impact) to more significant change where all the safety, qualification, and certification information have to be re\-assessed regarding airworthiness regulation, all the Design Changes must be submitted to customer approval before release.
   

  

 Our Equipments are Computers (as Flight Control, Flight Management, Display, Interactivity Control Panel, Head up Display)
   

  

 Our team is focused on Hardware Changes (electronics, packaging .. )
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Equipment engineering or equivalent with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in aeronautic. Higher qualifications of Post\-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in civil Avionics design is desirable.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Establish Impact Analysis of electronics Design Changes
+ Understand the applicable documentation basis (from specification to IVVQ and safety BOM data package).
+ Propose the validation plan

* Build the Simulation/analysis, and establish the entire necessary demonstration to obtain our PDA (followed by Customer) approval,
* Prepare all the customer satisfactory certification documentation (expected example) and reviews
* Perform the complementary testing and IVV at equipment level.
* Coordinate with stakeholders and specialists in a collaborative manner for
* Electronics Engineers when boards or FPGA are modified
* Packaging :Environmental testing when Qualification test are repeated
* Test Bench and Means : industrialization \& Production Support , Acceptances Tests in manufacturing
* Configuration Management team
* Project Managers


**Skills \& experience:**
* Must have strong knowledge in Electronics (analog and digital) design and development.
+ Should be able to analyze electronics circuits individually.
+ Should be able to select alternate electronics components (Active, Passive and Connector) individually
+ Should be able to read schematic, Bill of materials and Layout file.

* Must have high awareness of Airworthiness, Aeronautic Safety requirements and standards. ( as per ARP4761 or ARP4754 )
* Must have strong experience with aeronautic standard (DO\-160 environment , DO\-254, ARP4754, ARP4761; APQP)
* Must have strong experience to troubleshoot on electronics and embedded hardware systems to find the root cause and to fix with a suitable solution
* Must have experience in interfacing with external test facilities for environmental and EMI/EMC and other electrical tests as per MIL\-STD and DO\-160 standards
* Should be familiar in developing Qualification Test procedures (QTPs), Qualification Test Reports (QTR), Qualification by similarity reports (QBSR) and other documents required by airborne certification authorities
* Must be fluent with on Configuration Management data package (Build of Materials, Definition File, Identification, Design Change Rules)


 Must be fluent with tools and data repositories: as BDDP and PLM/TOL/GED
   

  

* Experience in establishing Design Documentation (Requirement, IVVQ procedure, reports)
* Should be familiar with mechanical drawings, wiring diagram reading and understanding.
* Should be familiar in Industrialization, Production process, Testing, (Acceptance test, Screening testing ) ideally experience on APQP
* Should be familiar in the IVVQ (Integration, Verification, Validation and Qualification) including requirements management
* Must have good experience in bench test set\-up, functional testing and performance evaluation
* Should be familiar with project progress reporting, ensure KPI’s reporting and Risk/opportunity assessment.
* Must have demonstrated leadership skills on complex topics.
* Must be rigorous, organized, autonomous, pro\-active and motivated to contain a position within a multidisciplinary team.
* Should be familiar with multi\-disciplinary team (BL engineering team, Lab technicians, external labs, Purchase team, ECC Engineering teams and manufacturing teams, …)


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Supplier Development Engineer (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
   

  

**SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (STARLINK)**
 SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best\-in\-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.
   

  

 As a Supplier Development Engineer focused on Final Assembly, Test, and Packout for Starlink, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of the user terminal manufacturing at our global suppliers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Planning, proposing, and leading experiments to produce timely and accurate analyses used to drive design, development, and supply chain decisions, with a focus on scalability for high volume manufacturing
* Assessing the suitability of a fabrication technology for a given part design, including its potential for automation and cost\-effective mass production
* Planning validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility as well as manufacturing capability at high volumes, incorporating throughput modeling and yield optimization
* Analyzing results of validation exercises and provide technical recommendations to enhance efficiency and reduce variability in large\-scale production
* Reviewing progress of development activities at supplier locations and serve as point of escalation for critical process related issues, ensuring alignment with high volume ramp\-up requirements
* Drive process development and capability assessment activities, reviewing part design documentation to ensure alignment with process capability for high volume manufacturing, including DFM principles for scalability and automation
* Assigns specific tasks and work with SpaceX suppliers to support process development and/or data gathering activities aimed at achieving consistent high throughput and low defect rates
* Set clear goals for results and provide timely reviews of performance throughout program, emphasizing metrics for production efficiency and cost per unit
* Establish validation procedures to figure out acceptance of tooling into development builds as well as mass production, incorporating statistical process controls and capacity planning for high volume output
* Review supplier tool design, process flow, equipment selection, DFM, and DOE proposals, with emphasis on their suitability for high volume manufacturing, such as automated lines and rapid cycle times
* Identify shortfalls and corrective actions to ensure design compliance and scalability to meet production demands
* Work with supplier engineering teams to map out process development exercises, secure resources, and commit to schedules in line with program goals, including ramp\-up plans for high volume output
* Assess supplier readiness to support build events and production ramp, evaluating infrastructure for sustained high throughput and supply chain resilience
* Identify potential execution issues and provide recommendations to mitigate risk, focusing on minimizing downtime and optimizing yield in mass production environments
* Apply solid understanding of quality control and manufacturing concepts to develop specific Product Quality Plan (PQP) appropriate to program and commodity, tailored for high volume manufacturing with advanced statistical methods and automated inspection
* Coordinate all Quality Engineering functions for a program, serving as project manager to lead efforts at supplier locations, ensuring robust processes for large\-scale production
* Actively participate in the program planning and monitoring process assuming responsibility for key deliverables at all milestones, including quality gates for volume ramp\-up
* Provide technical direction and guidance to other Quality Engineers supporting the implementation of the PQP, promoting continuous improvement for high yield operations
* Assess measurability and creatively address concerns directly with stakeholders, incorporating real\-time monitoring tools for high volume lines
* Identify and direct studies to implement improvements in measuring method where appropriate, such as adopting AI\-driven analytics for defect prediction
* Establish audit procedures appropriate to program and supplier to ensure adherence to SpaceX quality standards, with frequency scaled for high production volumes
* Implement FAI and Cp/Cpk reviews of mechanical parts, extending to ongoing process capability monitoring for sustained high volume performance


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering or STEM discipline
* 1\+ years of experience in one of the following: supply chain engineering, supplier development/quality, manufacturing, or design engineering


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Experience in PCBA manufacturing
* Professional experience with SMT processes (e.g., screen printing, pick\-and\-place, reflow, wave soldering, and inspection)
* Engineering degree in electrical or mechanical engineering
* Experience with statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma certification, or Lean manufacturing principles applied
* Proven track record of production ramp\-up for high\-volume electronics manufacturing, preferably in consumer electronics
* Strong understanding of PCBA failure modes, defect analysis, and quality control methodologies (e.g., 8D, Fishbone, Pareto, PFMEA, DOE, SPC), with the ability to develop Product Quality Plans (PQP), implement FAI and Cp/Cpk reviews, and establish audit procedures tailored for high production volumes
* Hands\-on experience with failure analysis
* Experience in analyzing large datasets and dispositioning hardware based on data
* 5\+ years of experience in SMT engineering, including leadership roles in supplier development or process engineering for complex consumer electronics systems and/or 5\+ years of experience in Final Assembly, Test and Packout
* Expertise in advanced SMT technologies, such as fine\-pitch components, BGA/CSP assembly, selective soldering, and high\-mix/low\-volume to high\-volume transitions
* Knowledge of environmental testing and reliability standards for consumer electronics (e.g., vibration, thermal cycling)
* Prior experience in the consumer electronics industry, particularly with high volume hardware assembly
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple suppliers and projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment


**Additional Requirements**
* Position is based in Bangalore, India and requires being onsite \- remote work not considered
* Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
* Ability to travel: Up to 50% work week travel may be required to suppliers in Southeast Asia


 SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Test Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Are you looking to grow your career in production testing at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world? At Texas Instruments (TI) a Production Test Engineer ensures manufactured components and assembled products meet company standards and objectives. You'll develop and implement testing and evaluation methods and create test plans based on production specifications and requirements. You'll use your talent to perform testing and compiling and analyzing data for review and identification of manufacturing and production issues.
   

  

**Who are we and what do we do?**
 The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high\-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal\-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra\-small form factors that enable TI’s best\-in\-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market.
   

  

 In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high\-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions!
   

  

 By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Utilize analog circuit analysis and Automated Test Equipment debug knowledge to troubleshoot test, quality, and device performance issues
* Develop test processes, fixtures and software for automated test equipment for optimized production use
* Establish and influence next\-generation test solutions that help achieve the lowest obtainable costs on future products
* Facilitate and support new multi\-factory manufacturing test and assembly flows
* Analyze test solution robustness through correlated performance and sameness verification techniques
* Perform yield analysis and work with fabs for yield improvements where applicable
* Lead Silicon Test \& Validation development activities with product ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing.
* Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical function responsible for silicon char, production testing, qualification, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications.
* Make assignments for team members, providing technical guidance as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project.
* Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the development phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives.


**Qualifications**

 As a CX Automation \& Project Coordinator, you will play a pivotal role in driving the CX AI and automation programme from end to end. You will transform the automation roadmap into delivered workstreams across the entire Client Journey, leading initiatives from requirements gathering through to successful implementation. Working closely with cross\-functional stakeholders, you will ensure every automation is governed by clear ownership, documentation, monitoring, and regulatory compliance across all jurisdictions. Your success will be measured by delivering meaningful business outcomes, including improved efficiency, reduced manual effort, increased deflection, and measurable ROI, enabling the CX team to focus on delivering exceptional client experiences.

* Own and maintain the CX automation roadmap and backlog, sequencing tasks across quarters under the agreed delivery framework and reporting status to CX Management.
* Serve as the first point of contact for operational and system challenges raised by the CS team, diagnosing root causes, implementing permanent and scalable fixes over workarounds, and keeping stakeholders updated through to resolution.

* Coordinate UAT and testing for new automations before release, building a feedback loop that iterates the design and implementation.

* Own the uptime, usability and responsiveness of CS\-critical platforms (Devrev), proactively addressing outages, lagging tools and user complaints, and escalating where needed.
* Track ROI, deflection and adoption for every flow, with the 95% blue tier deflection north star as the connecting thread between pilots and the wider roadmap.
* Govern ownership and operational readiness, confirming a named owner, runbook and monitoring for every flow before cutover, treating CX\-owned readiness as a hard gate.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and recommend scalable, long\-term solutions.

title: Risk Assurance Advisor - Technology Control Testing (1LOD)
description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Quality Assurance Advisor plays a key role in strengthening first\-line control testing and quality assurance capability, maturity, and consistency across a defined business portfolio.
   

  

 This role supports the delivery of meaningful insights into control effectiveness, risk exposure, and non\-compliance. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the Advisor contributes to the continuous uplift of control testing practices by translating enterprise risk standards into practical testing approaches, quality benchmarks, and reporting expectations.
   

  

 The role is instrumental in supporting assurance activities that deliver clear, prioritized insights, enabling effective escalation, informed decision\-making, and timely business\-owned remediation. It also contributes to embedding specialist risk and control capabilities, standards, and practices that help the business deliver safe, compliant, and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

 Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What will your day look like?**
 As a Quality Assurance Advisor, you will
   

  

* Support the continuous improvement of control testing methodologies, frameworks, templates, and quality standards.Ensure testing activities are performed
* consistently and in line with approved methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to enhance testing through data\-driven techniques and automation.
* Conduct and support control testing and assurance activities to assess control effectiveness and compliance with policies and standards.
* Review testing outcomes and identify control weaknesses, process gaps, and emerging risks.
* Perform root cause analysis and provide recommendations to strengthen controls and improve business outcomes.
* Support targeted reviews and deep dives based on risk exposure and assurance priorities.
* Translate testing outcomes into meaningful risk insights and reporting.
* Support governance forums through assurance reporting and risk\-based recommendations.
* Escalate material control issues, non\-compliance, and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Monitor remediation activities and validate sustainable closure of actions.
* Partner with business, risk, compliance, and control stakeholders to improve risk awareness and control effectiveness.
* Provide constructive challenge and support business teams in understanding testing outcomes and remediation requirements.
* Promote a consistent understanding of first\-line control testing expectations and risk management practices.
* Contribute to the ongoing uplift of testing, assurance, and governance practices.
* Share knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices across teams.
* Demonstrate strong risk culture behaviors, including integrity, independence, accountability, and evidence\-based decision\-making.


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring:
   

  

* 5\-8 years of Experience in Control Testing, Quality Assurance, Risk Assessment, Compliance Monitoring, Audit, or Operational Risk within a regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, control taxonomies, and enterprise risk management standards.
* Knowledge of business process controls, control design principles, and first\-line risk management responsibilities.
* Demonstrated ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness through testing, root cause analysis, and evidence evaluation.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, evaluate risk, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience identifying control gaps, process weaknesses, and compliance issues.
* Exposure to assurance methodologies, risk management systems, testing tools, and reporting platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* Excellent planning, prioritization, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex risk concepts to diverse audiences.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relating to conduct, compliance, operational risk, and governance.


**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124108

title: Sr, Digital Quality (SAP)
description:
**Purpose of this position :** 




 Position in a global environment, responsible for defining, governing and continuously advancing the Digital Quality ecosystem across ZEISS Vision Care/ ZEISS COM. The role owns the Digital Quality strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment between Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Business Functions, e.g. Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and IT.
 



 Responsible for leading digital quality initiatives, including the Quality work package within the international implementation of SAP S/4HANA and the integration of multiple eQMS and digital platforms (e.g., Polarion, Salesforce, Veeva, eDMS \[OpenText etc.]). The role focuses on defining, harmonizing and optimizing business processes within a Digital Quality ecosystem, considering system interfaces, AI\-enabled solutions, Prompt Governance, data governance and advanced analytics (reports, dashboards) across multiple manufacturing and distribution sites as well as headquarters. The incumbent acts as the global business lead for Digital Quality capabilities and is ac\-countable for ensuring that digital platforms, AI\-enabled quality solutions and quality data architectures support business objectives while maintaining regulatory compliance, data integrity and audit readiness.
 



**Primary duties and responsibilities** 




**Digital Transformation** 



* Actively participate in all activities required for the implementation of digital compliance systems impacting business processes (primarily SAP S/4HANA, including interfaces to other systems such as Polarion, Salesforce, and other eQMS platforms)
* Lead the Quality Management (QM) work package within the global SAP S/4HANA implementation project
* Analyze newly defined and existing S/4HANA processes for feasibility in high\-volume, highly regulated environments
* Collaborate with functions and business units to Identify requirements
* Aligning requirements with global quality representative’s prior implementation
* Implement changes within the digital compliance process landscape
* Map end\-to\-end processes and system interfaces, identifying risks, including process efficiency and compliance risks
* Support global rollout activities, including system validation and testing of SAP use cases
* Troubleshoot post\-implementation issues and recommend feasible, compliant solutions
* Work autonomously to gather required information and collaborate with relevant stakeholders
* Act proactively, deriving conclusions and driving decisions based on limited or incomplete information
* Ensure timely and effective communication with all relevant stakeholders
* Support additional activities as required by line management
* Own the Quality Management digital compliance transformation Quality Plan, roadmap and related governance activities
* Define target\-state Digital Quality process architectures and system integration concepts
* Lead cross\-functional Digital Quality transformation initiatives across regions and sites
* Drive harmonization and standardization of quality processes globally
* Process Ownership of CSV / CSA, User Access Control
* Ensure business ownership, adoption and sustainability of implemented Digital Quality solutions
* Support prioritization of Digital Quality investments and resource allocation in alignment with business priorities



**Digital Quality Strategy \& Governance:** 



* Own and continuously develop the global Digital Quality Strategy
* Define and maintain the Digital Quality roadmap aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements
* Establish governance models for Digital Quality initiatives, systems and processes
* Prioritize Digital Quality projects and transformation activities based on business value, risk and compliance impact
* Act as business owner for the Digital Quality portfolio and strategic initiatives
* Define Digital Quality standards, principles and minimum requirements across ZEISS Vision Care
* Provide recommendations regarding Digital Quality investments, capabilities and technology opportunities
* Ensure alignment between Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Business Functions and IT



**AI \& Digital Quality Innovation** 



* Identify and drive opportunities for AI\-enabled quality improvements (e.g., automation, predictive quality, AI agents and intel\-ligent workflows)
* Support the creation, training and deployment of AI agents to enhance quality processes and decision\-making
* Establish and maintain governance for AI\-enabled quality solutions
* Own Prompt Governance and Prompt Lifecycle Management for quality\-relevant AI applications
* Define standards for prompt development, validation, documentation, monitoring and continual improvement
* Maintain approved prompt libraries and quality\-specific AI instructions
* Ensure traceability, auditability and version control of prompts and AI\-generated outputs
* Define validation requirements for AI\-enabled solutions and support implementation of risk\-based controls
* Ensure AI\-based solutions comply with regulatory, quality and data governance requirements
* Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation within the Digital Quality landscape
* Drive adoption of Generative AI capabilities, advanced analytics and intelligent automation within Quality processes



**Data Governance :** 



* Define and implement data governance standards for quality\-relevant data across SAP, eQMS, and interfacing systems
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and traceability across the digital ecosystem
* Define data ownership, data flows, and lifecycle management for quality data
* Monitor and mitigate data\-related risks impacting compliance and business processes
* Own Quality Data Governance standards across Digital Quality platforms
* Define Quality Data ownership, stewardship and accountability models
* Lead development of the Quality Data Strategy supporting analytics, reporting and AI\-enabled decision making
* Establish standards for quality\-related master data management
* Drive implementation of quality dashboards and advanced reporting capabilities
* Ensure availability of quality\-relevant data for digital transformation initiatives



**Portfolio Management \& Vendor Governance** 



* Own the Digital Quality application, project and initiative portfolio
* Support budget planning and investment prioritization for Digital Quality initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their applicability within Digital Quality
* Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with Digital Quality solution providers
* Support vendor selection, performance evaluation and governance activities for Digital Quality platforms and related services
* Monitor portfolio performance and realization of business benefits



**Quality Management System** 



* Review and provide feedback on global Quality work package documentation and implementation processes to ensure compliance with the Quality Management System and ISO 13485, MDSAP, NMPA requirements
* Create and maintain QMS documentation (procedures, work instructions, digital process documentation) required for compliance and successful system implementation in context with CSV/CSA
* Ensure alignment of digital systems with regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 13485, MDR, GxP, FDA 21 CFR)
* Support QMS team in additional digital quality\-related activities e.g. AI Agent implementation as required by line management.



  





**Key Data** 




**1\. Leadership accountability** 




 provides functional and disciplinary leadership for Digital Quality initiatives, Digital Quality champions, business process owners and cross\-functional project teams within a global matrix organization across sites, regions and functions. Leads the Digital Quality community through governance structures, influence leadership and strategic alignment of priorities.
 



**2\. Supervisory dimension** 



* CSV/CSA Manager
* Digital Data Solution Managers
* SAP Quality Expert (BPO Regulatory Compliance)



**3\. Key relationship/customers** 



* Global SAP S/4HANA and digital transformation project stakeholders
* QMS team member
* Functions and business units across manufacturing and distribution sites, and headquarters
* Owners/users of interfacing systems (e.g., Polarion, Salesforce, eQMS platforms)
* IT, Digital, and Data Governance teams
* Key interfaces/liaison/functional guidance within the organization: Global Management Systems, Manufacturing/Operations, IT, Quality, Business Units, Sites, HQ



**4\. Key interfaces/functional guidance within ZEISS group** 



* Identification of process gaps and definition of required changes within project timelines
* Successful implementation and adoption of digital quality systems
* Data integrity and compliance across systems
* Efficiency improvements through digitalization and automation
* Audit readiness and regulatory compliance



**5\. Key data / KPIs** 



* Digital Quality Roadmap Delivery
* SAP Quality Work Package Milestone Achievement
* Global Process Harmonization Progress
* eQMS, eDMS, RIMSYS Deployment and Adoption
* Data Integrity Metrics
* AI Solution Adoption and Effectiveness
* Prompt Validation Compliance Rate
* User Account (Licence) in use, not in use
* Quality Automation Benefit Realization
* Digital Audit Readiness
* User Adoption and Training Effectiveness
* System Standardization Metrics



**Education / Professional Certification** 



* Academic degree (Bachelor or higher) in Quality Management, Engineering, IT, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field



**2\. Experience** 



* 5\+ years of experience in digital quality, SAP S/4HANA, or eQMS implementation in a global environment
* Experience as SAP superuser, especially in QM\-related processes
* Experience with eQMS platforms (e.g., VEEVA, Trackwise, or similar)
* Experience with RIM platforms (e.g. IQVIA; RIMSYS)
* Experience to connect automated processes (IT \+ OT)1 to other systems and operations and leverage collective analytics and learnings to continuously improve system autonomy
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in regulated Quality Management Systems (ISO 13485 preferred)
* Experience to define and implement AI Agents (CoPilot), automation, or digital innovation projects is an ad\-vantage



**3\. Knowledge / Skills / Other characteristics** 



* Language: Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is a plus
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, particularly in manufacturing environments
* Experience in integrating multiple digital systems and managing interfaces
* Knowledge of Quality Management Systems and regulatory frameworks (ISO 13485, MDR, GxP, FDA 21 CFR)
* Knowledge of quality tools and methods (e.g., CAPA, incoming inspection, recalls, quarantine, control plans)
* Experience in data governance, data structures, data lifecycle management, and analytics\-driven decision making
* Knowledge of AI concepts, including AI agent creation, Prompt Engineering, and AI Governance frameworks
* Experience in mapping complex business processes in high\-volume, regulated environments
* Experience in business process improvement (Six Sigma is a plus)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive conclusions from incomplete or ambiguous information
* Proven ability to work independently with excellent communication and organizational skills
* Proven ability to troubleshoot digital system implementation issues
* Experience in Digital Transformation, Digital Strategy Development, and governance of digital platforms and
* enterprise applications
* Experience in business ownership of enterprise quality systems
* Strong stakeholder management and influence leadership skills
* Experience in portfolio management and prioritization within global organizations

**Why this role is important to us**
 Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future\-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
 Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front\-to\-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.

We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.

* Strong structured thinking and attention to detail — precision matters in process and knowledge engineering.
* Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one.
* Self\-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow\-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject\-matter experts and global stakeholders.


**Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services.

* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

title: Silicon Validation Manager
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states.
   

  

 At Waymo, we are designing the custom compute platform that runs the Waymo Driver, powering millions of rider\-only trips and navigating over 100 million miles on public roads. When you are deploying custom silicon for safety\-critical physical systems, the responsibility is great. You need absolute correctness, exhaustive coverage, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement. To achieve this, the Waymo Compute team is scaling worldwide. In this role you will shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by guiding the validation of a cutting\-edge SoC.
   

  

*This role is primarily in\-office and reports to Head of Silicon.*
**You Will**
* As a Silicon Validation Manager, you will lead the group focused on post\-silicon validation of custom ML SoCs. You will set strategy and coordinate resources, planning, and execution for the team.
* You will strategize, review, and execute test plans for silicon systems and subsystems. You will own silicon bring\-up, new product introduction (NPI), and sustaining efforts. You will serve as the central coordination point between your team and systems teams, including hardware, software, manufacturing, and supply chain. You will also manage relationships with vendors and contract manufacturers.
* You will verify that silicon meets functional and performance requirements and own qualification, characterization, and deliverables for post\-silicon, including interfaces, compute cores, power, and performance. You will debug issues, suggest fixes, and ensure silicon meets quality and reliability requirements throughout the entire product life\-cycle.


**You Have**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in silicon bring\-up and validation and/or product characterization as a product development engineer.
* 5\+ years of experience managing a silicon development team and leading post\-silicon projects, including planning, execution, and team formation, mentorship, and coordination.
* Experience as a manager or technical leadership for new product introduction in custom silicon.
* Proficiency with Firmware development, C\+\+, and Python.
* Experience with lab equipment and debug tools, such as oscilloscope, protocol analyzer, JTAG debugger, etc
* Ability to work effectively within cross\-functional and cross\-site teams, strong communication and documentation capability.


**We Prefer**
* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Experience with the entire silicon development life\-cycle related to Silicon Validation, architecture and design requirements, DFx features, tapeout, planning and readiness for post\-silicon, and execution of post\-silicon.
* Experience bringing silicon to high\-volume manufacturing and sustaining programs.
* Experience in direct Silicon design or verification, and understanding of SystemVerilog.

Actual starting pay will be based on job\-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Hupo We are an AI\-native start\-up building sales enablement products in the banking, financial services, and insurance industry; already trusted by dozens of enterprise customers (including Fortune 500 companies). Role at a Glance Title: QA Automation Engineer \- AI Team: Engineering Employment Type: Full\-time Location: Remote (APAC) Why This Role Matters At Hupo, AI quality is the product \- a wrong score, hallucinated feedback, or a broken voice turn is a customer\-facing defect, and in a regulated BFSI context, a compliance risk. This role owns and scales the testing of Hupo’s AI pipelines, working closely with QA, Engineering, and Product as the platform grows. It’s a hands\-on, high\-ownership role in a fast\-moving environment \- you’ll be a key part of deciding, with evidence, whether each release is safe to ship. What You'll Do Build and maintain automated testing for AI voice and chat agents, from single conversational turns to full roleplay flows. Test LLM output quality \- correctness, consistency, structured output, language fidelity, prompt regression \- using evaluation harnesses (LLM\-as\-judge, golden datasets, tolerance\-based assertions for non\-determinism). Validate RAG pipelines: retrieval relevance, grounding/faithfulness, and answer quality. Test voice pipelines: STT/TTS accuracy and real\-time, low\-latency behavior across languages. Automate across UI/E2E, API, and AI output layers, and build CI/CD from scratch \- lint, type\-check, tests, evals, coverage gates, deployment checks. Own release quality: regression strategy, catching breakages early, and clear go/no\-go calls. Cover database and load/performance testing; extend automation to desktop and mobile clients. Take over and extend existing QA automation, and strengthen shared frameworks, tooling, and QA processes/standards. What Success Looks Like Within your first few months, you'll: Ramp on Hupo’s existing QA automation suites and take clear ownership of them. Extend test coverage for LLM and voice\-agent behavior, including new evaluation harnesses for non\-deterministic output. Contribute CI/CD improvements \- coverage gates, deployment checks \- that catch regressions before they reach customers. You’ll also be expected to continuously: Adapt and expand impact as priorities shift Take ownership of new problems as they emerge What We're Looking For Must\-Haves 5\+ years as a QA Automation Engineer, with a proven track record testing AI systems \- not just traditional software. Builder mindset: established testing frameworks, standards, and CI/CD\-integrated automation from scratch. Hands\-on experience testing conversational AI \- voice and/or chat agents \- on real, shipped projects. Strong grasp of LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG \- designing tests for nondeterministic output and evaluating retrieval/generation quality. Understanding of voice pipelines (speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech) and how to test them in automation. Hands\-on with LLM evaluation/observability tooling \- e.g. Langfuse, LangSmith, DeepEval, RAGAS. Proficient in UI/E2E (e.g. Playwright) and API test automation; experience building CI/CD pipelines from scratch. Comfort with database testing, load/performance testing, and desktop/mobile test automation. Solid Git discipline, basic cloud knowledge, and familiarity with the agile sprint lifecycle. Track record in fast\-paced, fast\-shipping environments \- ramps quickly on unfamiliar systems, pragmatic about process. Nice\-to\-Haves TypeScript \- for reading the codebase and contributing test/automation code directly. Voice \& real\-time: LiveKit / WebRTC; STT/TTS via Azure Speech, Google Cloud Speech, Deepgram, or self\-hosted Whisper. AI/ML infra \& eval tooling: GPU inference (vLLM / TGI / Triton), Azure OpenAI, golden datasets, HITL pipelines, Braintrust, Promptfoo. QA \& cloud tooling: Cypress, Postman, multi\-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Infrastructure\-asCode (Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation), Docker/Kubernetes. Also useful: product analytics familiarity (e.g. PostHog), multilingual/localized testing experience, and production monitoring/error\-tracking tools.

description:
**Job Description: Quality Assurance Engineer**




  





**About CARD91**




 CARD91 is a leading Issuance Platform\-as\-a\-Service provider, transforming payment infrastructure for banks, corporations, and fintechs. Our platform enables the issuance of various payment instruments, enhancing transaction visibility and decision\-making. We offer a suite of tools, including an issuer processor and card management system, to streamline card issuance. Partnering with major networks like RuPay, Visa, and Mastercard, we effectively tackle payment challenges in India and support global expansion. Backed by $14 million in pre\-Series A funding, CARD91, founded in 2020 by Ajay Pandey and Vineet Saxena, boasts a team of experienced technopreneurs and bankers.
 



  





**About the Role**




 As the QA Engineer at CARD91, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our products and services through effective leadership of the Quality Assurance team. You will develop and execute quality assurance strategies, oversee testing processes, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to maintain high standards of excellence in all aspects of the product lifecycle. Your role will be pivotal in driving continuous improvement and ensuring that all CARD91 products meet the highest levels of quality, performance, and security.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities**




**Develop and Implement QA Strategies:** 



* Design and oversee the implementation of comprehensive QA strategies, ensuring alignment with CARD91's business objectives and product requirements. Establish best practices to enhance product quality across all stages of development.



**Lead the QA Team:** 



* Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of QA professionals, providing guidance on QA methodologies, tools, and processes. Foster a collaborative and high\-performance culture within the QA team.



**Test Planning and Execution:** 



* Coordinate the development and execution of test plans, cases, and scripts, ensuring that testing covers all functional, regression, integration, and security requirements. Ensure all features are thoroughly tested before release.



**Collaboration with Cross\-functional Teams:** 



* Work closely with Product, Development, and Operations teams to define quality goals, clarify requirements, and ensure a shared understanding of expectations. Facilitate communication across teams to address issues and prioritize deliverables.



**Monitor and Report Quality Metrics:** 



* Track and analyze quality metrics such as defect rates, testing progress, and performance, providing regular reports to stakeholders. Use data\-driven insights to improve testing processes and product quality.



**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Identify areas for process optimization and recommend tools or methodologies to enhance efficiency, reduce defects, and improve testing effectiveness. Stay updated on industry trends and implement new best practices and technologies.



**Risk Management and Issue Resolution:** 



* Proactively identify and address potential risks in the product development lifecycle. Lead efforts to resolve defects and issues that impact quality, working with development teams to ensure timely resolution.



**Ensure Compliance with Standards:** 



* Ensure that all products adhere to internal and external quality standards, regulatory requirements, and security protocols. Implement audits to verify compliance with industry best practices.



**Drive Automation Initiatives:** 



* Lead the efforts to integrate test automation tools and frameworks to improve the efficiency and coverage of testing. Oversee the development of automated test scripts and ensure their successful integration into the CI/CD pipeline.



  





**Requirements**



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in Quality Assurance. Experience in the payments, financial technology, or SaaS industry is a plus.
* Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, software testing, and automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, JMeter, Postman). Familiarity with Java, Python, Mysql, Postman, Swagger, Agile methodology, Scrum, and DevOps practices is essential.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and motivate a team. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams and stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and efficiently.
* High attention to detail with the ability to identify potential issues early in the process to ensure high\-quality outcomes.



  





**Why should you join?**

* **High\-Impact Role** 
 : Lead critical initiatives, manage investor relations, and influence decision\-making across leadership, contributing directly to the company's success.
* **Dynamic and Growth\-Oriented Environment** 
 : Be part of a cutting\-edge, tech\-driven culture with opportunities to innovate, take ownership, and expand your skill set.
* **Purpose\-Driven Mission** 
 : Join a company empowering businesses with seamless financial solutions, driving financial inclusion and transformative change in the payment ecosystem globally

* Stock options for long term wealth creation

At Universal Robots, part of Teradyne Inc., Our vision is to create a world where people work with robots, not like robots.
