**Our Purpose**
 At Teradyne Robotics, including Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), our mission is simple:Automation for Anyone. Anywhere.
   

  

 Our vision is to create a world where people work with robots, not like robots. With more than 100,000 collaborative robots deployed worldwide, Universal Robots leads the global market in collaborative automation while MiR provides cutting\-edge autonomous mobile robots that transform internal logistics.
   

  

 Together we enable manufacturers of all sizes to automate, improve productivity, and empower people through robotics.
   

  

**Opportunity Overview**
 Do you want to ensure the quality and safety of software powering the world’s leading collaborative robots?
   

  

 Are you passionate about testing complex robotic systems and working closely within an international team? Then you might be our next Senior Software Test Engineer.
   

  

 We are currently looking for an experienced  Software Tester  to join our global R\&D organization, working closely with our teams in Denmark. You will become part of a growing setup in India, collaborating daily with highly skilled colleagues across locations.
   

  

**Designing the future**
 Universal Robots is the world’s market leader in collaborative robots (cobots), developing solutions that transform the way work is done across industries.
   

  

 In this role, you will contribute directly to the quality and reliability of robot platform and its core components. You would be responsible for testing the core operating system components of the Robot, including networking features, firewall features etc. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and usability.
   

  

 We are looking for a Backend Test engineer with strong Python automation skills who enjoys working close to the product and the code. You should be comfortable combining hands\-on manual testing with Linux Based platforms using Python\-based automated testing, while also bringing a strong understanding of ROS. If you are motivated by improving product quality through robust test coverage, fast feedback loops, and close collaboration with developers, this could be the right role for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, write, and maintain automated tests in Python for new and existing features of the operating system components of the Robot
* Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure stable and reliable releases
* Work closely with developers to understand the changes being made in the controller operating system layer or the network layer, investigate failures, and improve testability
* Contribute to and improve test frameworks
* Help define effective test strategies and quality practices across the development lifecycle in an agile setup
* Build tests that have hardware in the loop (not all flakiness comes from software)


**Qualification, Experience, Skills And Educational Background**
 To succeed in this role, we imagine you have a strong background in software test engineering and a practical mindset when it comes to combining automation with hands\-on validation. You understand how software is built, how systems fail, and how to create effective tests that increase quality and confidence.
   

  

**Skills Required**
* 4 to 6 years of experience in software backend testing, software quality engineering of OS level software components, or a similar role
* Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests in Python for backend components using tools like pytest and FastAPI.
* Experience with Penetration testing
* Experience with API Testing
* Familiarity with GoLang and its frameworks.
* Familiarity with Containerization technique (Docker, Podman)
* Proficient with linux environment and linux commands
* Linux networking stack \+ systemd (services, journald, network namespaces)
* Network analysis tooling: Wireshark/tcpdump and nmap and traffic shaping for resilience tests.
* Hands\-on experience with manual testing of complex systems, ideally involving hardware, robotics, or integrated software\-hardware solutions
* Experience creating and maintaining unit, integration, and regression tests
* Good understanding of test frameworks, debugging, and finding root causes
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, build servers, or DevOps practices such as Jenkins or similar tools
* Ability to understand complex systems, identify risks, and design effective test coverage
* Experience working in agile or scrum environments


**It Will Be Considered An Advantage If You Have**
* Familiarity with ROS2, Industrial Communication Protocols
* Familiarity with Firewall (NF Tables/IP Tables)

title: R&D Senior Software Test Engineer - IDC
description:

 At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future by enabling stronger, smarter, and more resilient power systems. Quality is central to how we deliver trusted digital solutions for customers worldwide. We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Test Engineer to join our Grid Automation team and help shape the quality of mission\-critical software used in modern energy systems.
   

  

 In this senior role, you will take ownership of complex testing activities, influence quality strategy, and collaborate with global engineering teams working on advanced Grid Automation technologies. You will contribute to scalable test practices, automation maturity, CI/CD readiness, and continuous improvement while growing your expertise in a global organization committed to innovation, sustainability, and technical excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead the definition of test objectives, test strategy, test scenarios, and execution plans for complex product and release activities.
* Identify required test environments, equipment, test data, tools, and other provisions needed for effective testing. Partner with functional leaders to ensure readiness for test start and completion in line with program schedules, including maintenance and minor releases. Report test progress, quality risks, and release readiness to the Test Manager and key stakeholders, escalating proactively when progress toward a stable, releasable product is at risk. Support and strengthen CI/CD practices across products, with a focus on expanding automation of key tests.
* Ensure defects are documented clearly, accurately, and with the technical detail needed to support efficient investigation and resolution.
* Work closely with developers, product owners, and engineering stakeholders to analyze, resolve, and verify product issues across the software lifecycle.
* Continuously strengthen testing expertise, automation skills, and domain knowledge in Grid Automation and power system software.
* Act as a senior contributor in a cross\-functional team by sharing knowledge, supporting collaboration, and helping the team deliver high\-quality outcomes aligned with shared objectives.


**Your background**
* At least 8 years of professional experience in quality assurance, software testing, or test engineering, preferably in complex software product environments.
* Strong knowledge of QA best practices, testing methodologies, quality processes, and risk\-based testing approaches.
* Hands\-on experience with low\-level testing, including API and integration testing, in microservices\-based architectures.
* Good understanding of microservices architecture and related testing areas, including message queues, Kubernetes, Docker, and distributed system behavior.
* A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to influence quality discussions across technical and cross\-functional teams.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.
* Knowledge of Python, Robot Framework, Azure DevOps, and PostgreSQL is a strong advantage.
* Experience with Jira, Helm, test automation frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines is considered an advantage.


**What We Offer**
* Flexible working time
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Excellent career development opportunities within Hitachi Energy in Bangalore and across our global engineering organization.
* Access to an employee benefit portal with thousands of discounts and perks.
* The opportunity to work on meaningful technologies that support a more sustainable, flexible, and secure energy future.

 Join Hitachi Energy and be part of a global team where your expertise in quality, automation, and software testing can make a real impact on the future of energy. If this opportunity sounds like the right next step for you, we encourage you to apply today. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so do not delay.

title: Senior Data Quality Engineer
description:
symplr is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Quality Engineer with 5\+ years of experience to execute testing initiatives for our robust Data Platform. This role is instrumental in maintaining the integrity, reliability, and performance of our data systems. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in ETL testing, data validation, AWS\-based data workflows, and Power BI reports, with a solid foundation in Test Automation and scripting. Readiness on learning/understanding new tools.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Contribute to the development and execution of data quality strategies and best practices to support the organization’s data initiatives.
* Web UI/tools testing : Create testcases and scenarios based on features and requirements.

* ETL Testing : Design and perform thorough ETL tests, including test case development, data validation, transformation accuracy, end\-to\-end pipeline testing, and performance testing.

* Power BI Reports : Ensure data accuracy and consistency in Power BI reports by validating data lineage, transformation logic, and report outputs against source systems.

* Documentation : Maintain clear and detailed documentation of testing procedures, test results, and quality metrics in addition to product/processes workflows.


**Skills Required**
* 5\+ years of experience in data quality engineering, data testing, or related fields.
* Strong hands\-on experience with ETL testing and data validation techniques.
* Experience working with AWS data services, including Glue, S3, Athena, MSK, SQS, Lambda, Step Functions, etc.
* Experience in building Automated regression test suites
* Proficiency in writing SQL and basics of any OOP languages
* Experience validating data using Power BI reports, including understanding of data models and report logic.

* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying data quality issues.
* Ensured data availability and integrity for analytics \& reporting teams.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and willingness to adapt to new technologies and techniques.


**Good To Have**
* Automation \& Scripting : Develop Python\-based scripts to automate data quality checks and validation processes.
* Experience in Conducting root\-cause analysis for data anomalies, improving issue resolution time.
* Understanding of Data warehouse tools like Redshift

title: Senior AIT Quality Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000\+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well\-being of patients everywhere.
   

  

 Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As our new Senior Quality Engineer – Computer System Validation, you will independently lead and deliver complex validation solutions of moderate size across pharmaceutical manufacturing IT projects. You will provide quality and validation leadership from requirements and design through testing, installation, handover, and project close\-out, while balancing compliance risk, delivery timelines, and operational usability. Acting as a subject matter expert, you will strengthen project execution, coach colleagues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of NNE validation processes and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Experience: 6\-8 years
   

  

 Department Manufacturing IT – Computer System Validation**
**How You Might Spend Your Days**
 As our new Senior Quality Engineer – Computer System Validation, you will:
   

  

* Lead CSV/OV strategy, validation planning, and execution activities.
* Guide teams in protocol, test plan, and validation deliverable preparation, review, and execution.
* Support FAT, SAT, UAT, IQ/OQ/PQ, defect management, deviation handling, and TIMS activities.
* Ensure compliance with NNE QMS and regulatory requirements across projects.
* Conduct and participate in risk assessments and quality reviews.
* Review requirements, design specifications, test documentation, and validation reports.
* Coordinate validation activities across IT, OT, Automation, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Oversee supplier deliverables, including SIR/SIP reviews. (if needed)
* Support project planning, estimation, progress tracking, issue resolution, and customer interactions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, training programs, and department process development.
* Support SER/SAR preparation and ensure successful project handover and documentation closeout.


**Who You Are**
 We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the effort we do as a team. As a person, you:
   

  

* Thrive in a collaborative and multicultural environment and enjoy working with colleagues, customers, and project stakeholders.
* Are structured, detail\-oriented, and committed to delivering high\-quality work in regulated project environments.
* Take ownership of your tasks and follow through with a strong sense of accountability.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Are curious and eager to learn new validation methodologies, regulatory requirements, quality standards, and industry best practices within regulated manufacturing environments.
* Have a quality mindset and understand the importance of compliance, documentation, and data integrity.
* Are proactive in identifying risks, issues, and improvement opportunities during project execution.
* Enjoy working as part of a team and supporting others through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
* Stay positive and solution\-oriented when working in complex project environments.


**What You Bring To The Role**
 In all positions there are some things that are needed, and others a bonus. We believe these qualifications are needed for you to do well in this role:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Automation, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6\-8 years of experience in Computer System Validation (CSV), Operational Verification (OV), Qualification, or Quality Assurance within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or other regulated industries.
* Strong experience in planning, reviewing, and executing validation deliverables, including Validation Plans, Risk Assessments, Traceability Matrices, FAT, SAT, UAT, IQ, OQ, PQ, and Validation Summary Reports.
* Proven experience in leading validation and quality review activities, ensuring compliance with project requirements, corporate quality standards, and regulatory expectations.
* Sound knowledge of GMP, GEP, GAMP 5, Data Integrity, Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA\+ principles, and Computerized System Validation methodologies.
* Experience in developing and reviewing Operational Verification (OV) strategies and validation approaches using risk\-based methodologies.
* Demonstrated expertise in requirements review, design review, test specification review, defect management, deviation handling, change control, and CAPA processes.
* Experience working with Test Management Information Systems (TIMS) or equivalent tools for validation and testing activities.
* Ability to conduct and facilitate risk assessments, identify compliance gaps, and drive mitigation actions throughout the project lifecycle.
* Experience coordinating with cross\-functional teams including Quality Assurance, Automation, IT/OT, Engineering, Process, Manufacturing, and Project Management.
* Knowledge of supplier quality management activities, including review and oversight of Supplier Information Requirements (SIR), Supplier Information Packages (SIP), and vendor documentation.
* Experience supporting audits, inspections, validation assessments, and ensuring projects remain audit ready.
* Strong understanding of system lifecycle management, documentation governance, validation traceability, and handover processes.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Ability to mentor and guide validation teams, provide GMP/GEP training, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to work independently while leading quality and validation activities across multiple projects and disciplines.


**Life at NNE.**
 NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.
   

  

 At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project\-based environment built on close day\-to\-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on\-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.
   

  

 We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award\-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in\-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long\-term growth.
   

  

**Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.**
**Deadline of application** 
 is – e.g. Sep 30, 2026
   

  

 Questions before applying? Please contact PVYN@nne.com
   

  

**Please note:**
 We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV
   

  

 We invite to interviews on a running basis.
   

  

**Fair hiring:** 
 At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.
   

  

**Still searching for the right opportunity?**
 If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
   

  





 Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary**




 The
 **Product Quality Engineer (** 
 PQE) is responsible for ensuring quality and reliability performance of our products, wherever they are designed, manufactured, and assembled, by performing best in class Product Qualification in accordance with international standards and customer requirements. The PQE is also responsible for Reliability Monitoring through ORT.
   

  





 The PQE works cross\-functionally with Design, Test, Manufacturing, Reliability Labs, FA Labs, and Customer/Supplier Quality to prevent defects, drive robust product quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Attend related Milestones Meetings starting at Design kick\-off through to production transfer.
* Define, perform, and review Qualification (new products, second source, material changes, design changes, process changes, …)
* Define, evaluate, and implement suitable stress tests for related product applications.
* Ensure product compliance with internal specifications, customer requirements, and applicable standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, IEC, JEDEC, AEC, etc.).
* Communicate qualification plans and data with customer (Silicon, Package and Board Level).
* Participate in risk assessments (e.g., DFMEA) and ensure mitigation actions are implemented and validated.
* Review qualification test results, assess risks, and provide quality approval for production release or change management.
* Generate and publish qualification reports.
* Handling of the resolution for qualification related issues in a timely manner.
* Coordinate failure analysis for qualification failures using electrical, mechanical, or materials analysis techniques.
* Define and implement measures jointly with related teams to achieve high product robustness.
* Highlight in timely manner potential criticalities and risks on the success of qualifications.
* Ensure lessons learned from product quality issues are systematically fed back into design and process improvements.



**Key Performance Measures**



* Qualification achievement in terms of timing, quality, and costs.
* Overall Product Quality achievement alignment to Division KPIs


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering with 8\+ years of relevant experience
* Prior team leadership experience is preferred.
* Good understanding of semiconductors and the semiconductor industry.
* Good understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes (wafer fab, assembly, test).
* Strong knowledge on industry quality, reliability standards, and qualification methodologies.
* Experience with failure analysis workflows and quality tools (FMEA, 8D, root cause analysis).
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving mindset.
* Good understanding of automotive customer or AI product customer high quality requirement.
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and with cross\-functional teams.
* Customer\-focused, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable working in a global, multicultural environment.
* Self\-motivated and business service minded.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communications skills


**Additional Information**

 Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.
   

  

  

  

 With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’
   

  

  

  

 At Renesas, you can:
   

  




* **Launch and advance your career** 
 in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.


* **Make a real impact** 
 by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.


* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** 
 in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.



 Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
   

  

 General Information:
   

  

**TC Manager Project (m/f/d)**
 For our Sustainability and Technical Compliance team, we are looking for a product integrity professional in the functional safety risk field area aka Project Functional Safety Manager (m/f/d) to perform and support an adequate risk based approach to achieve adherence to product\-related binding obligations for the risk field of technical compliance for assigned products and/or subject matter areas incl. definition of necessary tailoring.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities:**
* Perform and support the implementation of the strategy, management system and adequate risk based approach for the respective technical compliance risk field in line with higher ranking strategies and the strategic product portfolio.

* Coordinate the internal/external transfer of specific risk field related information for the assigned products and/or subject matter areas according to business interests.
* Perform qualified risk field related assessments for assigned products and exercise the right to release or withdraw products.


**Your Qualifications:**
* Having an engineering degree and at least 5\-7 years of experience in development, preferably in automotive industry.
* Experience with system engineering approaches (requirements engineering/management, functional analysis and allocation, architecture design, validation \& verification) and experience with change \& configuration management.
* Detailed knowledge and proven experience on the ISO26262 standard.
* Experience in Software Quality and process. (e.g., ASPICE, CMMI)
* Knowledge of Requirements Management tools. (e.g., DOORS, IMS\-RM, Polarion)

title: Process Integration Engineer – Parametric Test | Semiconductor Foundry
description:
**Process Integration Engineer Parametric Test \| Semiconductor Foundry** 




  





**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Onsite
 



**Experience:** 
 5 \-12 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Semiconductor Manufacturing / Foundry
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Process Integration Engineer Parametric Test** 
 to support technology development and high\-volume manufacturing for advanced semiconductor processes. The role focuses on
 **electrical parametric characterization, process monitoring, technology correlation, yield improvement, and process optimization** 
 across FEOL and BEOL manufacturing. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in wafer\-level parametric testing, statistical data analysis, device characterization, and process integration within a semiconductor foundry or IDM environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Drive process integration activities using electrical parametric test data throughout technology development and manufacturing.
* Analyze wafer acceptance test (WAT), eTest, PCM, and inline metrology data to monitor process health.
* Correlate electrical parameters with process variations, defectivity, reliability, and yield performance.

* Support technology qualification, process optimization, and production ramp activities.
* Partner with Device, Yield, Process, Equipment, Reliability, Product, and Manufacturing Engineering teams to improve technology performance.
* Perform root cause analysis of electrical failures using parametric and statistical data.
* Establish process control limits and monitor manufacturing stability through SPC.
* Support DOE planning, process characterization, and engineering change implementation.
* Generate technical reports, dashboards, and engineering documentation for technology review meetings.
* Participate in customer qualification programs and technology transfer projects.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives for process capability, yield, and manufacturing efficiency.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Technology, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5\- 12 years of experience in semiconductor wafer fabrication, foundry, or IDM manufacturing.
* Hands\-on experience with electrical parametric testing and semiconductor process integration.
* Strong understanding of CMOS manufacturing processes and semiconductor device physics.



**Technical Skills** 
**Semiconductor Process** 



* CMOS Technology
* FEOL / BEOL Integration
* Semiconductor Wafer Fabrication
* Advanced Process Nodes
* Process Characterization
* Technology Qualification



**Parametric Test** 



* Wafer Acceptance Test (WAT)
* Electrical Test (eTest)
* Process Control Monitoring (PCM)
* Parametric Characterization
* Device Characterization
* Electrical Failure Analysis



**Data Analysis** 



* Statistical Process Control (SPC)
* DOE (Design of Experiments)
* JMP
* Python
* SQL
* MATLAB
* Excel



**Yield \& Process Improvement** 



* Yield Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Process Capability Analysis
* Defect Correlation
* Reliability Correlation
* Continuous Improvement

**Job Summary**

 **Principal Post\-Silicon Validation Engineer** 
 to lead silicon bring\-up, characterization, validation, and debug of mixed\-signal image sensor products. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership, define validation strategies, drive complex debug activities, and influence product quality from development through production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead post\-silicon bring\-up, validation, characterization, and debug of mixed\-signal and image sensor products.

**Senior Analyst, Corporate Responsibility \& Sustainability Technology**
****About Us****
 We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan.  One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH here.
   

  

****About The Role****
 As
 **Senior Analyst, Corporate Responsibility \& Sustainability Technology** 
 , you will support the technology capabilities that enable PVH’s Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability agenda across ESG compliance, product and packaging sustainability, supply chain transparency, traceability, certifications and sustainable supply chain processes.
   

  

 This is a
 **techno\-functional IT role** 
 where you will help translate business, compliance and regulatory needs into practical system requirements, data flows, integrations, reporting capabilities and platform improvements.
   

  

**The Role Focuses On Three Core Pillars:**
**Platform Enablement** 
 — supporting and improving technology platforms used for ESG, traceability, certifications, product and packaging sustainability, and sustainability\-related compliance.
 **Data \& Integration Readiness** 
 — helping ensure required sustainability, traceability, product packaging and certification data is structured, connected, reliable and aligned across enterprise systems.
 **Compliance \& Audit Support** 
 — enabling traceable, auditable and reportable data to support regulatory, certification, assurance and sustainable supply chain requirements.
   

  

 The scope includes platforms and capabilities such as Workiva, Traceability (TextileGenesis, IDFactory) and Certification (AWS\-based), Power BI, and other connected enterprise systems. The role will contribute to initiatives related to regulations and frameworks such as CSRD, EUDR, Digital Product Passport, Extended Producer Responsibility, supplier due diligence and other sustainability\-related requirements.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Platform Enablement**
* Support the day\-to\-day enablement, improvement and adoption of technology platforms used for Corporate Responsibility \& Sustainability, traceability, certifications and packaging sustainability.
* Assist with configuration, access management, issue resolution, release coordination and vendor follow\-up for relevant platforms.
* Support platforms such as Workiva, TextileGenesis, ID Factory, and OSS Certifications across the enterprise.
* Partner with business, IT stakeholders, IT support team to collect requirements, document issues and propose practical improvements.
* Coordinate with external technology vendors and implementation partners to support delivery, issue resolution and roadmap alignment.
* Help identify opportunities to simplify, harmonize and improve the Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability technology landscape over time.


**Data \& Integration Readiness**
* Translate business, sustainability, traceability, certification, product and packaging requirements into clear data, system and integration requirements.
* Support data mapping, data quality checks, data standards and integration flows across PLM, VMS, ERP, Workiva, TextileGenesis, ID Factory, OSS Certifications, packaging data sources and reporting solutions.
* Support the design and testing of integrations, APIs and data exchanges between enterprise systems and external platforms.
* Work with data governance, enterprise architecture and platform teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure and aligned with PVH technology standards.
* Support Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs for operational, compliance, certification, traceability and sustainability technology use cases.


**Compliance \& Audit Support**
* Enable system and data capabilities that support ESG compliance, product and packaging sustainability, traceability, certification validation and sustainable supply chain activities.
* Support structured data capture and technology enablement for requirements such as EUDR, Digital Product Passport and other relevant sustainability regulations.
* Help ensure data used for compliance, certifications, reporting and sustainability claims is accurate, complete, traceable and auditable.
* Support certification data flows, chain\-of\-custody documentation and document verification processes across relevant systems.
* Work with Corporate Responsibility \& Sustainability, Product Compliance teams to understand sustainability and regulatory needs and translate them into system and data requirements.


****Requirements****
 The ideal candidate is a techno\-functional professional with experience in IT systems, data, integrations and reporting, combined with an understanding of sustainability, ESG, traceability, certifications, product and packaging sustainability, or supply chain compliance processes.
   

  

 The candidate should be comfortable working across business and IT teams, translating complex requirements into practical technology outcomes, and supporting global platforms and data flows.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring experience in the following areas:
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in IT systems, data, reporting, systems analysis or technology delivery, preferably in supply chain, sustainability, ESG, compliance related domains.
* Experience working in a techno\-functional role, translating business and compliance needs into system requirements, data requirements and technology improvements.
* Good understanding of Corporate Responsibility, Sustainability, ESG, traceability, certification, product sustainability, packaging sustainability or supplier/product compliance processes.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as ESG reporting tools, traceability platforms, certification systems and respective reporting solutions.
* Experience with data mapping, data quality, data standards, APIs, integrations and enterprise data exchange.
* Experience supporting SaaS or cloud\-based platforms, including configuration, access management, issue resolution, release coordination and vendor coordination.
* Experience with reporting and dashboarding tools, preferably Power BI.
* Understanding of sustainability regulations and frameworks across the supply chain (ESG related, EUDR, Digital Product Passport, EPR or similar requirements).
* Understanding of supply chain traceability concepts, material/product tracing, chain\-of\-custody documentation and sustainability certification schemas.
* Good to have: experience with Workiva or any other ESG reporting platform.
* Good to have: experience with traceability or certification platforms such as TextileGenesis, ID Factory, TrusTrace, Retraced or similar.
* Good to have: exposure to AWS\-based applications or cloud services such as S3, Lambda, Athena or Bedrock.
* Nice to have: exposure to product environmental data, packaging sustainability data, product environmental footprint.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work across global business, IT and vendor teams.
* Ability to manage priorities, document requirements clearly and support delivery of system and data improvements.
* Good project coordination and planning capabilities.
* Strong Excel skills.
* Fluency in English.

In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job\-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.*

* Working with MGO capability leads and accountable process owners, design or update clear end\-to\-end processes based on approved requirements. Show what needs to happen, who is responsible, what decisions or approvals are required, which systems and documents are used, and when an issue must be escalated.
* Help global, regional, local, and Bengaluru teams understand and adopt new or updated processes and monitor whether those processes are working as intended.
* Simplify processes wherever possible by removing unnecessary steps, reducing duplication, improving handoffs, and clarifying responsibilities.
* Support consistent global ways of working while ensuring that valid local legal, regulatory, or business requirements are clearly identified and documented.
* Work with the relevant document owners and the Medical Data Governance \& Knowledge Management Lead to ensure that process maps, SOPs, procedures, templates, checklists, training materials, and supporting guidance are aligned, current, and easy to find.
* Work with MGO and Medical Excellence \& Operations to ensure that assigned processes align with the Medical Operating System and that gaps, overlaps, unclear ownership, or broken handoffs are identified and addressed.
* Ensure that approved changes to processes, roles, governance, systems, or responsibilities are reflected in the Medical execution model and communicated to affected global, regional, local, and Bengaluru teams.


**Work Directly with MGO and Accountable Process Owners:**
* Receive functional direction from the Head, Medical Governance Office on MGO priorities and expected outcomes. Agree the scope, workplan, deliverables, timelines, and escalation needs for assigned processes, and reflect approved requirements in the Medical execution model.
* Partner with MGO capability leads and the accountable owner of each Medical activity to translate approved governance requirements into practical ways of working.
* Help clarify process ownership, responsibilities, decision points, approvals, and final accountability, and support the agreed process design and implementation.
* Bring together the appropriate partners, including Quality, Ethics \& Compliance, Legal, Privacy, DD\&T, Finance, Procurement, Medical Excellence \& Operations, regions, and local teams, when their input or approval is required.
* Facilitate process discussions and working sessions, document agreed decisions, follow up on open actions, and escalate unresolved questions to MGO or the appropriate accountable owner.


**Implement and Improve Processes:**
* Support the introduction of new or updated processes through clear implementation plans, communication, training, readiness checks, launch support, and follow\-up after implementation.
* Monitor a small set of practical measures, such as timeliness, delays, rework, overdue actions, exceptions, user feedback, and repeated process issues, to understand whether each process is working effectively.
* Lead reviews of recurring process problems, identify the underlying cause, agree practical improvements with the responsible owners, and track those improvements through completion.
* Identify opportunities for simple workflow tools or automation where they will reduce manual effort, improve consistency, or make the process easier to follow. Partner with DD\&T and system owners on any technology changes.


**DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS:**
**Technical/Functional Expertise:**
* Strong understanding of how to review, design, document, implement, and improve end\-to\-end processes in a regulated environment.
* Good knowledge of Medical Affairs operations and governance processes, including the relationship between policies, SOPs, procedures, roles, approvals, systems, records, training, and day\-to\-day execution.
* Good understanding of operating models and execution models, including how roles, decision rights, governance forums, processes, systems, measures, and handoffs work together.
* Ability to take complex or unclear requirements and turn them into simple, practical ways of working that people can understand and follow.
* Understands the difference between designing and supporting a process and owning the final governance, scientific, compliance, legal, financial, or business decision.


**Leadership:**
* Leads cross\-functional discussions and helps stakeholders reach clear and practical decisions.
* Constructively challenges unnecessary complexity, unclear responsibilities, inefficient ways of working, and repeated activities.
* Influences stakeholders across functions and geographies without relying only on formal authority.
* Maintains momentum by ensuring that decisions are documented, responsibilities are clear, and agreed actions are completed.


**Decision\-Making and Autonomy:**
* Accountable for the operational approach used to review, design, document, implement, and improve processes within the approved scope.
* Makes recommendations on how a process should work, how responsibilities should be divided, and how operational process issues should be resolved.
* Makes operational decisions within approved governance requirements and agreed decision boundaries.
* Escalates decisions that involve governance direction, policy interpretation, Medical or scientific judgment, Quality, Ethics \& Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Finance, technology ownership, or business accountability.
* Final governance requirements and decisions remain with MGO or the relevant accountable functional owner.


**Interaction:**
* Works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO leads to translate approved MGO requirements into the documented Medical execution model and practical ways of working, monitor progress, and escalate significant process issues.
* Works closely with MGO capability leads and the accountable owners of Medical activities to design, implement, and improve the processes supporting their areas.
* Maintains close alignment with the GCM Medical Operations \& Governance Lead as the formal line manager and regarding Bengaluru priorities, resources, and cross\-team dependencies.
* Partners closely with the Medical Data Governance \& Knowledge Management Lead to ensure that process documents, definitions, records, and supporting knowledge remain aligned.
* Collaborates with Audit, Inspection Readiness \& Risk Management, Medical Excellence \& Operations, Quality, Ethics \& Compliance, Legal, Privacy, DD\&T, Finance, Procurement, and global, regional, and local Medical teams.


**Innovation:**
* Looks for practical ways to make processes easier, faster, and more consistent.
* Uses digital tools, workflow solutions, automation, and AI\-enabled capabilities where they solve a clear process need and can be introduced with appropriate controls and oversight.
* Avoids automating an unclear or unnecessarily complex process before the process itself has been clarified and simplified.


**Complexity:**
* Works across different Medical activities, functions, systems, regions, and local organizations.
* Balances the need for consistent global processes with valid local legal, regulatory, or business requirements.
* Manages situations where responsibilities, requirements, or handoffs may initially be unclear and helps the appropriate owners reach agreement.
* Supports consistent implementation without taking ownership of governance strategy, policy requirements, or the final decisions of MGO and other accountable functions.


**EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business, operations, quality, healthcare administration, engineering, or a related discipline is required.
* An advanced degree or relevant certification in process improvement, change management, quality, or project management is preferred but not required.


**Experience:**
* Eight or more years of relevant professional experience, including at least four years in the biopharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience reviewing, designing, improving, or implementing cross\-functional processes.
* Experience in Medical Affairs operations, Medical governance, quality, compliance, business operations, process improvement, or a related area.
* Experience working with global, regional, and local stakeholders in a matrixed organization.
* Experience supporting the implementation of new processes, organizational change, centralization, or the transition of activities to a global capability center is preferred.
* Experience leading cross\-functional work, projects, or senior individual contributors is preferred.


**Skills:**
* Ability to understand and clearly describe an end\-to\-end process.
* Ability to identify unnecessary steps, duplication, delays, unclear responsibilities, missing checks, and difficult handoffs.
* Ability to create clear process maps, role descriptions, procedures, templates, checklists, training materials, and implementation plans.
* Strong facilitation skills and the ability to guide stakeholders toward clear and practical decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to turn recurring issues into practical improvements.
* Ability to use simple measures and stakeholder feedback to assess whether a process is working effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complicated topics in clear language.


**Behavioural Competencies:**
* Practical and solutions\-oriented, with a strong focus on making processes usable for the people who need to follow them.
* Comfortable asking questions, challenging unnecessary complexity, and clarifying unclear responsibilities.
* Collaborative and respectful, while able to hold stakeholders accountable for agreed decisions and actions.
* Organized, reliable, and able to follow work through from initial review to implementation and ongoing improvement.
* Demonstrates sound judgment and knows when a question must be escalated to MGO or another accountable function.


**Languages:**
 Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous.
   

  

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:**

* For MGO\-assigned scope, the role works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office, who provides functional direction on priorities, approved requirements, expected outcomes, workplans, and escalation of significant process matters.

title: Associate Lead Testing
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :** 
 8 \- 13 Years
   

  

**Job location :** 
 Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
   

  

 The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four\-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec\-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel\-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high\-volume
   

  

 capacity claims.
   

  

 This role is technical\-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec\-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the four\-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within\-layer composition), contract (cross\-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end\-to\-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec\-to\-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory\-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR\-Repository interceptor work, end\-to\-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured\-but\-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi\-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late\-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion\-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel\-run validation framework — for the 30\-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6\.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR\-Repository egress interceptor captures every client\-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write\-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no\-match/multi\-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end\-to\-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec\-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8\+ years of QA experience with at least 3\-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2\+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large\-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt\-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event\-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt\-expectations or dbt\-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open\-table\-format\-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel\-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups


 Nice\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec\-driven or contract\-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA\-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications


*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us* 
*!*

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Function:** 
 Engineering / Cloud Platform
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Sr. Engineering Manager
   

  

**Are you...**
* Interested in building automation that ensures the reliability and quality of foundational cloud services?
* Passionate about software engineering, API testing, distributed systems, and building quality into CI/CD?
* Excited about solving complex testing challenges across a growing SaaS platform?


 If so, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Why Esko?**
 Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140\+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.
   

  

 Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi\-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an SDET on the Cloud Platform team, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of the foundational services that power Esko's cloud products.
   

  

 You will work closely with software engineers, architects, and DevOps engineers to build automated testing for platform capabilities such as data and repository services, workflow, search, identity and access management services.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, understanding how distributed systems behave, finding difficult failure scenarios, and building automation that helps engineering teams release with confidence.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and test frameworks for cloud platform services and APIs.
* Build API, integration, contract, regression, system, and end\-to\-end tests for distributed services.
* Test complex platform behaviors including data integrity, asynchronous workflows, service interactions, authentication and authorization, and failure scenarios.
* Build performance, scalability, and reliability tests for critical platform services.
* Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback to engineering teams.
* Develop test infrastructure, test data, mocks, and tooling needed to test complex cloud services.
* Investigate failures across distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, and other diagnostic information.
* Partner with software engineers and architects to improve testability and build quality into the software development lifecycle.
* Contribute to automation standards, testing practices, and continuous improvement across the Cloud Platform team.


**Required Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in SDET, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or Test Automation roles.
* Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern programming language.
* Hands\-on experience building automated tests for REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with API, integration, regression, and system\-level testing.
* Good understanding of distributed systems and common testing challenges such as asynchronous processing, retries, failures, and service dependencies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, architects, product managers, and DevOps engineers.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications.
* Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter, Gatling or equivalent.
* Experience with API contract testing and testing event\-driven or asynchronous systems.
* Experience debugging distributed systems using observability tools, logs, metrics, and traces.
* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, or other UI automation frameworks.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within your first year, you will:
   

  

* Establish performance testing and baseline metrics for critical platform services to identify performance regressions early.
* Increase automated coverage of API, integration, reliability, and performance scenarios.
* Identify defects and failure scenarios earlier in the development lifecycle.
* Improve CI/CD quality gates and reduce dependence on manual regression testing.
* Become a trusted engineering partner who helps teams design more testable, reliable, and scalable platform services.


 At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
   

  

**Unsolicited Assistance**
 We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: HRIS Senior Associate -  Data, Reporting & Testing
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Indus HRIS Senior Associate – Techno\-Functional Data, Reporting \& Testing plays a critical role in enabling scalable, compliant, and audit\-ready HR data operations within Oracle HCM as the organization expands across countries, legal entities, and integrated systems. This role combines
 



 functional HR process understanding with technical HRIS execution, owning expanded responsibilities across HR reporting rationalization, country\-specific regulatory and audit reporting (including ISQM\-equivalent requirements), and complex testing efforts supporting entity onboarding and integrations.
 



 The Senior Associate operates with a high degree of independence may serve as a bridge between HR, Compliance, and IT by translating business and regulatory requirements into technical reporting logic, data validations, and testing outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Techno\-Functional Reporting \& Data Ownership** 



* Own and enhance HR reporting solutions within Oracle HCM (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts), translating functional HR and regulatory requirements into technical report logic.
* Collaboration on the rationalization, standardization, and streamlining of existing HR reports by assessing business usage, aligning data definitions, and eliminating duplication across countries and entities.
* Design and support country\-specific regulatory, compliance, and audit reporting, including requirements aligned to ISQM\-equivalent control frameworks.
* Perform advanced data analysis and reconciliation, validating report outputs against Oracle HCM source data and downstream integrations.
* Define and maintain functional and technical documentation, including data definitions, report logic, transformation rules, and checkpoints.



**Testing \& Integration Validation** 




 Participate and/or lead end\-to\-end testing efforts for new country/entity onboarding, configuration changes, and HR system integrations.
 



 Develop and execute detailed test scenarios and scripts that reflect real HR business processes (hire, transfer, termination, organizational changes) and country\-specific variations.
 



 Validate integrations through source\-to\-target testing, ensuring accuracy of employee, assignment, organizational, and regulatory data.
 



 Own defect triage, root cause analysis, and retesting, partnering with HRIS, IT, and vendors through resolution.
 



 Coordinate and execute regression testing for reporting, extracts, and integrations following releases or configuration changes.
 



**Controls, Audit \& Risk Management** 



* Support HRIS control frameworks by ensuring reporting and testing processes meet documented control standards and audit expectations.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready evidence, including reconciliations, test results, report logic, and approvals.
* Proactively identify data and control risks introduced by new countries, entities, or integrations and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR systems, reporting accuracy, and data controls.



**Stakeholder Partnership \& Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a techno\-functional SME for HR reporting and testing within the HRIS team.
* Collaborate with IT and integration teams to align functional requirements with technical solutions (APIs, extracts, downstream feeds).
* Mentor Associate\-level team members and contribute to continuous improvement of HRIS reporting and testing standards.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications:** 



* 4–7\+ years of experience in HRIS, HR technology, or HR data roles with both functional and technical responsibilities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle HCM data structures and reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience owning testing activities for HR processes, integrations, or multi\-entity implementations.
* Ability to translate business, regulatory, and audit requirements into technical reporting and testing solutions.
* Proven experience working in audit\-sensitive, controlled environments.
* Experience supporting multi\-country HR implementations and local regulatory reporting.
* Strong documentation, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize competing priorities and pivot focus as business needs evolve, particularly in response to regulatory deadlines, country/entity expansion, and integration\-driven dependencies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Advanced experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL.
* Exposure to system integrations (payroll, benefits, IAM, finance, data warehouse/ODS).
* Familiarity with ISQM or equivalent quality, audit, or control frameworks.
* Basic SQL or data querying skills for validation and analysis

title: Hardware Technician
description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds the hardware and software stacks that power the next generation of smart connected vehicles. From device telemetry and remote diagnostics to OTA updates, alerts, and fleet\-scale device management, Bytebeam helps teams ship connected products faster and operate them reliably in the field.
 



 A lot of what makes hardware actually work happens at the bench and on the line: a clean rework, a shorted net found with a meter, an end\-of\-line jig that catches a bad unit before it ships. The Hardware Technician is the person who makes that happen, both in our lab and at the places our products get built and deployed.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are hiring a Hardware Technician to support our automotive telematics devices across prototyping, bring\-up, production, and field integration. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is excellent with a soldering iron, comfortable with test instruments, can read schematics and board files, and can debug failures down to the component.
 



 You will not be stuck at one bench. You should be ready to travel frequently to our EMS / manufacturing partners, test locations, and customer sites to support builds, set up end\-of\-line test, and help integrate our devices into vehicles and systems.
 


 What You'll DoSoldering and Rework
 * Perform hand soldering and SMD/through\-hole rework on PCBs, including fine\-pitch components, connectors, and wires, to a clean, reliable standard.
* Build, modify, and repair prototype and production boards, including blue\-wire mods and component swaps during debug.


 Component\-Level Debugging
 * Debug board and device failures down to the component level, and help find root cause.
* Use schematics and Gerber / PCB layout files to trace nets, locate components, and probe the right test points.
* Isolate faults across power, analog, digital, and communication sections with guidance from the engineers, and document findings clearly.


 Test and Measurement
 * Use multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and bench test setups / jigs to measure, verify, and characterize device behavior.
* Set up and run test fixtures, and capture and log measurements for the team.


 End\-of\-Line Assembly and Test
 * Support end\-of\-line (EOL) assembly and test for telematics devices: assemble units, run EOL test sequences, and flag and segregate failures.
* Help build, set up, and improve EOL and functional test jigs, and keep them running on the line.


 Field and Integration Support (Travel)
 * Travel frequently to plants, test locations, and customer sites to support production builds, validation, and device integration.
* Set up test benches on site, support installation and integration of devices into vehicles/systems, and help debug issues found in the field.
* Be a reliable pair of hands and eyes for the engineering team wherever the hardware is.


 General
 * Maintain tools, instruments, ESD\-safe practices, and a clean, organized work area.
* Keep clear records of rework, test results, failures, and field observations.


 Must\-Have Skills
 * ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, or related (or equivalent hands\-on experience)
* 2\+ years hands\-on as an electronics/hardware technician (production, test, lab, or field)
* Strong hand soldering and SMD/through\-hole rework skills, including fine\-pitch work
* Ability to debug component\-level failures and trace faults on a board
* Ability to read schematics and Gerber / PCB layout files
* Hands\-on with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and bench test setups / jigs
* Familiarity with end\-of\-line (EOL) assembly and functional test
* Willing and available to travel frequently to plants, test, and customer locations
* Careful, methodical, ESD\-aware, and good at documenting what was done and observed


 Good\-to\-Have (Strong Plus)
 * Experience with automotive or telematics hardware (cellular/GNSS/CAN/OBD devices)
* Experience setting up or maintaining EOL / functional test jigs and fixtures
* Exposure to flashing/programming devices and basic firmware\-level checks
* Experience with field installation or integration of electronic devices in vehicles
* Familiarity with reading test logs, basic scripting, or test\-equipment automation
* IPC\-A\-610 / IPC J\-STD soldering awareness


 Who We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for a genuinely skilled pair of hands \- someone who takes pride in a clean rework, enjoys hunting down a stubborn fault with a scope and a schematic, and is happy to get on a flight or a train to a plant or a customer site to make a build succeed. You should be dependable, safety\- and quality\-conscious, and the kind of technician engineers trust to do it right and tell them honestly what they found.
 


 Application Note
 * Tell us about the trickiest board\-level fault you have personally found and fixed \- what the symptom was, how you traced it (instruments, schematic/Gerber), what the root cause turned out to be, and how you reworked it.

title: Senior CQV Engineer

 Your impact
   

  

 The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.

The lead will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.

* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C\&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.

* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C\&Q non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10\-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In\-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta\-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results\-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better.
