title: Head of Quality Assurance - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
 Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap” \- the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments \- kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes \- to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10\+ years
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Automotive / Mobility / Robotics / Manufacturing
   

  

**About The Role**
 Instawork Robotics creates the highest\-quality, highest\-diversity datasets for robotics and physical AI. We work with many of the most important robotics builders and research labs to solve the most important challenge in robotics \- closing the data gap.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head of QA** 
 with 10\+ years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, mobility, robotics, or a closely related industry. This person will own the end\-to\-end quality and data\-labeling function across
 **Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Visual Inspection, and process quality** 
 .
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can build quality systems from the ground up, establish rigorous processes, lead teams, and drive a strong quality culture across operations and engineering.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the QA/QC function: Build and lead the overall quality strategy, processes, standards, and KPIs across operations and manufacturing.
* Visual \& Product Quality: Establish robust visual inspection and defect detection processes, including inspection standards, sampling methodologies, defect classification, and root\-cause analysis.
* Quality Systems: Design and implement SOPs, inspection protocols, quality gates, audit mechanisms, CAPA, and continuous improvement processes.
* Team Leadership: Build, manage, and develop high\-performing QA/QC teams across locations and functions.
* Cross\-functional Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Product teams to identify and eliminate recurring quality issues.
* Data \& Metrics: Build quality dashboards and drive metrics such as defect rates, first\-pass yield, rework, rejection rates, customer complaints, and quality escapes.
* Supplier \& Process Quality: Drive supplier quality, incoming inspection, in\-process quality, and final inspection standards.
* Root Cause \& Continuous Improvement: Lead RCA, corrective/preventive actions, and quality improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.


**What We're Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in QA/QC, preferably in the automotive, manufacturing, robotics, mobility, electronics, or hardware industry.
* Strong experience setting up and scaling multi\-layer quality functions and processes from the ground up.
* Experience leading QA and data\-labeling operations for Petabyte\-scale pipelines of real\-world data
* Experience working closely with machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or AI researchers on high\-quality AI training datasets.
* Experience managing large or distributed QA/QC teams.
* Strong knowledge of root\-cause analysis, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC, and quality management systems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to quality.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* A hands\-on, high\-ownership mindset — someone who is comfortable being on the floor, solving problems, and building processes rather than just managing them.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949\.
* Exposure to computer vision, automated inspection, AI\-based visual QA, or robotics.
* Experience in a fast\-scaling startup or high\-growth manufacturing environment.
* Six Sigma / Quality certification.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: AI QA Specialist
description:
**About PeopleHum**
 peopleHum is a Human Capital Platform, built for the next decade, we're on a mission to transform "The Future of Work". The winner of the 2019 Global Codie award, used by organizations around the world.
   

  

 It is an intuitive, agile and integrated platform built for a complete multi\-generational employee experience, from hiring to performance, engagement and HRMS, with the power of machine learning and automation.
   

  

 Find out more \- https://www.peoplehum.com
   

  

**Role Overview**
 PeopleHum is an AI\-native Human capital global platform built on a microservices architecture with event\-driven pipelines and deep LLM integrations on the Java stack. We are looking for a QA Specialist who can own quality end\-to\-end from writing automation frameworks and API test suites to performance benchmarking and production monitoring using and for testing AI agentic systems. This is not a “write test cases and throw them over the wall” role. You will own the quality of features from requirement to production, collaborate directly with backend and frontend developers, and build the automation infrastructure that keeps our platform reliable. As our AI agents make autonomous decisions (payroll calculations, employee workflows, HR automation), testing their correctness, safety, and edge\-case behavior is critical and we need someone excited by that challenge.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Quality Ownership Mindset:
   

  

* You believe quality starts before a line of code is written not something tested for in the final phase
* You work to prevent defects, not just find them reviewing requirements and designs for testability before development begins
* You own quality culture on your team, not just test execution
* You are well versed with new age AI technologies for AI engineering and have show interest working in Agentic build environments.
* You are interested in vibe coding, AI and running QA As a service.


**Advocacy \& Risk Communication**
* You are a quality advocate you raise concerns about risks early, suggest design changes that enhance testability, and don’t stay silent when something feels off
* You communicate quality issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, with data and impact, not just bug counts
* You have the confidence to push back on shipping when quality isn’t there, while being pragmatic about deadlines


**Collaboration \& Partner, Not Gatekeeper**
* You are embedded in the development team participating in sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives with valuable insights, not just status updates
* You collaborate with developers during design and implementation, not just after code is written
* You bring both the developer and user perspective to conversations part detective, part engineer, part customer advocate


**Critical Thinking \& Analytical Skills**
* You have a curious, analytical mindset investigating issues to their root cause, not just logging symptoms
* You think in edge cases identifying the scenarios that others miss and prioritizing testing based on risk and impact
* You can compromise between perfect coverage and good\-enough results while staying flexible under pressure


**Proactive Behaviour \& Gap Identification**
* You provide input on potential quality issues during the design phase before coding starts
* You continuously learn about new testing approaches, tools, and methodologies without waiting to be trained
* You identify flaws in processes and drive improvements, not just report them


**Documentation \& Communication Discipline**
* You write clear, actionable bug reports with precise reproduction steps not vague descriptions
* You create test documentation that is understandable and maintainable by others on the team
* You articulate technical issues in a way that helps developers fix problems faster


**Product Curiosity \& User Empathy**
* You think like a user understanding workflows, personas, and real world usage patterns to design meaningful test scenarios
* You are genuinely curious about the product, not just the test framework you want to understand what users care about and test accordingly
* You are excited by the challenge of testing AI agents that make autonomous decisions payroll, HR workflows, compliance where correctness isn’t optional


 Must have skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, and TestNG/JUnit is essential because this role expects end\-to\-end automation ownership.
* Solid knowledge of REST Assured, Postman, and API validation is a must, since the platform is built on microservices and AI\-integrated services.
* Experience with Apache JMeter and understanding response times, throughput, SLA validation, and bottleneck analysis is very important.
* Good coding ability in Java is critical, with added value from Python and TypeScript/JavaScript for automation and test utilities.
* Since this is an AI\-native platform, understanding LLMs, AI agents, non\-deterministic outputs, guardrail testing, hallucination detection, and AI API testing is one of the biggest differentiators.
* Knowledge of Git, microservices, REST/Kafka communication, and SQL basics is necessary to test reliably in a real engineering environment.


 Good to have skills
   

  

* Knowledge of Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD is very valuable because QA automation is much stronger when it is fully tied into build and deployment pipelines.
* Being able to run tests in containers and set up stable test environments is a big plus, especially in modern microservices\-based products.
* Since the platform uses event\-driven workflows, understanding how to test Kafka message production and consumption is highly useful.
* Experience with Cucumber/Gherkin or Robot Framework helps in writing clear, behavior\-driven scenarios that improve collaboration between QA, developers, and product teams.
* Familiarity with Axe\-core/WCAG validation and OWASP ZAP adds strong value because it improves both usability and product safety.
* Experience with tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cody is a strong advantage for speeding up test automation and working efficiently in an AI\-heavy engineering setup.
* Modern code\-first performance testing tools are highly valuable because they fit well into CI/CD workflows and are more flexible for engineering teams than traditional load\-testing setups.
* This is especially important in microservices\-based systems because it helps validate API boundaries and prevents service\-to\-service integration issues early.
* A very strong plus because it enables isolated, Docker\-backed test environments, making integration testing more reliable and production\-like.
* A useful frontend\-focused E2E testing tool with a strong developer experience, especially valuable for faster debugging and tighter collaboration with frontend teams.
* These are great to have because shift\-left security scanning improves product quality early in the pipeline and reduces risk before release.
* This stands out because observability\-driven testing is becoming very important in modern distributed systems, especially for tracing failures across services.

title: Service Quality & Operations Lead (CX Lead)
description:
**Who we are** 




 Founded in 2014 by Richa Singh and Puneet Manuja, YourDOST is one of India's first and largest holistic emotional wellness organisations. We help corporations, colleges and government organisations build resilient communities.
 



  





 We are enabling leading corporates including, CK Birla Group, UpGrad, and educational institutions like IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, and IIM Bangalore to name a few. We believe in using a three\-pronged approach for building a holistic emotional wellness program \- Awareness, Training, and Individual Counseling.
 



 We work with them through awareness modules, self\-help tools, 1on1 counseling intervention, and organisation\-level diagnostic and reporting.
 



  





 Our offerings include Product Led Engagement, Assessments, 24x7 Instant Connect With Qualified Therapists, Leadership Programs, Manager Training and much more. We have partnered with 500\+ clients including Corporates, Educational Institutions, and Government organisations counseling over 20 lakh Indians to date.
 



  





 To learn more about us please visit www.yourdost.com
 



  





**About the job** 




 We are looking for an analytical, structured, and technology\-driven CX
 
 Lead
 
 to improve the quality and efficiency of our end\-to\-end service delivery. This is a cross\-functional role working closely with Operations, Customer Support, Expert Teams, Clinical, Product, Technology, and Customer Success. The person will own key areas such as counselling adherence, expert supply and utilisation, customer and expert support, service quality, operational dashboards, process improvement, and automation.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Monitor and improve counselling adherence, cancellations, no\-shows, delays, and service failures\- identify patterns, investigate root causes, and drive corrective actions.
* Own expert availability, utilisation, demand\-supply balance, and capacity planning\- ensure clients always have access to the right experts at the right time.
* Strengthen customer and expert support processes escalation management, resolution workflows, SLA compliance, and experience quality.
* Define and monitor operational KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, and dashboards that give leadership real\-time visibility into service health.
* Surface recurring issues, conduct structured root\-cause analysis, and lead process redesign initiatives across teams.
* Build scalable SOPs, workflows, and governance mechanisms that the business can actually run on.
* Partner with Product and Technology to automate manual, high\-effort processes using no\-code tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and process digitisation.
* Drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, expert experience, service quality, and operational efficiency.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Must\-haves:** 



* 5\+ years in operations, service delivery, customer support, or customer experience
* Strong analytical skills\- comfortable drawing actionable conclusions from data and dashboards
* Experience managing cross\-functional and customer\-facing operations at scale
* Hands\-on with CRM platforms, support tools, and spreadsheets
* Working knowledge of automation, no\-code tools, and process digitisation
* Strong communication and stakeholder management\- able to influence without authority
* Ability to handle sensitive user and expert concerns with empathy and maturity



  





**Good to have:** 



* Experience in healthcare, mental health or wellness
* Familiarity with quality frameworks\- CSAT, NPS, first\-response time, escalation rate
* Prior exposure to platform\-based or marketplace operations



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Counselling adherence and service fulfillment rates improve quarter on quarter
* Expert supply gaps are anticipated\- not discovered after a client complains
* Customer and expert satisfaction scores trend upward
* Support resolution time drops and the same issues stop recurring
* Leadership has real\-time operational visibility, not retrospective reporting
* High\-effort manual processes are automated or eliminated
* Cross\-functional teams are aligned on quality standards and shared processes



  





**What We Offer** 



* 5\-day work week
* Health insurance coverage
* Access to YourDOST's mental health and wellness services for you and your loved ones.
* An inclusive, growth\-oriented culture focused on learning, collaboration, and impact.
* Opportunity to work with a mission\-driven organization focused on emotional well\-being.

**QA ENGINEER**
**Overview**
 Tintri, a DDN company, builds enterprise storage platforms that power mission\-critical virtualized environments. Our QA Engineering team is the last line of defense before every VMstore release reaches a customer, validating everything from core storage protocols and hardware resiliency to hypervisor integrations and data\-at\-rest encryption. We're looking for a QA Engineer who's equally comfortable writing automation code and getting hands\-on with real storage hardware, someone who enjoys tracing a defect back to its root cause as much as designing the test that caught it in the first place.
   

  

 You'll work closely with development throughout the release cycle, not just at the end of it, helping define what "tested" actually means for a given feature before it's built, then proving it once it is. This is a role for someone who wants deep, hands\-on exposure to enterprise storage internals (NVMe, RAID, encryption, hypervisor ecosystems) while building the automation that lets the whole team move faster and with more confidence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, automate and execute test plans and test cases for the storage platforms.
* Build and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts.
* Clear understanding of defect life cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to understand requirements and define the test strategies.
* Perform root cause analysis of defects and drive issues to resolution.
* Conduct sanity, smoke, performance and stress test coverage.
* Document test execution processes and results.


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong programming ability with hands\-on experience in one or more scripting languages (preferably Python).
* Good understanding of NVMe, SAS, and SATA concepts.
* Hands\-on experience in Linux troubleshooting \& debugging.
* Experience with any one of the hypervisors.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of NAS \& SMB protocols.
* Storage platform components understanding, including SSD, DIMM, RAID, IPMI, and BMC.
* Storage encryption concepts.


**Education \& Experience**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

The company is renowned for its culture of innovation, holding over 100,000 patents and producing iconic products such as Post\-it® Notes, Scotch® Tape, and N95 respirators. With a workforce exceeding 90,000 employees across more than 70 countries, 3M serves customers in nearly every industry and market segment worldwide.
   

  

 3M’s mission is to apply science in collaborative ways to improve lives daily, leveraging its deep expertise in materials science, manufacturing, and product development. The company consistently ranks among the most admired and respected corporations globally, recognized for its sustainability initiatives, research and development capabilities, and global reach. In recent years, 3M has been in the news for its role in supplying critical personal protective equipment during the COVID\-19 pandemic, as well as for its ongoing efforts to address environmental and legal challenges related to PFAS chemicals.

title: QA Associate Analyst, E2E [T500-29425]
description:
**About A\&F Co:** 




 At ANSR, we operate A\&F Co. Bengaluru, a hub of digital transformation delivering services exclusively to our client, Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.). A\&F Co. is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.
 



 Now is your opportunity to join us and develop dynamic tech solutions to meet the needs of A\&F Co.’s rapidly growing global business. For over 20 years now, companies cutting across size, industry and markets have relied on our expertise to successfully build global business and technology teams. We can help you land a rewarding career in this dynamic industry.
 



 Here, you’ll be part of a team working on Digital Engineering \& Architecture, Data \& Analytics and Digital Operations to build inclusive experiences and outstanding products. Ready to usher in a digital revolution? Apply today.
 



 Disclaimer: Candidates will initially be employed under ANSR and subsequently transitioned to A\&F Co. Bengaluru.
 



  





**QA Associate Analyst –Enterprise Systems** 




**About the Role:** 




**We are looking for a QA Associate Analyst to support quality validation across our enterprise and ERP platforms, including Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and** 




 related integrations.
 



**This is an early\-career, hands\-on role focused on building strong testing fundamentals,** 
 understanding enterprise business workflows, and learning how large\-scale systems interact. You will execute test cases, validate data and workflows, log defects, and support regression and end\-to\-end testing—while learning automation and modern quality practices under guidance.
 



**This role is ideal for individuals starting their career in Quality Engineering who want to grow into more technical, automation\-focused QE roles over time.** 




  





**What You’ll Do:** 




**Execute Hands\-On Testing for Enterprise Systems:** 



* Execute manual and exploratory test cases for enterprise applications and workflows.
* Validate features against acceptance criteria, business rules, and documented requirements.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains stable as changes are introduced.
* Support end\-to\-end testing across systems that exchange data or depend on shared configurations.



  





**Support Data \& Integration Validation:** 



* Validate data accuracy across screens, reports, interfaces, and downstream systems.
* Assist in testing batch jobs, scheduled processes, and integration hand\-offs.
* Compare expected vs. actual results for calculations, rules, and configuration\-driven behavior.
* Help identify data mismatches, missing records, or processing errors.



  





**Participate as Part of an Agile Team:** 



* Participate in sprint ceremonies such as stand\-ups, refinement, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product partners to clarify requirements.
* Ask questions early to ensure test scenarios are well understood before execution.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, and defects clearly.



  





**Support Automation \& Modern Quality Practices (Under Guidance):** 



* Execute existing automated tests and report failures or flakiness.
* Assist senior QEs and developers with test data setup for automation.
* Learn API testing, basic scripting, and automation frameworks used by the team.
* Contribute to improving regression coverage over time.



  





**Defect Tracking \& Continuous Learning:** 



* Log clear, actionable defects with reproduction steps and evidence.
* Re\-test fixes and validate resolutions.
* Review production issues to understand root causes and prevention opportunities.
* Build domain knowledge of enterprise systems and business processes continuously.



  





**What You Bring:** 




**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2–3 years of experience in software testing, QA, or a related role.
* Understanding of basic software testing concepts (test cases, defects, regression).
* Exposure to manual testing of business or backend systems.
* Basic familiarity with APIs, data validation, or SQL concepts (academic or practical).
* Exposure to enterprise systems, ERP platforms, or data\-driven applications(Oracle ERP/SAP/Microsoft Dynamics).
* Comfortable working with test management or defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, qTest).
* Good at Debugging and root cause analysis
* Willingness to learn complex systems and ask questions.
* Strong attention to detail and reliability in executing assigned work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Familiarity with REST APIs and JSON payloads.
* Basic scripting or automation exposure (JavaScript, Python, or similar).
* Experience working in Agile teams.
* Interest in growing toward Quality Engineer or Software Engineering roles.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 Enterprise platforms power critical business decisions and operations. As a QA Associate
 **Analyst, you help ensure that features work as expected, data remains accurate, and defects** 




**are caught early.** 




**This role is a foundational entry point into an engineering\-led quality organization—providing hands\-on experience, structured learning, and a clear growth path toward Quality Engineer I and beyond.** 




  





**Benefits \& Perks:** 




 As an Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.) associate in our India Global Capability Center (GCC), you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A\&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward
 


* Comprehensive group medical insurance covering associate, spouse, children, and parents/in\-laws
* Outpatient medical and wellness allowance for associates and dependents
* Associate assistance program offering confidential counseling for mental, financial, and legal support
* Access to fertility, adoption, and family\-forming benefits through Carrot
* Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace
* Paid Caregiver leave
* Comprehensive paid leave programs, including earned leave and casual/sick leave
* Paid public and national holidays each year
* Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles and six work from anywhere weeks per year)
* Seven associate wellness half days per year
* Onsite meal program including daily lunch and pantry snacks/beverages
* Transportation support with point\-to\-point pickup and drop\-off
* Creche/daycare reimbursement support for working parents
* Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within
* Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

title: Quality Testing Associate Analyst
description:
3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a diversity of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
 As a Quality Testing Associate Analyst, You Will Have The Opportunity To Tap Into Your Curiosity And Collaborate With Some Of The Most Innovative People Around The World. Here, You Will Make An Impact By
   

  

  

* Support QA/Test Management in planning and executing testing across SAP and integrated applications.
* Perform manual, functional, regression, retesting, and UAT support based on requirements, scenarios, and test cases.
* Prepare, review, maintain, and execute test cases while documenting test evidence and results.
* Identify, log, track, retest, and close defects using Jira with proper descriptions, screenshots, severity, and priority.
* Use qTest to manage test cases, track execution, maintain defect status, and support requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability.
* Prepare test status reports and metrics in Excel, coordinate with SAP/business teams, follow QA standards, and escalate risks or blockers on time.


**Your Skills And Expertise**
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* 0–2 years of experience in Software Testing, QA, SAP Testing, or a related area.
* Basic understanding of SDLC, STLC, manual testing concepts, defect lifecycle, Excel, and clear documentation of test results and defects.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with willingness to learn SAP applications, testing tools, and enterprise testing processes.


**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**
* Basic exposure to qTest for test management and Jira for defect logging, tracking, and workflow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for test tracking, reporting, data analysis, and basic formulas.
* Basic understanding of SAP Testing / Quality \& Test Management and overview of SAP modules such as MM, SD, OTC, and MTD.


**Work Location:** 
 Hebbal, Bangalore (Karnataka), Hybrid Mode
   

  

**Supporting Your Well\-being**
 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
   

  

 Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.
   

  

 Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.
   

  

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1\) uploading a resume, or 2\) entering the information into the application fields directly.**
**3M Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**
 Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at 3M are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.
   

  

 Please click on the following links and select the country where you are applying for employment to review the applicable Terms of Use (link here) and Privacy Policy (link here). Before submitting your application, you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.

title: Senior Test Analyst Professional
description:
**About the Company** 




 Naviam partners with organizations worldwide to streamline their asset management journey through an unparalleled combination of expertise, innovative solutions, and unwavering commitment.
 



 Born from the unification of seven industry leaders and backed by over three decades of experience, Naviam delivers cutting\-edge enterprise asset management (EAM) solutions and services. Our approach is built on flexibility, collaboration, and partnership—allowing us to provide highly tailored solutions that dynamically evolve with our customers' changing needs.
 



 With our expanded scale and deep industry expertise, we navigate the complexities of modern asset management, introducing new ways of thinking and unlocking innovative technologies that drive impact and lasting value for organizations globally.
 



**Main Purpose:** 




**We are looking for a detail\-oriented Senior QA Tester to join our quality assurance team. In this role, you will collaborate closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability. The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences, possesses strong analytical skills, and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.** 




  





**Specific Responsibilities:** 





 \- Perform functional, integration, regression, and acceptance testing for new and existing features.
 





 \- Perform Automation/Performance testing and maintain test run via pipeline
 





 \- Identify, document, and track software defects using a bug tracking system.
 





 \- Verify and validate fixes through retesting, ensuring resolved issues meet quality standards.
 





 \- Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define quality goals and ensure successful software deliveries.
 





 \- Communicate test progress, test results, and other relevant information to stakeholders promptly.
 





 \- Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve identified defects.
 





 \- Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance the quality and efficiency of testing activities.
 





 \- Keep up to date with industry best practices, tools, and technologies to optimize QA processes.
 





 \- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for test procedures and testing outcomes.
 





 \- Provide clear, concise, and actionable insights to inform product decisions and enhance quality.
 




  





**Skill Requirements \- Essential:** 





 \- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
 





 \- 8\+ years of experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
 





 \- Proficiency in testing methodologies, including functional, regression testing.
 





 \- Maximo knowledge required to help plan and execute numerous projects.
 





 \- Experience with test automation frameworks/tools (e.g., WebdriverIO) or with Performance Testing tool (eg., NeoLoad) is highly desirable.
 





 \- Conduct thorough code reviews and provide meaningful feedback by following established PR review standards and best practices.
 





 \- Basic understanding of programming languages or scripting (e.g., Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML) is a plus.
 





 \- Familiarity with tracking systems (e.g., ADO, Jira, ALM) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
 





 \- Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality results in a fast\-paced environment.
 





 \- Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
 





 \- Solid communication skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 





 \- Ability to prioritize tasks, handle multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing requirements.
 





 \- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 





 \- Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging testing trends.
 




  





**Skill Requirements \- Preferable:** 





 \- DevOps Methodology work experience.
 





 \- Demonstrates strong multitasking skills and effectively manages multiple priorities while maintaining the quality of deliverables.
 





 \- Certification in ISTQB/relevant work domain.
 




  





**Person Specification/Attributes:** 




 \- Professional and committed, with a disciplined approach to work.
 



 \- Motivated and driven by finding and providing solutions to problems.
 



 \- Polite, tactful, helpful, empathic nature, able to deliver to the needs of customers.
 



 \- Has respect for others and their views.
 



 \- Technology minded and focused, enthusiastic about technologies.
 



 \- Analytical, able to raise from the detail and see the bigger picture.
 



 \- Dedicated to continually updating and upgrading own knowledge.
 



 \- Carries a mind\-set of continuous improvement, constantly looking for better and more efficient ways of doing things.
 


* \- Values quality at the centre of all things in work.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer - Management Representative
description:
We are looking for an experienced QMR / AS9100D Certification Lead to take complete, hands\-on ownership of building and certifying the company’s AS9100D Aerospace Quality Management System (AQMS) — from Gap Assessment through QMS implementation, internal audits, Management Review, and Certification Body Stage 1 \& 2 audits, to final certification. This is an implementation role, not a documentation or QC role, and requires independently driving the project across all functions while working directly with Top Management.
 


**Key Responsibilities** 

 ●     Conduct AS9100D Gap Assessment and build the implementation roadmap; map QMS processes, procedures, and records; set Quality Policy, objectives, KPIs, and risk/opportunity management.
 



 ●     Own Certification Body coordination end\-to\-end: planning, Stage 1 \& Stage 2 audit preparation, finding closure, and surveillance\-audit readiness.
 



 ●     Implement aerospace\-specific controls: risk management, product safety, configuration management, counterfeit parts prevention, traceability, special processes, AS9102 FAI, and change management.
 



 ●     Run the internal audit programme and Management Review cycle — audit planning, auditor training, NCR/CAPA, root\-cause analysis, and effectiveness verification.
 



 ●     Establish and manage supplier quality: qualification, Approved Supplier List, risk assessment, performance monitoring, audits, and NCR/CAPA.
 



 ●     Ensure customer/contract quality requirements are identified, reviewed, and flowed into operations; interface with Sales, Engineering, Procurement, and Operations.
 



 ●     Control QMS documentation and records (manual, procedures, inspection/calibration/training/audit records) and maintain a Quality Dashboard (complaints, OTD, NCR/CAPA, audit and calibration status, COPQ) for Top Management reporting.
 



  




**Must\-Have Qualifications \& Experience** 

 ●     B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Aerospace, Production, Electrical, Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
 



 ●     7\-10 years total experience, including minimum 5 years in Quality/QMS leadership.
 



 ●     Aerospace / Defence / Aviation / high\-reliability engineering background.
 



 ●     Strong working knowledge of AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015; formal Internal Auditor training.
 



 ●     Experience with Certification Body audits, NCR/CAPA systems, root\-cause analysis, and supplier quality.
 



 ●     Comfortable presenting QMS performance to Top Management and driving cross\-functional teams.
 



  




**Preferred / Desirable** 

 ●     Experience with aerospace/defence manufacturing, avionics, precision engineering, MRO, or government/defence customers (HAL, DRDO, IAF, Indian defence ecosystem).
 



 ●     Practical, hands\-on experience implementing or significantly upgrading an AS9100D QMS (not just maintaining an already\-certified system).
 



 ●     Personally led at least one complete AS9100 certification cycle: Gap Assessment → Documentation → Implementation → Internal Audit → Management Review → Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Certification.
 



 ●     Exposure to customer/supplier audits, AS9102 FAI, Configuration Management, Product Safety, and Counterfeit Parts Prevention.
 



 ●     AS9100D / ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, ASQ CQA/CQE, or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt (valuable, not mandatory if hands\-on implementation experience is strong).
 



 ●     PG qualification in Quality Management.
 



  




**Reporting \& Authority** 

 Reports directly to the Managing Director/CEO, with functional authority across Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Inspection, Stores, Projects, Sales/Contracts, and Administration, and unrestricted access to Top Management on QMS and certification matters.
 



  




**Success Criterion** 

 Successful AS9100D certification of the company’s defined scope, followed by a sustainable QMS that passes subsequent surveillance audits and meets customer and aerospace/defence quality requirements.

title: Peformance Test Architect
description:
Non Functional Testing Architect
 



 Location \- Bangalore
 



  





  





 Required Qualifications
 



  





 10\+ years in software QA/testing with at least 5 years focused exclusively on Non\-Functional Testing (performance, load, stress, security) for enterprise\-grade web applications.
 



 Proven track record of architecting and driving NFT programs end\-to\-end — from customer NFR workshops through tooling setup, test execution, and executive\-level reporting.
 



 Hands\-on proficiency with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or k6, and security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Nessus, or Qualys.
 



 Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure (App Services, Azure Load Testing, Azure Monitor, Application Insights) and its impact on application performance and security posture.
 



 Experience with APM and observability platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, or New Relic) for performance profiling, bottleneck isolation, and capacity planning.
 



 Strong communication and consulting skills — ability to run NFR definition sessions with customers, present risk\-rated findings to non\-technical stakeholders, and align cross\-functional teams on quality gates.
 



 Tech Stack
 



  





 · JMeterLocustGatlingk6OWASP ZAPBurp SuiteNessus / QualysAzure DevOpsAzure Load TestingApplication InsightsDatadogDynatracePlaywrightPythonDocker / Kubernetes
 



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 



  





 Certifications in performance testing (ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or security testing (CEH, OSCP, or relevant Azure security certifications).
 



 Experience with UI/UX performance measurement tools (Google Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Core Web Vitals) for page responsiveness and load\-time optimization on B2B portals.
 



 Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment — managing NFT deliverables, customer expectations, and multi\-stakeholder engagements simultaneously.
 



 Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and shift\-left security integration within Azure\-based CI/CD workflows.
 



 Exposure to accessibility testing standards (WCAG 2\.1\) relevant to enterprise B2B web applications.
 



  





  





  





 Roles \& Responsibilities
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Define and own the end\-to\-end Non\-Functional Testing strategy and framework covering performance, load, stress, UI/UX responsiveness, and security vulnerability testing for an Azure\-hosted B2B web application.
 



 Lead customer\-facing NFR requirement workshops — translate business expectations into measurable test criteria, SLA thresholds, and acceptance gates in collaboration with product and engineering stakeholders.
 



 Evaluate, select, and onboard the NFT tooling stack; establish standards for load simulation, vulnerability scanning, and frontend performance profiling suited to the Azure platform.
 



 Design realistic workload models, test scenarios, and data strategies for load and stress testing that reflect B2B usage patterns, peak traffic, and failure conditions.
 



 Plan and execute security vulnerability assessments (VAPT) aligned to OWASP Top 10; coordinate with DevSecOps teams to log, prioritize, and track remediation of findings.
 



 Integrate NFT suites into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, establishing automated performance gates and regression baselines that block releases when thresholds are breached.
 



 Monitor application performance using APM tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, or Application Insights); analyse bottlenecks and provide root\-cause analysis with actionable optimization recommendations.
 



 Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA engineers — providing technical direction, script/code reviews, and hands\-on guidance during test execution, triage, and reporting to both technical and business audiences

title: Test Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Test is a crucial time in an IC development process; if you find a bug or an issue, it is a good time to fix it, but every additional second of testing we do, is additional cost when you scale a device into production. So, test engineers must identify the critical points of the device where testing is most necessary and the points where we may want to take some risk. It is a precise balance, that has the potential to save our businesses millions of dollars!
   

  

 Test engineers spend a good amount of time in the lab and when they're not there, they are designing test hardware using software tools like cadence and building test programs on an ATE simulator, or troubleshooting – the programs or the device.
   

  

**Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP)**
 Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and data centers are just a few of the trends driving the need for high\-current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise market. The Multiphase Processor Power product line is focused on bringing to market the multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus power FETs with integrated sensing) solutions for enterprise computing and other ASICs that are power hungry and require very high currents (can be 1000A\+). The MPP team actively collaborates with TI’s advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level.
   

  

**About The Job**
 At TI, Test Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands\-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. description:
Experienced Post Silicon Validation required to drive Analog and PMIC validation, characterization, and bench\-testing activities. The ideal candidate will have proven experience leading validation teams, developing comprehensive validation strategies, automating bench measurements, and debugging complex silicon issues through close collaboration with Analog Design, System, Product, Applications, and Test Engineering teams.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Working on end\-to\-end post\-silicon validation and characterization of analog IPs and PMIC devices.
* Define validation strategy, test plans, coverage matrices, schedules, and execution milestones.
* Own validation execution across pre\-silicon readiness, first silicon bring\-up, characterization, qualification, and production support.
* Review specifications, design documents, schematics, datasheets, and validation requirements.
* Develop and execute detailed bench\-validation procedures for:
	+ Functional validation
	+ DC and AC electrical characterization
	+ Power, voltage, current, and thermal measurements
	+ Accuracy, efficiency, line/load regulation, and transient response
	+ Protection features such as OVP, UVLO, OCP, OTP, and short\-circuit response
	+ Power sequencing, startup/shutdown, ramp behavior, and fault recovery
	+ Corner, stress, and limit testing
* Build and maintain automated validation frameworks using Python, NI PXI, TestStand, LabVIEW, and related bench\-automation environments.
* Develop reusable test scripts, drivers, measurement utilities, data\-logging modules, and report\-generation solutions.
* Integrate oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, SMUs, source\-measure units, spectrum/network analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.
* Debug silicon, board, firmware, software, and measurement\-related failures using systematic root\-cause\-analysis techniques.
* Analyze characterization data, identify trends and anomalies, and provide technically sound conclusions.
* Own validation reports, defect documentation, failure analysis summaries, and executive\-level status updates.
* Coordinate with global engineering teams and communicate risks, dependencies, silicon issues, and schedule impact.
* Mentor engineers in bench validation, automation, debugging, data analysis, and effective documentation practices.
* Drive continuous improvement in validation coverage, automation efficiency, test quality, and execution processes.











 Required Technical Skills
 



 Analog and PMIC Validation
 


* Strong hands\-on experience in analog IC and PMIC post\-silicon validation.
* Expertise in validating power\-management functions such as:
	+ LDOs
	+ Buck and boost converters
	+ Charge pumps
	+ Battery\-management circuits
	+ Voltage/current references
	+ ADC/DAC interfaces
	+ Power\-path and charging solutions
	+ Protection and monitoring blocks

* Experience validating silicon against electrical specifications, datasheet requirements, and design targets.
* Exposure to silicon debug, failure isolation, characterization limits, and engineering change recommendations.

title: QA Engineer 1, E2E [T500-29426]
description:
**About A\&F Co:** 




 At ANSR, we operate A\&F Co. Bengaluru, a hub of digital transformation delivering services exclusively to our client, Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.). A\&F Co. is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.
 



 Now is your opportunity to join us and develop dynamic tech solutions to meet the needs of A\&F Co.’s rapidly growing global business. For over 20 years now, companies cutting across size, industry and markets have relied on our expertise to successfully build global business and technology teams. We can help you land a rewarding career in this dynamic industry.
 



 Here, you’ll be part of a team working on Digital Engineering \& Architecture, Data \& Analytics and Digital Operations to build inclusive experiences and outstanding products. Ready to usher in a digital revolution? Apply today.
 



 Disclaimer: Candidates will initially be employed under ANSR and subsequently transitioned to A\&F Co. Bengaluru.
 



  





**Quality Engineer I – Enterprise Systems** 




**About the Role:** 




**We are looking for a Quality Engineer I (QE I) to support quality execution across our ERP and product\-facing enterprise systems, including Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation,** 
 Inventory, and related integrations.
 



 In this role, you will work closely with engineers, product partners, and senior quality engineers to validate business workflows, data flows, and system behavior across complex, interconnected
 **platforms. You will focus on learning enterprise business processes, executing well\-designed test scenarios, and contributing to automation\-first quality practices.** 




**This is an early\-career growth role for engineers who are curious about how large\-scale** 
 systems work end\-to\-end and want to build strong foundations in enterprise quality engineering.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 




**Support Quality and Operations Across Enterprise Workflows:** 



* Execute test cases for enterprise business processes across Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and downstream systems.
* Validate functional behavior against requirements, acceptance criteria, and documented workflows.
* Identify defects related to business logic, data issues, integrations, or configuration errors and log them clearly with impact and repro steps.
* Assist in end\-to\-end testing of workflows that span multiple systems.
* Provide Operational assistance during GHO off\-hours and report any callouts to Onshore counterparts.



  





**Data \& Integration Validation:** 



* Validate data accuracy across interfaces, APIs, batch jobs, and downstream system updates.
* Support testing of scheduled jobs, data feeds, and integration hand\-offs.
* Compare expected vs. actual results for calculations, rules, and configuration\-driven behavior.
* Help ensure data integrity for planning, inventory, and operational reporting.



  





**Automation \& Engineering Practices:** 



* Contribute to automated test suites for APIs, services, and enterprise workflows.
* Execute and maintain existing automated tests as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Assist in creating reusable test data and validation scripts.
* Learn automation frameworks, tools, and best practices used by the team.



  





**Collaboration \& Learning:** 



* Participate in Agile ceremonies including refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Partner with developers and senior QEs to understand system design and test intent.
* Ask questions early to clarify requirements and uncover edge cases.
* Support release testing and post\-release validation activities.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Review defects and production issues to understand root causes and prevention opportunities.
* Suggest improvements to test cases, automation coverage, and documentation.
* Continuously build knowledge of enterprise platforms, business processes, and quality practices.



  





**What You Bring:** 




**Required Qualifications:** 



* 4–5 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, or a related role.
* Experience testing backend systems, APIs, or data\-driven applications.
* Basic understanding of software testing fundamentals and defect lifecycle.
* Exposure to ERP or large\-scale enterprise systems.
* Good at Debugging and root cause analysis
* Familiarity with API testing concepts (REST, JSON, status codes, payload validation).
* Exposure to SQL or basic data validation techniques.
* Comfortable working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to learn complex systems.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience with test automation tools or scripting (JavaScript, Python, or similar).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Basic understanding of business domains such as Merchandising, Inventory, Planning, or Supply Chain.
* Experience working with batch jobs, integrations, or data pipelines.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 Enterprise systems power critical business decisions and operations. As a Quality Engineer I,
 **your work helps ensure that data is accurate, workflows behave as expected, and integrations remain reliable.** 




 This role provides a strong foundation in enterprise quality engineering—preparing you to grow into deeper system ownership, automation leadership, and end\-to\-end quality strategy over time.
 



  





**Benefits \& Perks:** 




 As an Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.) associate in our India Global Capability Center (GCC), you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A\&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward
 


* Comprehensive group medical insurance covering associate, spouse, children, and parents/in\-laws
* Outpatient medical and wellness allowance for associates and dependents
* Associate assistance program offering confidential counseling for mental, financial, and legal support
* Access to fertility, adoption, and family\-forming benefits through Carrot
* Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace

* Paid public and national holidays each year

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Bangalore)
description:
GeneralMind is a Berlin\-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises: an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It's an autopilot: human\-supervised, with approvals where needed. Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end\-to\-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human\-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders. Designed for mid\-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox\-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale. Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond.
 


  

 Tasks
   

  
* Test the platform from a real user's perspective, running through both typical flows and the unusual ones ("what happens if I enter the wrong thing?").
  
* Track down bugs, crashes, display issues, and illogical behaviour, and document them clearly with steps to reproduce.
  
* Judge whether features work the way they should, and flag anything confusing, clunky, or inconsistent (usability).
  
* Check different devices, browsers, and screen sizes to make sure everything works everywhere.
  
* Rank bugs by severity (critical vs. cosmetic) and prioritise them so the team knows what to fix first.
  
* Retest fixed bugs and confirm that the fixes didn't break anything else (regression testing).
  
* Work closely with engineering and product, answer their questions, and help reproduce issues.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* A sharp, thorough eye for detail and the patience to get to the bottom of things.
  
* A structured, clear way of documenting bugs so anyone can follow them.
  
* The ability to think like a user and to use software "the wrong way" on purpose to find its limits.
  
* Clear, easy\-to\-understand communication, both written and spoken.
  
* First experience with software testing, QA tools, or ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, Linear) is a plus, but not a must depending on focus.
  


  


 Werde Teil von GeneralMind als Quality Assurance Engineer! Entwickle deine Fähigkeiten in einem innovativen AI\-Unternehmen in Berlin und gestalte die Zukunft der Automatisierung. Bewirb dich jetzt!

title: QA Engineer – Manual - Desktop Applications
description:
**Create the future of e\-Health together with us by becoming a part of our Development Center in Bangalore**
 As a leading provider of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 passionate professionals. Join us and become part of a dynamic, innovative environment overflowing with possibilities. Your dedication and passion will empower you to make a lasting impact.
   

  

 Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare. Become part of our mission and make a difference—for a world where knowledge saves lives!
   

  

**Your Impact**
 We are looking for a
 **QA Engineer** 
 who can execute test cases manually as well as converting them to automated test cases using C\# and Automation Tools. These are for mission\-critical Windows Desktop products. These products generate significant revenue and require robust, maintainable, and scalable test coverage.
   

  

 You will be responsible understanding the product functionality, executing manual test cases, and for eventual conversion of the test cases to automation using C\# and automation tools. Modern AI Tooling and AI Assisted development will be used in all applicable stages. You will be required to understand and comply with documentation requirements and other best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work closely with the development teams and own the QA activities
* Perform manual QA \- UI, functional, regression, and exploration testing on desktop applications
* Write and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios based on requirements/specifications
* Log, track, and verify defects using bug\-tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps)
* Perform UI, usability, and installation/uninstallation testing for desktop applications
* Collaborate with developers and business analysts to understand requirements and edge cases
* Participate in test planning, test case reviews, and release signoffs
* Document test results and prepare test summary reports
* Extend the existing automation framework and add automated test cases
* Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines


**You Are a Good Fit for This Job If You Have:**
* 2\+ years of experience in manual QA and automation.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC
* Experience writing test cases, test plans, and defect reports
* Familiarity with bug\-tracking/test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Azure DevOps, or similar)
* Good understanding of database concepts (basic SQL for data validation is a plus)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge in C\# and .NET
* Expertise with QA tools like Playwright
* Experience in automating Windows desktop applications
* Excellent communication skills.
* Experience, or an eagerness to learn, AI\-assisted development.
* Relevant academic qualifications.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* High Performing Team: You will be part of a close\-nit, elite team within CGM that will move fast, with accuracy and hit deadlines with confidence.
* Hybrid Work: Enjoy the flexibility of working two days per week remotely and three days on\-site at our Bangalore office.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Extensive group health and accidental insurance programs.
* Seamless Onboarding: A safe digital application process and a structured onboarding program.
* Career Growth: Various career growth opportunities and a competitive merit increment policy.
* Stable \& Resilient domain: Healthcare is a relatively stable and recession\-proof domain.


**Even if you do not meet all the requirements of this job post, we encourage you to apply!** 
 We are interested in your real\-world experience, strengths, and problem\-solving style rather than generic and theoretical assessments.
   

  

**Convinced?** 
 Submit your application now (including desired salary and earliest possible starting date). We create the future of e\-health. Become part of a significant mission.

title: Principal Eng, Disposables
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
   

  

 We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
   

  

**Education Qualification**
 Bachelor’s/master’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent relevant technical degree.
   

  

 10 to 16years of relevant Experience in Systems \& Component level Verification \& Validation activities.
   

  

 Deep domain knowledge in design verification and validation of medical devices.
   

  

 Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in Plastic/Connectors/Products/electro\-mechanical.
   

  

 Understanding of hardware methodologies and test best practices.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Own and drive change control activities by ensuring accountability for all technical aspects of development, sustaining projects, and design controls.
   

  

 Lead the design and execution of R\&D studies, provide manufacturing support as needed, and contribute to product specifications.
   

  

 Drive the development, improvement, and troubleshooting of disposable manufacturing processes.
   

  

 Lead and implement changes through creative solutions, adapting to new product test methods and technologies while driving test automation to improve quality assurance and productivity in test deliverables.
   

  

 Partner with R\&D and cross\-functional teams to coordinate product integration and system testing, including automated testing.
   

  

 Plan, build, and maintain test infrastructure, including lab budget planning and management.
   

  

 Demonstrate the ability to achieve objectives and deliver multiple projects simultaneously.
   

  

 Develop and maintain effective, collaborative working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across levels and cultures.
   

  

 Lead V\&V activities to meet customer requirements, safety, regulatory, and quality expectations within committed timelines.
   

  

 Support corporate, internal, ISO, and regulatory audits by ensuring adherence to Vantive QMS requirements.
   

  

 Lead audit nonconformances or findings to closure by defining and implementing appropriate corrective actions.
   

  

 Lead and execute IQ, OQ, and PQ for equipment and instruments in accordance with QMS site policies.
   

  

 Ensure lab requirements are validated, and laboratories are qualified for intended use; coordinate shared equipment usage when needed.
   

  

 Qualify vendors and add them to the approved vendor list by coordinating with the sourcing team to ensure quick turnaround.
   

  

 Be self\-motivated with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to analyze and solve complex problems through innovative thinking and experience.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with mechanical equipment such as UTM, leak testers, torque testers, and other instruments or equipment would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Design and develop fixtures based on V\&V needs by preparing drawings and working closely with external vendors.
   

  

 Work with global cross\-functional teams to ensure completion of V\&V tasks.
   

  

 Exposure to regulatory standards, medical device manufacturing processes and procedures, RF welding, and solvent bonding would be an added benefit.
   

  

 Exposure to statistical tools such as Minitab and Six Sigma methodologies for results analysis would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Lead and execute assigned testing with minimal dependency on project owners by managing timelines, providing regular result updates, and owning final report preparation, review, sign\-off, and release.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Notice**
 Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

description:
Job Description – PMO \+ QA Analyst
 



**Role:** 
 PMO \+ QA Analyst
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **PMO \+ QA Analyst** 
 who can work across Project Management and Quality Assurance functions. The role requires a combination of
 **QA execution, project coordination, release management, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and quality governance** 
 .
 



 The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Business teams to ensure features and projects are delivered
 **on time and with the expected quality** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple workstreams, tracking project progress, identifying risks and dependencies, coordinating with stakeholders, and independently driving QA activities for assigned features/releases.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 PMO \& Project Management
 


* Track project, sprint, feature, and release timelines.
* Maintain project trackers, sprint trackers, dashboards, and action\-item trackers.
* Monitor progress against planned timelines and highlight deviations.
* Track
 **risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and blockers (RAID)** 
 .
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities.
* Follow up on pending tasks and ensure closure of action items.
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, release discussions, and project meetings.
* Track feature readiness across different stages of the SDLC.
* Monitor dependencies between Product, Development, QA, vendors, and other teams.
* Prepare and circulate regular project/sprint status reports.
* Escalate risks, blockers, and timeline concerns to relevant stakeholders.
* Support planning and tracking of multiple projects/releases simultaneously.



 QA \& Quality Assurance
 


* Review
 **PRDs, user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, edge cases, and dependencies before development/testing.
* Prepare and review test scenarios and detailed test cases.
* Execute and coordinate
 **functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and end\-to\-end testing** 
 .
* Perform API testing using tools such as
 **Postman** 
 .
* Validate UI, API responses, business rules, validations, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Log detailed defects in JIRA with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, severity, and supporting evidence.
* Track defects through the complete lifecycle and coordinate with Development/Product teams for resolution.
* Perform defect retesting and regression after fixes.
* Validate fixes across relevant environments.
* Monitor QA progress and identify testing risks or gaps.
* Maintain QA metrics such as test execution status, defect status, open blockers, and release readiness.
* Support production issue investigation and RCA activities.
* Ensure adequate regression coverage before releases.



 Release \& Production Readiness
 


* Coordinate QA activities for planned releases.
* Track feature readiness across
 **Development, UAT, Pre\-Production, and Production** 
 environments.
* Ensure required QA activities and documentation are completed before release.
* Track test execution, open defects, blockers, and pending dependencies before release.
* Coordinate QA sign\-off/release readiness with relevant stakeholders.
* Support production deployment validation and post\-release verification.
* Track production issues and ensure appropriate RCA and closure.
* Maintain release documentation, test reports, and sign\-off records.



 Quality \& Process Improvement
 


* Identify gaps in existing QA and project execution processes.
* Recommend improvements to testing, tracking, documentation, and release processes.
* Ensure standard QA and PMO processes are followed across projects.
* Identify recurring defects, process gaps, and quality risks.
* Contribute to improving test coverage and release quality.
* Help establish and maintain project and QA metrics.
* Support implementation of quality gates and production\-readiness checks.



  





 Required Skills
 


* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in QA, PMO, Project Coordination, or a combination of these.
* Strong understanding of
 **SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and software delivery lifecycle** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with functional and regression testing.
* Experience in API testing using
 **Postman** 
 or similar tools.
* Good knowledge of
 **JIRA** 
 and project/task tracking.
* Strong knowledge of
 **Excel / Google Sheets** 
 and reporting.
* Good understanding of defect lifecycle and release management.
* Ability to review requirements and identify gaps.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, features, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent documentation and follow\-up skills.



 Good to Have
 


* Knowledge of
 **SQL/MongoDB** 
 .
* Experience with automation tools such as
 **Selenium, TestNG, Karate, or REST Assured** 
 .
* Basic understanding of performance/load testing.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as Kibana.
* Experience working with API\-driven products.
* Experience in
 **FinTech, Banking, SaaS, or enterprise technology products** 
 .
* Understanding of production\-readiness and release\-governance processes.



 Key Competencies
 


* **Ownership:** 
 Takes responsibility for assigned features, releases, and deliverables.
* **Coordination:** 
 Effectively works with Product, Development, QA, and Business teams.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 Identifies requirement, testing, and process gaps.
* **Communication:** 
 Clearly communicates progress, risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* **Problem Solving:** 
 Investigates issues and drives them toward resolution.
* **Planning:** 
 Can prioritize and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* **Quality Mindset:** 
 Focuses on preventing issues rather than only identifying defects.
* **Execution:** 
 Ensures planned activities are tracked through completion.



  





 Success in This Role
 



  





 The person should be able to independently:
 



  




* Drive QA activities for assigned features/releases.
* Maintain accurate project and QA trackers.
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Coordinate effectively with Product, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure testing and release activities are completed on schedule.
* Provide clear visibility into
 **project status, quality status, and release readiness** 
 .
* Contribute to improving the overall QA and project execution process
